Charlotte Chess Center Tuesday Night Action

Charlotte Chess Center (Main/South)

weekly on Tuesday, starting from Tuesday, March 11, 2014, forever

Event Overview

OVERVIEW

Tuesday Night Action  is one US Chess-rated game every Tuesday night, completely free for CCC members. This is a great way for players to get weekly rated practice. The Top and U1600 Sections are also FIDE-rated - offering the only free weekly FIDE-rated game in the whole country. In addition, there is a free lecture before the games begin.

HOW IT WORKS

-
CCC opens Tuesdays at 5:45pm

-
Lecture with FM Peter Giannatos prior to rated games starting at 6:00 pm

-
Players must register weekly and in advance using the online registration system

-
Each Tuesday evening will be limited to the first 62 players to register

-
TNA registration will close at 6:30pm if not already full

-
Once spots are filled, players may email  events Click here to show mail address  to be placed on the waitlist.

​REQUIREMENTS

-
Players must be members of the  CCC

-
Players must have a  USChess membership

-
Open to all players in grades 9-12 and adults

-
Students in grades K-8 must be rated over 900

K-8 players rated under 900 - See  Monday Action Quads ,  Wednesday Action Quads ,  Friday Action Quads ,  and   Sunday Action Quads

​START TIME

Lecture: 6:00pm

Game: 7:00pm

GAMES

1 round weekly, rated at the end of the month

​ SECTIONS

TOP (1600+)

Under 1600

Under 1300

​ PRIZES

-
2.5/3.0 score required for TNA tournaments with 3 weeks or 4.0/5.0 score required for TNA tournaments with 5 weeks.

-
Free entries must be used for  Monday Action Quads ,  Wednesday Action Quads ,  Friday Action Quads , and  Sunday Action Quads  within 1 month.

-
Not transferrable to other events or players.

-
Section winners will receive a voucher for CCC merch.

TIME CONTROL

Top Section: G/80, inc/10 - FIDE and US Chess Rated

U1600 Section: G/60, inc/10 - FIDE and US Chess Rated

U1300 Section: G/60, inc/10 - US Chess Rated

ENTRY FEE

Free, must be a  CCC Member ​  - CCC membership only $50/year -  join today !​

OTHER NOTES​​

-
Top and U1600 Sections are FIDE-rated - FIDE rules apply, except for US Chess penalties for cell phone infractions.

-
Tournament Directors will accelerate pairings to pair players close in rating when possible

-
Most recent "live" US Chess regular ratings used for all sections to ensure close matchups

-
Open to high schoolers and adults of any rating, including unrated

-
All players must use CCC equipment - wooden sets and digital clocks are provided

PRIZES

-
The top adult (18 or older) in each section will win a $25 gift card to USCF Sales .

-
The top junior (under 18) in each section will win a $25 gift card to USCF Sales .

-
All perfect scores (with perfect attendance) will receive a 3-month CCC membership extension.

-
See special notes on site for tiebreak rules.

The Charlotte Chess Center’s Main/South Location is conveniently located off of I-485 and Pineville-Matthews Road. CCC’s Main/South Branch serves both North Carolina and South Carolina. Regulars join in from Ballantyne, Pineville, SouthPark, Matthews, Mint Hill, Waxhaw, Weddington, Steele Creek, Fort Mill, Tega Cay, Rock Hill, Lake Wylie and South Charlotte.

Address: 10700 Kettering Drive

Unit E

Charlotte , NC 28226

United States

Climb The Rating Ladder Online Courses (Rated Games & Analysis)

Online

weekly on Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday, starting from Friday, May 1, 2020, forever

Event Overview

Climb the Rating Ladder Online Courses

By DMV Chess since May 2020!

OVERVIEW

Register here: https://www.dmvchess.com/courses-register

Students play one USCF-online-regular-rated game per week, after which a professional chess coach will help students analyze their games together as a group. When time permits, the coach will also give the class puzzles and lectures on tactics and strategy. Coaches are all experienced chess players who have a passion for teaching.

-
Time control: game in 25 minutes with a 5-second increment

-
Games submitted to the USCF for rating at the end of every month

-
Open to scholastic players from any geographical location

-
Wednesday class exclusively for adults

-
Active USCF membership required

-
Class participation strongly encouraged

-
Groups meet online on different days for two hours .

Schedule (Eastern Time):

Monday class from 6:30 pm to 8:30 pm- (designed for 400 to 1000 USCF)

Tuesday  class from 6 pm to 8 pm- (designed for 400 to 1000 USCF)

Wednesday (Adults) class from 8 pm to 10 pm- (Open)

Friday class from 6 pm to 8 pm- (designed for 400 to 1000 USCF)

Friday (Advanced) class from 7 pm to 9 pm- (designed for 1100 to 1600 USCF)

Sunday class from 6 pm to 8 pm- (designed for 250 to 850 USCF)

Coaches:

Mondays: National Master Justin Burgess

Tuesdays: National Master Dennis Norman

Wednesdays: National Master Sam Martin

Fridays: Chess Author & USCF Expert Kevin Stokker

Fridays (Advanced): International Master Joshua Posthuma

Sundays: USCF Expert Epiphany Peters

Registration & Billing

The cost of enrollment is $150/month for every course except the Friday advanced class. The cost of enrollment for the Friday Advanced course is $200/month. Fees are assessed regardless of attendance. After registering online, you will be set up for automatic monthly payments. These payments can be cancelled prior to the start of the upcoming month.

To register for this course , kindly visit our website: https://www.dmvchess.com/courses-register

Note: If you would like to join a class mid-month, we can send you a pro-rated invoice for the first month. By default, students who register online will be enrolled on the first of the upcoming month. After registering on the website, please email Click here to show mail address if you would like to be enrolled immediately in the middle of a month.

Address: lichess.org

Tysons Corner , VA 22102

United States

Charlotte Chess Center Wednesday Action Quads

Charlotte Chess Center (Main/South)

weekly on Wednesday, starting from Wednesday, September 14, 2022, forever

Event Overview

OVERVIEW
A 3 round "quad" US Chess-rated tournament open to all adult players and youth.  Quads, which group players by their skill level, are a great way to ensure closer matchups for a more fun and competitive challenge. Opportunity to play 3 regular rated games in one night!

Top Quads are FIDE rapid rated!
​
WHEN
Every Wednesday Night!
​
WHERE
Charlotte Chess Center - Main/South Campus
10700 Kettering Drive, Unit E
Charlotte, NC 28226
​
CCC HOURS
6:00pm - 10:00pm

REQUIREMENTS

- Participants must be members of the  US Chess Federation

​
ROUND TIMES
Round 1: 7:00pm
Round 2: ASAP
Round 3: ASAP
End Time: Between 8:30pm-10:00pm depending on quad.

HOW IT WORKS

- Players must register weekly and in advance

- Quads - players placed into groups of 4 by their most recent US Chess rating*

- 3 US Chess rated games every Wednesday night
- Top 6 quads also FIDE rapid rated

- Each evening will be limited to the first 60 players to register

- Entries are first registered, first served​

*Minor roster shifts to avoid family member pairings may be possible
​​
PRIZES
$40 to the winner(s) of each quad; $45 for perfect 3-0 score
TIME CONTROL
G/20; Increment 10
Each player receives 20 minutes plus a 10 second bonus each move to complete each game
ENTRY FEE
CCC Members Rated 2000+:  Free Entry ( $20 deducted from any prize )
CCC Members:  $20.00
Non-Members:  $25.00
​
Join the CCC and Save  - Only $50 a Year - Save on Camps, Classes, Tournaments and More!
The Charlotte Chess Center’s Main/South Location is conveniently located off of I-485 and Pineville-Matthews Road. CCC’s Main/South Branch serves both North Carolina and South Carolina, with regulars coming from Lake Wylie, Ballantyne, Pineville, SouthPark, Matthews, Mint Hill, Waxhaw, Weddington, Steele Creek, Fort Mill, Tega Cay, Rock Hill, and South Charlotte.

Address: 10700 Kettering Drive

Unit E

Charlotte , NC 28226

United States

A three round US Chess-rated tournament open to all scholastic (K-12) players. Quads, which group students in sections of 4 by their rating level, are a great way for students to get closer matchups for a more fun and competitive challenge.

Every Friday Night!

Round 1: 7:00pm
Round 2: ASAP

- Players must register weekly and in advance

- Each evening will be limited to the first 62 players to register

- Quads are for students (K-12) only

Community Chess Club of Rochester Wednesday Night chess!

Rochester Chess Center

weekly on Wednesday, starting from Wednesday, January 4, 2023, forever

Event Overview

1 USCF-Rated Game, G/80 d5. New players welcome. *EF: $6 for visiting players; CCCR members $4. Register on-site: 6:30-7:15 pm. Rd.: 7:30pm.
*US Chess Membership is required and can be done on-site during registration. Cost varies by age group: 20 (Youth), $27 Young Adult, $45 Adult, $40 Senior. Details for eligibility for each age group is available from the US Chess site and during registration at the Chess Center.

- Snack bar on-site at the Chess Center.

- Many special events take place throughout the year including our annual club championship.

- Club Membership is optional. Club membership is $30 for individual members and $40 for family members in same household.

- Chess game pairing is generally arranged by closest chess rating available. New players generally play the lower-rated players.

- Our Club's Web Site: www.rochesterchessclub.org

- Rochester Chess Center store on-site for all your chess needs, including sets, boards, clocks, books and more.

- You may schedule Chess Lessons and Sign-up for Chess Camps run by the Rochester Chess Center.

History: Our chess club has been hosting chess players for over 60 years. During this time, thousands of USCF-rated chess games have been played, and countless unrated chess games have been played (e.g. Blitz, Simultaneous exhibitions, etc.). Weekly club meetings are held at the Rochester Chess Center located at 221 Norris Drive, Rochester, NY 14610; Phone: (585) 442-2430. We welcome all chess players & curious visitors. Currently, we have chess players of all ages with USCF ratings from beginner to Master strength. All are welcome.
Club Organization: Club President: Ken McBride (Local TD), Vice President: Jamshed Ahmed (Club TD), Treasurer/Organizer: Mike Lionti (Senior TD), Club Secretary: Mike Runnells, Club Officers: Mike Runnells and David Worl. Several other TDs and volunteers also assist us.

Bearcat DKC Grand Prix September 2023

Dragon Knight Chess Center

weekly on Sunday, Friday and Saturday, starting from Saturday, September 16, 2023, forever

Event Overview

-
DKC Grand Prix Tournament Information

-
September 2023 Dragon Knight Chess Grand Prix Tournaments

Join us for chess tournaments in our new home at  2000 Bearcat Way, Suite 104, Morrisville 27560 , where we are hosting our September tournaments  Friday-Sunday  (plus a special Labor Day tournament)!

- Players of all ages and experience levels are invited to attend.

- Entry fee: $20 in advance, or $30 onsite.  Entry fees help to fund the 2023 Dragon Knight Chess ("DKC") Grand Prix.

- Time controls:  Saturday and Sunday afternoons (1pm) : Time control for sections below 800: Game in 25 minutes; 5 second delay/move.  Time control for sections above 800; Game in 45 minutes; 5 second delay/move

- Time control for  Friday night (6pm) Quick :  Game in 15 minutes; 5 second delay/move

- Cash prizes in the top rated section:

- 1st: $40

- 2nd: $27

- 3rd: $13

- New scholastic tournament players receive a 1 year USCF membership!

- New players are welcome!

Sections have 4 players each by rating (Quad Setup). Below the top rated section, 1st place wins a trophy, 2nd place wins a medal, and 3rd place wins a small scorebook.  (Alternative prizes are available.)  Also, all players who adequately record the moves in their tournament games get a keychain chess piece.

Adults are invited to participate, but must have a US Chess Federation Membership which can be purchased here:  https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess

Free Blitz  Tourna ments!

Free blitz tournaments  are scheduled immediately following the regular  Saturday and Sunday  afternoon tournaments. These are recommended for all adults ages 16 and up; and for players younger than 16 with ratings of at least 700.

- Double Round Robin, or Swiss System if many entries

- Time control is Game in 5 minutes; +2 second increment each move

- Blitz tournament starts on  Saturday and Sundays at 4:30pm  (or immediately after players complete 1pm tournament)

- Estimated end: 7pm

- Free blitz!   No immediate cash prizes, but points count toward the 2023 Dragon Knight Chess Grand Prix!

- USCF rated - Adult players must have current USCF membership

Rated DKC tournament points scored earn 2023 DKC Grand Prix points, which earn prizes for category winners. Scroll down the list of players at:

https://www.dragonknightchess.com/tournaments/

Tournament Registration

Register now (Tournament)! -  https://form.jotform.com/232403191843148

or the registration button to play in our tournaments! You can either register once for all of September, or submit a registration form for each tournament you wish to attend.

Register now!

Charlotte Chess Center Monday Action Quads

Charlotte Chess Center (North)

weekly on Monday, starting from Monday, November 13, 2023, forever

Event Overview

Monday Action Quads

A three round US Chess-rated tournament open to all scholastic (K-12) players.  Quads, which group students in sections of 4 by their rating level, are a great way for students to get closer matchups for a more fun and competitive challenge.  MAQ   is held at our CCC North Branch.

During the Fall and Spring seasons, this event does count for eligibility towards the  Tournament of Champions .

​ CHECK OUT ALL OF OUR EVENTS!

HOW IT WORKS

-
Players must register weekly and in advance

-
3 US Chess regular and quick rated games every Monday night

-
Quad format - students placed into groups of 4 by their most current "live" US Chess regular rating to ensure closer matchups.

-
Each evening will be limited to the first 42 players to register

-
Entries are first registered, first served

-
Quads are for students (K-12) only

-
IMPROVE -  Game Analysis and Blitz with CCC Coaches

ROUND TIMES

Round 1: 6:30pm

Round 2: ASAP

Round 3: ASAP

Approximate End Time: 8:30pm

WHEN

Every Monday Night!

Can't make Monday evenings? Great alternatives are:

-
Friday Pizza Quads  ( CCC North  and  South  Branches )

-
Sunday Action Quads  ( CCC Main/South )

​ TIME CONTROL

G/20; Increment 10

Each player receives 20 minutes plus a 10 second bonus each move to complete each game

​ PRIZES

Medal to winner of each quad

ENTRY FEE

Players currently rated 1200+:  FREE Entry   (see special notes for details)

CCC Members:  $17.50

Non-Members:  $22.50

​ Join the CCC and Save  - Only $50 a Year - Save on Camps, Classes, Tournaments and More!

The Charlotte Chess Center’s North Branch is conveniently located off of I-485 and Benfield Road. Opened in September of 2023, the CCC’s North Branch serves North Charlotte, University City, Concord, Kannapolis, Harrisburg, Huntersville, Cornelius, Davidson, Lake Norman, and Mooresville. Regulars visit from both North Carolina and South Carolina.

2024 Weekly and Monthly Rated and Unrated Chess at Memphis Chess Club

Memphis Chess Club

weekly on Sunday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday, starting from Saturday, March 9, 2024, forever

Event Overview

Weekly and Monthly rated and unrated chess

Sundays

1st Sundays of the month

All Sundays: 2pm Afternoon Beginner lessons and 3pm non-rated 4ss G/10, each $15 EF and ribbons for prizes, free for MCC Full and Fam Members.

4th Tuesdays of the month (starting in 2022)

4pm Scholastic Chess Team Tournament (Students Only!) 3ss G/25d5 $15, Trophies and Ribbons, rated and non-rated sections, $5 off for MCC Members.  All school teams welcome, regardless of size.

Wednesdays

Casual/Social Free Play Chess, 5pm-close.  Free chess set rentals for non-members.

Thursday nights

5:30pm Intermediate Lesson, usually with Master-or-higher. (IM Dave Ross as of March 2024, for the past 6 months)

6:45pm bimonthly Memphis Chess League, G/45+10, $5/game or free for MCC Members.

Saturdays

12:30pm 3ss accel G/25d5 $15, 80% paid out;

2nd Saturdays of the month instead... 8:30am... 4ss G/45+10 rds at 9am,12pm,2pm,4pm, $40 EF, 80% p/o; OR 1700+ Memphis' Closed Circuit, 3ss G90/d5, rds at 9am, 12pm, 4pm, $40 EF, 80% p/o, points awarded to qualify toward 2022 Memphis City Championship, 13-8-5-3-2-1, additional 1 point for playing;

4:30pm 5ss Blitz (7pm on 2nd Saturdays), G/5 on odd weekends; G/3+2 on even weekends, 80% p/o, $25 1st month Saturdays, $10 all other Saturdays;

MCC Members $5 EF discount.

Some 2nd Saturday weekends are larger tournaments.

Full schedule and prize information at memphischessclub.com/calendar

Charlotte Chess Center Friday Action Quads - North

Charlotte Chess Center (North)

weekly on Friday, starting from Friday, May 3, 2024, forever

Event Overview

Friday Action Quads - North
A three round US Chess-rated tournament open to all scholastic (K-12) players. Quads, which group students in sections of 4 by their rating level, are a great way for students to get closer matchups for a more fun and competitive challenge.
During the Fall and Spring seasons, this event does count for eligibility towards the  Tournament of Champions .
​ CHECK OUT ALL OF OUR EVENTS!
WHEN
Every Friday Night!
Can't make Friday evenings?   Great alternatives are:

- Sunday Action Quads   ( CCC Main/South )

- Monday Action Quads  ( CCC North )

Friday Action Quads is also offered at our South Location -  Info Here
REGISTRATION
Limited to first 42 to register.  Registration must be completed online ahead of the event.
REQUIREMENTS

- Ages 17 and under

- Participants must be members of the  US Chess Federation

- US Chess is the governing body of chess in the US and conducts all of the rating calculations for players. Need a US Chess Membership? Purchase through the  CCC and save !

​​ ROUND TIMES
Round 1: 7:00pm
Round 2: ASAP
Round 3: ASAP
Approximate End Time: 9:00pm
HOW IT WORKS

- Players must register weekly and in advance

- 3 US Chess regular and quick rated games every Friday night

- Quad format - students placed into groups of 4 by their most current "live" US Chess regular rating to ensure closer matchups.

- Each evening will be limited to the first 42 players to register

- Entries are first registered, first served

- Quads are for students (K-12) only​

PRIZES
Medal to winner of each quad
​​ TIME CONTROL
G/20; Increment 10
Each player receives 20 minutes plus a 10 second bonus each move to complete each game
​ ENTRY FEE
Players currently rated 1500+:  FREE Entry   (see special notes for details)
CCC Members:  $17.50
Non-Members:  $22.50
​
Join the CCC and Save  - Only $50 a Year - Save on Camps, Classes, Tournaments and more!

The Charlotte Chess Center’s North Branch is conveniently located off of I-485 and Benfield Road. Opened in September of 2023, the CCC’s North Branch serves North Charlotte, University City, Concord, Kannapolis, Harrisburg, Huntersville, Cornelius, Davidson, Lake Norman, and Mooresville. Regulars visit from both North Carolina and South Carolina.

Monthly Classical at Manchester YMCA

YMCA of Downtown Manchester, Studio A[webform_submission:values:event_location_online]

weekly on Tuesday, starting from Tuesday, May 14, 2024, forever

Event Overview

USCF Rated Chess tournaments every month at the Manchester YMCA.

Four rounds, one game each Tuesday at 6:30pm.

First round is on the first Tuesday of each month.

After first round, late-comers are still welcome to register for rounds 2, 3 and 4.

​USCF dual rated - classical and rapid. G/45;+5.

One open section

US Chess Federation membership required.

ENTRY FEE : $10 (to secure a 4-week chess-only YMCA ‘membership’ for venue access). Free entry to members of Granite YMCA.

First place secures free entry to a future Queen City Chess tournament.

REGISTRATION : Online registration required.

Register online at link:   https://ymcagranite.sgasoftware.com/Sales/Product?SearchText=chess

½ point byes upon advance request (limit 1 per tournament; additional 0 point byes allowed) – email  Click here to show mail address

Late joins welcome (but please show up promptly at 6PM for pairing).

SCHEDULE :

6:00pm Check-in; Setup; Discussion on tactics and puzzle themes

6:30pm Check-in closes and round pairings are formulated

6:45pm Game clocks start ticking

ARRIVE NO LATER THAN 6:30PM TO ENSURE A PAIRING.

IF YOU EXPECT TO ARRIVE AFTER 6:30PM, PLEASE CONTACT ORGANIZER TO SECURE A PAIRING.

YOUR OPPONENT MAY START YOUR CLOCK AT 6:45PM

Facility closes at 9pm

PARKING:

Metered on street parking available but limited. Parking garage is one block away at 2-98 Plaza Dr. in Manchester.

Accessibility: Elevator from street level is available. Ring buzzer for assistance. Chess event is on second floor.

NEWSLETTER:  Signup for weekly email updates by going to  https://queencitychessnh.wixsite.com/chess

QUESTIONS? Email Eric at  [email protected] , or text or call (929) 900-4226

Event Overview

**Novi's AccelerateKid Scholastic Tournament Overview**

**Presented by Implodians Chess School LLC**

Join us for an exciting day of competitive chess at the Novi's AccelerateKid Scholastic Tournament, sponsored by The Implodians Chess School LLC. This event is designed to provide young chess enthusiasts with a platform to showcase their skills, challenge themselves, and enjoy the spirit of competition.

**Date and Time:**

May 19th, starting at 10:00 AM EASTERN( this week only ,then back to every 2nd sunday)

**Venue:**

24404 Catherine Industrial Dr #316, Novi, MI 48377

**Tournament Format:**

- 5 Round Swiss

- USCF REGULAR Rated

- 3 Sections: Open, Under 900, Under 600

- Time Control: G/30; d5 (5-second delay)

**Entry Fee:**

$30 per participant. Ensure your spot by registering before the deadline on April 13th at 9:00 PM.

**Tournament Schedule:**

- Rounds begin at 10am, followed by 11:15am, 1:00pm, 2:15pm, and 3:30pm.

- Pairings for each round will be created as soon as possible after the previous round ends.

- The tournament is anticipated to conclude before 5pm.

**Awards:**

- Trophies for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd places in the Open and Under 900 sections.

- In the Under 600 section, trophies will be awarded to the top 5 finishers (1st through 5th).

- A special "Best Notation Award" will be given to the participant with the most legible and accurate score sheet.

- All awards are based on a minimum of 50 entries.

**Registration:**

Secure your participation by registering online at [https://onlineregistration.cc/](https://onlineregistration.cc/). Don't miss the chance to be part of this enriching chess experience!

**Contact Information:**

For more details about the tournament, please reach out to Bryan Wilson at (313)878-2807 or via email at [ [email protected] ](mailto: [email protected] ).

This tournament promises to be a day filled with strategic thinking, sportsmanship, and fun. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the world of competitive chess, the Novi's AccelerateKid Scholastic Tournament is the perfect opportunity to improve your game, meet fellow chess enthusiasts, and possibly take home a trophy. Register now and be part of this exciting chess event!

Dragon Knight Sunday Scholastic Quads

Dragon Knight Chess Center

weekly on Sunday, starting from Sunday, June 16, 2024, forever

Event Overview

Each Sunday at 10:00am

A 3-6 round "quad" US Chess rated tournament open to all scholastic (K-12) players. Quads group players by their skill level. This is a chance to play 3-6 rated (regular and quick) games each Sunday morning!

Dragon Knight Chess Center

2000 Bearcat Way

Suite 104

Morrisville, NC  27560

(919) 422-2535

3-6 round (Single or Double) Quad Round Robin sections

First place trophy in each 4 player section. Team trophy to top school overall. Other prizes will also be awarded.

Registration and Entry Fee:

$19 online mid-day before the event (Noon Saturday), or

$29 onsite registration 9:00-9:30am day of tournament.

Players currently rated 1200+: Free Entry

Free Entry Policy:

Free entry is offered to scholastic (K-12) players who have a current "live Over The Board (OTB)" US Chess rating of 1200+. No exceptions.

To get free entry, players must register online mid-day before the event (Noon Saturday).

If you register for free but must cancel, email [email protected]

or text (919) 422-2535 by 9:00am (one hour before Round 1 of the quad).

Players receiving free entry are not permitted to withdraw mid-quad, without permission from all other players in their quad. Free entry players who withdraw mid-quad (without permission) will not be eligible for free entry in future Dragon Knight Chess quads.

US Chess membership required; Dragon Knight Chess will use vouchers to create new scholastic memberships. US Chess is the governing body of chess in the United States. US Chess conducts all rating calculations for players.

Time Control:

Above USCF 800 sections G/40; delay 5 (3 games):  Each player receives 40 minutes (plus a 5 second delay each move) to complete each game.

USCF U800 sections G/25; delay 5 (3-6 games):  Each player receives 25 minutes (plus a 5 second delay each move) to complete each game.

Onsite registration 9:00-9:30am day of tournament.

Round Times:

1st Round 10:00am;

Round 2: ASAP;

Round 3: ASAP

End Time: Between Noon-1pm, depending on quad.

How it Works:

Players must register weekly.

Quads: Players are placed into groups of 4 by their most recent "live" US Chess regular rating. (Minor section shifts are possible, to avoid family member pairings.)

3-6 rated games each Sunday morning

Each Sunday morning is limited to the first 40 players to register.

Entries are first registered, first served.

Quads are for K-12 students only.

IMPROVE - Game analysis and blitz with Dragon Knight Chess coaches IM Jonathan Schroer and Paul Ascolese (peak FIDE rating 2275)

For questions, concerns, and withdrawals prior to the event email:   [email protected]

For contact during the event email (above) or text (or call) ( 919) 422-2535

GMChessPrep Academy, owned by GM Rashad Babaev, is excited to announce that we will be hosting online USCF quick rated tournaments every other week on Saturdays at 11 AM EST time. In addition to tournament access, participants will receive full access to GMChessPrep's material and database.

For a small fee of $15, players can participate in two tournaments during the month. This is a great opportunity for chess enthusiasts to compete with like-minded individuals and improve their game by learning from GMChessPrep's extensive resources.

Don't miss out on this chance to join our community and take your chess skills to the next level. Register now for our upcoming tournaments and start your journey towards becoming a better chess player.

Tournament details: 4 rounds, time control 10min 3 sec for each player. USCF membership is required, no byes.

Registration fee is $15 for two tournaments for players who do not hold account with us. Tournament is free for current students of GMChessPrep academy.

Downriver Chess - Tuesday Night Club Play

Morning Call

weekly on Tuesday, starting from Tuesday, July 16, 2024, forever

Event Overview

Tuesdays at Morning Call, 5101 Canal Blvd
Registration for 6:30 PM, pairings for 7 PM
Five rounds over five weeks, G/90;d5, $5 entry fee (prizes at end of five-week sequence)
USCF-membership required
All ages and skill levels welcome! Join any week.
We do not play on Saints games or major holidays, check  our facebook  for potential cancellations.
90% of entries returned as prizes to top three of open and U1600 classes

Half point byes are available upon request but must be made prior to pairing round four in non-emergency situations. Bye requests cannot be cancelled following the start of round four. If you are unable to attend round five and have not previously requested this as a bye, please let us know for pairing purposes (but you will receive 0 points).
Sign up for our newsletter

Newark JFK Chess Club

John F. Kennedy Recreation & Aquatic Center.

weekly on Tuesday and Friday, starting from Tuesday, September 24, 2024, forever

Event Overview

Unlock Your Chess Potential at Newark JFK Recreation!

Are you ready to dive into the exciting world of chess? Newark JFK Recreation is thrilled to announce our comprehensive chess program, catering to players from beginners to advanced levels! Join us every Tuesday and Friday from 4:30 PM to 6 PM for engaging lessons and strategic gameplay that will elevate your skills.

What We Offer:

-
Beginner to Advanced Classes : Whether you’re just starting out or looking to sharpen your tactics, our skilled instructors will guide you through the intricacies of the game. You'll learn essential techniques, openings, and strategies to outsmart your opponents.

-
Introduction to Tournament Play : Immediately following our classes, we will introduce you to the thrilling world of tournament play. Discover what it takes to compete, and gain valuable insights into the competitive chess landscape.

-
Opportunity to Represent Our Club : We’re excited to announce that the chess club will be selecting players to represent us in upcoming team tournaments! This is your chance to showcase your skills, gain experience, and be part of a passionate community of chess enthusiasts.

Why Join Us?

Chess is more than just a game; it’s a fantastic way to develop critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and patience. Plus, it’s a great way to make new friends and become part of a supportive community. Whether you’re playing for fun or aspiring to compete, there’s a place for you here.

How to Get Involved:

Don’t miss out on this fantastic opportunity to enhance your chess skills and join our vibrant chess community! Simply come to Newark JFK Recreation on Tuesdays or Fridays at 4:30 PM, and we’ll take care of the rest. Bring your enthusiasm and willingness to learn, and let’s make some moves together!

We look forward to seeing you on the board! Let’s checkmate those challenges and have fun along the way. For more information, feel free to reach out to us or visit our website. Happy playing! ♟️

Junior Joust by Temecula Chess Club

Temecula Chess Club

monthly on Saturday, but only the second and the 4th instance of this set, starting from Saturday, November 16, 2024, forever

Event Overview

Tournament Schedule
Day: Second and Fourth Saturday of the month
Time: 11:00am
Location: Temecula Chess Club
Participants must arrive  5 to 15 minutes  before the tournament begins. The first round will start  promptly at 11:00 AM , and the clock will begin running as soon as the round starts.

Tournament Information
Participants:
This is for TCC members ages 17 and below with USCF Quick rating of 1300 or less. A player who surpassed 1300 in the midst of the season will be allowed to continue to play and will be eligible in that season's finals. Participants is required to have a USCF number from the  US Chess Federation and must be a TCC Member .

Format:
The event is a 4 round Swiss.
Players qualify for season finals each three months by accumulating five points total throughout the regular season.

Time Control:
15 minutes for each side, i.e. G/15.

Ratings:
Event is United States Chess Federation Quick rated.

Prizes:
Medals for the top 3 participants

Tournament Registration
Entry Fee:
$15 Early Registration (day before the tournament)
$20 Same Day/ On Site Registration

Registration:
Players must accomplish our  Registration Form  prior tournament.

Dragon Knight Sunday Afternoon Scholastic Quads (Holly Springs)

Dragon Knight Chess Center

weekly on Sunday, starting from Sunday, December 1, 2024, forever

Event Overview

Dragon Knight Sunday Afternoon Scholastic Quads (Holly Springs)

Each Sunday at 1:30pm
A 3-6 round "quad" US Chess rated tournament open to all scholastic (K-12) players. Quads group players by their skill level. This is a chance to play 3-6 rated (regular and quick) games each Sunday afternoon!
New School Montessori Center
5617 Sunset Lake Road
Holly Springs, NC  27540
(919) 422-2535
3-6 round (Single or Double) Quad Round Robin sections
First place trophy in each 4 player section. Team trophy to top school overall. Other prizes will also be awarded.
Registration and Entry Fee:
$19 online mid-day before the event (Noon Saturday), or
$29 onsite registration 12:30-1pm day of tournament.
Players currently rated 1200+: Free Entry
Free Entry Policy:
Free entry is offered to scholastic (K-12) players who have a current "live Over The Board (OTB)" US Chess rating of 1200+. No exceptions.
To get free entry, players must register online mid-day before the event (Noon Saturday).
If you register for free but must cancel, email [email protected]
or text (919) 422-2535 by 12:30pm (one hour before Round 1 of the quad).
Players receiving free entry are not permitted to withdraw mid-quad, without permission from all other players in their quad. Free entry players who withdraw mid-quad (without permission) will not be eligible for free entry in future Dragon Knight Chess quads.
US Chess membership required; Dragon Knight Chess will use vouchers to create new scholastic memberships. US Chess is the governing body of chess in the United States. US Chess conducts all rating calculations for players.
Time Control:
Above USCF 800 sections G/40; delay 5 (3 games):  Each player receives 40 minutes (plus a 5 second delay each move) to complete each game.
USCF U800 sections G/24; delay 4 (3-6 games):  Each player receives 24 minutes (plus a 4 second delay each move) to complete each game.
Onsite registration 12:30-1pm day of tournament.
Round Times:
1st Round 1:30pm;
Round 2: ASAP;
Round 3: ASAP
End Time: Between 3-4:30pm, depending on quad.
How it Works:
Players must register weekly.
Quads: Players are placed into groups of 4 by their most recent "live" US Chess rating. (Minor section shifts are possible, to avoid family member pairings.)
3-6 rated games each Sunday afternoon
Each Sunday afternoon is limited to the first 50 players to register.
Entries are first registered, first served.
Quads are for K-12 students only.
IMPROVE - Game analysis and blitz with Dragon Knight Chess coaches IM Jonathan Schroer and Paul Ascolese (peak FIDE rating 2275)
SIDE EVENTS - Free USCF rated blitz and quick tournaments start as early as 1:30pm.
For questions, concerns, and withdrawals prior to the event email:  [email protected]
For contact during the event email (above) or text (or call) ( 919) 422-2535
Handicap Accessible

NO Residency Restriction: Open to all scholastic players!
Live OTB event

Address: 2000 Bearcat Way

Suite 104

Morrisville , NC 27560

United States

FMCA

Clock Tower Center, Future Masters Chess Academy

weekly on Sunday, Tuesday and Saturday, starting from Wednesday, January 1, 2025, forever

Event Overview

FMCA runs weekend tournaments with sections Open, U1800, U1400 and U700.
Month-long, one game per Tuesday night, starting with the first Tuesday of the month.
We have blitz tournaments on Saturday and Sunday Nights.
On Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, we provide rigorous training for beginners (U400), Emerging (U800), and Next Level (U1400).
Future Master Leve (Over 1400)
Chess Master and Massachusetts State Champion, Lawyer Times, is the founder, owner, and teacher of FMCA.

G/45,d5. Quads USCF rated.

e4 Chess Academy

weekly, starting from Saturday, January 4, 2025, forever

Event Overview

G/45;d5. USCF rated. Saturday Quads

Players must register in advance. No on-site registration.
Refunds are available up to 24hr before the event.
Rounds: 11am then ASAP. All players play three games.

Format: 4-person round-robin or swiss if 6 people in one quad.

Prizes: $60 1st each quad, 2nd in swiss(6 player Quads) $35 .
No byes permitted as this is a three round tournament. All participants are expected to complete all of their games. Spaces are limited.

Entry Fee: $35 ( $28 for members). You can register now and pay at the venue!

USCF Membership Required. Join at uschess.org

Norwalk , CT 06850

Irving Swiss

Texas Chess Center -- Irving Location

weekly on Sunday, starting from Sunday, January 26, 2025, forever

Event Overview

This is a 4-round tournament with a time control of G/30;d5. The event is held at the Texas Chess Center in Irving: 4343 W Royal Ln STE 114, Irving, TX 75063.
General expected schedule (subject to slight variation):

- Registration ends: 1:45pm

- Round 1 pairings posted: 2:00pm

- Opening announcements: 2:05pm

- Round 1 begins: 2:10pm

- Subsequent rounds: ASAP after the completion of the prior round

- Latest expected end-time of last game (most will end far earlier): 7:10pm

After Round 1, subsequent rounds are conducted on an ASAP basis, with midround transitions being employed as often as appropriate. All necessary equipment (clocks, boards, pieces, notation sheets, and pencils) will be supplied for you.

There are three sections, into which entrants are automatically placed (based on their latest Monthly US Chess rating):

- Championship

- U1000

- U600

Players whose Monthly ratings are within 150 points of the section cap may, for a $10 fee, request to play up one section. Approval of this request is subject to the organizers' discretion. Masters (NM+) enjoy free entry, with no deduction from any prizes won.

Prizes (all guaranteed):

- Championship: Cash prizes for 1st and 2nd
- 1st place receives 20% of total Championship section entry fees

- 2nd place receives 10% of total Championship section entry fees

- Minimum prizes are $50 for 1st, $25 for 2nd

- U1000: Trophies for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd

- U600: Medals for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd

Monday Month Long Swiss

weekly on Monday, starting from Monday, March 3, 2025, forever

Event Overview

Summary: USCF Rated Classical Chess at the Chicago Chess Center. One game, played every Monday. Allowed up to two half-point byes. You can also register for an individual week, if you can only play one game.
Location: 47 West Polk Street, Suite G9, Chicago, IL 60605
Sections:

- Open Section: 1600+

- U1600 Section: 1599-1000

- U1000 Section: 999-0

Format:

- Four rounds (one per week) of G/90, inc/30.

- Pairings will be designed to minimize rating difference between opponents ( Monrad Swiss )

Schedule: Every Monday (04/07 - 04/28), at 6:15 PM.
Registration:  Free, CCC and USCF membership required. You can also register for just one week, if desired.
Medals : All children who score higher than 50% will receive a medal!
Transportation: We are right next to the Harrison Red Line, Lasalle Blue Line, and Harold Washington Library Loop stop. Additionally, we are 1 mile from Union Station and 1.3 miles from Ogilvie.
Parking: Paid parking is available behind Dearborn Station, but there is also street parking, lots, and garages nearby.

Dragon Knight Chess Center

weekly on Sunday, starting from Sunday, March 9, 2025, forever

Event Overview

USCF Blitz Rated Tournament
Sundays at 10am
Time Control: G/3; +2. Each player receives 3 minutes plus a 2 second bonus increment per move to complete each game.
Dragon Knight Chess Center
2000 Bearcat Way
Suite 104
Morrisville, NC 27560

Free (no entry fee) Double Round Robin tournament played under USCF rules:
https://new.uschess.org/sites/default/files/media/documents/us-chess-rule-book-online-only-edition-chapters-1-2-9-10-11-2024.pdf
at Blitz Chess time controls (see pages 19-21 for time controls, and pages 141=144 for rules).
USCF membership is required, and the tournament is USCF Blitz Rated.
Free entry to all players!
Prizes: 100% of entry fees, but 100% of 0 is 0.
Round Times: 10am and ASAP thereafter. Arrive and start playing when ready.
Estimated end time: Noon-12:30pm
For questions, concerns, and withdrawals prior to the event email:  [email protected]
For contact during the event email (above) or text (or call) ( 919) 422-2535

Saturday Swiss

Chicago Chess Center

weekly on Saturday, starting from Saturday, March 15, 2025, forever

Event Overview

Tournaments run most Saturdays; double check our calendar .
Summary: USCF Rated Classical Chess at the Chicago Chess Center
Location: 47 West Polk, Chicago, IL 60657
Sections:
Open: 1600+, 1400+ can play up for $20.
U1600: 1599-1000, 800+ can play up for $20.
We recommend players under 1000 play in the Beginner's Open running on the same day.
Format:
Open: Three rounds; G/60, inc/30.
U1600: Four rounds; G/45, inc/15.
Schedule:
Open: Round 1 at 9:30 AM, Round 2 at 1:00 PM*, Round 3 at 4:30 PM* (* or 30 minutes after the last game ends, whichever is later).
U1600: Round 1 at 9:30 AM, Round 2 at 12:30 PM, Rounds 3-4 ASAP.
Registration: $25 online by 1 week before; $35 one day before; $40 after that.
Registration closes 15 minutes before the first round. Any players not registered before then will receive a round 1 bye.
Affordability: If you are unable to afford the entry fee, please contact us.
FIDE-titled players automatically receive free entry.
Prizes:
Open: Trophies and free entry in a future event for first, second, and U2000.
U1600: Trophies and free entry in a future event for first, second, and U1200.
All children who score higher than 50% will receive a medal!
Transportation: We are right next to the Harrison Red Line, Lasalle Blue Line, and Harold Washington Library Loop stop. Additionally, we are 1 mile from Union Station and 1.3 miles from Ogilvie.
Parking: Paid parking is available behind Dearborn Station, but there is also street parking, lots, and garages nearby.

Under 800 Wednesdays

Charlotte Chess Center (North)

weekly on Wednesday, starting from Wednesday, April 2, 2025, forever

Event Overview

OVERVIEW
Under 800 Wednesdays is a free, 1 round per week, US Chess rated tournament for K-8 children, held every Sunday at the CCC's North Charlotte location.

WHEN
Every Wednesday, 6:30 - 8:00pm

REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS

- Open to K-8 participants (ages 13 and under)

- Players must be rated under 800

- Unrated players who wish to establish a rating are welcome to play.

- Participants must be members of US Chess
- Need a US Chess Membership? Purchase through the  CCC and save !

- Participants must be members of the CCC .

- Limited to first 42 players to register.

- Online registration only.

- Registration closes 30 minutes prior to round 1 if not already full.

HOW IT WORKS

- Parents strongly encouraged to drop off.

- Students play one rated game per week.

- Each registration is only for the next round.

- The event is submitted for rating monthly on the final Wednesday of the month.

- Students may choose to get their game analyzed by a CCC coach.

SECTIONS
Under 800
Under 400/Unrated

TIME CONTROL
G/35, inc/10
Each player receives 35 minutes plus a 10 second increment to complete the game.

PRIZES
The top player in each section will receive a trophy!
See special notes below for tiebreak information.

This is a CCC Grand Prix  event!

ENTRY FEE
FREE, must be a  CCC Member ​ ​

CONTACT

- Click here to show mail address

- For contact during the event email (above) or call 980-265-1156

WITHDRAWAL
Use this link  to withdraw (cancel). Withdrawals close 30 minutes prior to each game.

Charlotte Chess Center U1000 Sundays

Charlotte Chess Center (Main/South)

weekly on Sunday, starting from Sunday, April 6, 2025, forever

Event Overview

OVERVIEW
Under 1000 Sundays is a free, 1 round per week, US Chess rated tournament for K-8 children, held every Sunday at the CCC's Main/South Charlotte location.

WHEN
Every Sunday, 10:30am - 12:00pm
​
REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS

- Open to K-8 participants (ages 13 and under)

- Players must be rated under 1000

- Unrated players who wish to establish a rating are welcome to play.

- Participants must be members of US Chess .
- US Chess is the governing body of chess in the US and conducts all of the rating calculations for players. Need a US Chess Membership? Purchase through the  CCC and save !

- Participants must be members of the CCC .

- Limited to first 30 players to register.

- Online registration only.

- Registration closes 30 minutes prior to round 1 if not already full.

HOW IT WORKS

- Students play one rated game per week.

- Each registration is only for the next round.

- The event is submitted for rating monthly on the final Sunday of the month.

- Students may choose to get their game analyzed by a CCC coach.

​ SECTIONS
Under 1000
Under 500/Unrated

TIME CONTROL
G/35, inc/10
Each player receives 35 minutes plus a 10 second increment to complete the game.

PRIZES
The top player in each section will receive a trophy!
This is a CCC Grand Prix  event!

ENTRY FEE
FREE, must be a  CCC Member ​ ​

The Charlotte Chess Center’s Main/South Location is conveniently located off of I-485 and Pineville-Matthews Road. CCC’s Main/South Branch serves South Charlotte, Ballantyne, Pineville, SouthPark, Matthews, Mint Hill, Waxhaw, Weddington, Steele Creek, Fort Mill, Tega Cay, Rock Hill, and Lake Wylie.

ChessPalace Wednesday Knights

ChessPalace

weekly on Wednesday, starting from Wednesday, June 18, 2025, forever

Event Overview

Wednesday Knights  is a month-long tournament with one US Chess-rated game every Wednesday.  The tournament is an excellent opportunity for players of all ages and skill levels to participate in weekly rated practice. With classical time controls, players can take their time to think more thoroughly about their moves and strengthen their calculation skills.
Details:

- Schedule : Rounds start weekly at 7 pm;

- Format: 1 round per week. Games are submitted for rating at the end of the month; 4 rounds/month (5 rounds in some months)

- Time Control:  30moves/90minutes + sudden death 30minutes, both time controls have 5-second delay starting move one

- Sections:  one open section

- Players must have an active US Chess membership. Player can also sign up or renew their US Chess membership onsite

- Players must know how to use the clock and record the moves with chess notation

Entry Fee:
$30 per month​ (Free for ChessPalace club members/$35 for first-time club players)
CLICK HERE TO REGISTER

For schedules of other regular  ChessPalace tournaments (i.e.  Scholastic  tournaments, Blitz Tournament, and Saturday Tournaments) and special events such as Grandmaster lectures and simul exhibitions, please check out our  calendar page or subscribe to the blog at https://www.chesspalace.com

Lowcountry Scholastic Grand Prix Quads

Chess for Everyone - Summerville Academy

monthly, starting from Sunday, June 29, 2025, 12 times

Event Overview

📆 June Edition : Sunday, June 29 at 10 AM
(expected to conclude by 2 PM)
📆 Dates of the following tournaments of the Grand Prix Series: July 27, Aug 31, Sep 28, Oct 26, Nov 30, Dec 21, Jan 25, Feb 22, Mar 29, Apr 26, May            31(Subject to change)
📍 Location : Chess for Everyone - Summerville Academy
901 Old Trolley Rd, Summerville, SC

About the Series:
The Lowcountry Scholastic Grand Prix 2025-2026 is a series of 12 monthly tournaments running from June 2025 to May 2026.
🏆Year-End Awards will be given to the top 3 players with highest cumulative points across the series,
🏆 Special prize for the highest USCF rating gain over the series!
All participants are eligible for year-end awards, no matter how many events they play.

Format: Quads Tournament - Players are grouped in quads, based on their rating. Each player plays 3 round-robin games - one against each opponent in their group. This format ensures all players face opponents closest to their own rating, making it one of the most balanced and competitive formats.
⏳Time Control: 25 minutes with 5 seconds increment.
Sections : Rated and Unrated.
Entry Fee : $20
Prizes : Winner of each quad gets a trophy.
A great challenge and brain workout for students of all levels!

Dragon Knight CC Saturday Afternoon Scholastic Quads (Morrisville)

Dragon Knight Chess Center

weekly on Saturday, starting from Saturday, August 16, 2025, forever

Event Overview

UPDATE: There will be no tournament on Saturday, Jan. 31, due to inclement weather. Tournaments resume Saturday, Feb. 7.

Each Saturday at 1:30pm
A 3-6 round "quad" US Chess rated tournament open to all scholastic (K-12) players. Quads group players by their skill level. This is a chance to play 3-6 rated (regular and quick) games each Saturday afternoon!
Dragon Knight Chess Center
2000 Bearcat Way
Suite 104
Morrisville, NC 27560
(919) 422-2535
3-6 round (Single or Double) Quad Round Robin sections
First place trophy in each 4 player section. Team trophy to top school overall. Other prizes will also be awarded.
Registration and Entry Fee:
$19 online mid-day before the event (Noon Friday), or
$29 onsite registration 12:30-1pm day of tournament.
Players currently rated 1200+: Free Entry
Free Entry Policy:
Free entry is offered to scholastic (K-12) players who have a current "live Over The Board (OTB)" US Chess rating of 1200+. No exceptions.
To get free entry, players must register online mid-day before the event (Noon Friday).
If you register for free but must cancel, email [email protected]
or text (919) 422-2535 by 12:30pm (one hour before Round 1 of the quad).
Players receiving free entry are not permitted to withdraw mid-quad, without permission from all other players in their quad. Free entry players who withdraw mid-quad (without permission) will not be eligible for free entry in future Dragon Knight Chess quads.
US Chess membership required; Dragon Knight Chess will use vouchers to create new scholastic memberships. US Chess is the governing body of chess in the United States. US Chess conducts all rating calculations for players.
Time Control:
Above USCF 800 sections G/40; delay 5 (3 games):  Each player receives 40 minutes (plus a 5 second delay each move) to complete each game.
USCF U800 sections G/25; delay 5 (3-6 games):  Each player receives 25 minutes (plus a 5 second delay each move) to complete each game.
Onsite registration 12:30-1pm day of tournament.
Round Times:
1st Round 1:30pm;
Round 2: ASAP;
Round 3: ASAP
End Time: Between 3-4pm, depending on quad.
How it Works:
Players must register weekly.
Quads: Players are placed into groups of 4 by their most recent "live" US Chess rating. (Minor section shifts are possible, to avoid family member pairings.)
3-6 rated games each Saturday afternoon
Each Saturday afternoon is limited to the first 50 players to register.
Entries are first registered, first served.
Quads are for K-12 students only.
IMPROVE - Game analysis and blitz with Dragon Knight Chess coaches IM Jonathan Schroer and Paul Ascolese (peak FIDE rating 2275)
SIDE EVENTS - Free USCF rated blitz tournaments start as early as 1:30pm.
For questions, concerns, and withdrawals prior to the event email:  [email protected]
For contact during the event email (above) or text (or call) ( 919) 422-2535
Handicap Accessible

NO Residency Restriction: Open to all scholastic players!
Live OTB event

Tournaments: https://www.dragonknightchess.com/tournaments/
Registration: https://form.jotform.com/243304917823154
Payments: https://checkout.square.site/merchant/MLE095F2MVX1C/checkout/RTEAXW7Q72ZRAX6SEW35TUBQ

Charlotte ChessQ Thursday Action USCF Online

Lichess

weekly on Thursday, starting from Thursday, September 4, 2025, forever

Event Overview

Every Thursday online at 6.30 pm EST.
Highlights:  USCF Rated Online Tournament
(Online Quick Ratings will be updated.)
Prizes: Top 3 winners gets Free entry to Next Thursday Event.
How it works & Details:
All participants must be active members of the US Chess Federation.
Register here: https://chessqueenclub.org/chess-events/

After registering, you will get email instructions from ChessQueen Club to join the Lichess Team and how to join tournament.
On approval, you will get link and email to join tournament section with passcode.
Those who already in the team, can just click tournament Join button in Lichess, joining Team.
Time Control: 10 minutes with a 5-second increment .
There will be four rounds in total, event handling is controlled by Lichess Program Engines from start to finish.
Game starts at ( Eastern Time ): 6.30 pm
PreRegistered list is displayed inside Lichess – Tournament screen,  visible once you login the Tournament.
As we use Lichess for this Online tournament, so all players need to have an account in Lichess.

For fair play conduct, we need all players to join our Zoom meeting and keep webcam on, so players can see online presence during game. Zoom details will be given to you in email.
Ratings of players are determined by USCF-regular ratings.

Dragon Knight CC Saturday Morning Scholastic Quads (Morrisville)

Dragon Knight Chess Center

weekly on Saturday, starting from Saturday, October 11, 2025, forever

Event Overview

Each Saturday at 10am
A 3-6 round "quad" US Chess rated tournament open to all scholastic (K-12) players. Quads group players by their skill level. This is a chance to play 3-6 rated (regular and quick) games each Saturday morning!
Dragon Knight Chess Center
2000 Bearcat Way
Suite 104
Morrisville, NC 27560
(919) 422-2535
3-6 round (Single or Double) Quad Round Robin sections
First place trophy in each 4 player section. Team trophy to top school overall. Other prizes will also be awarded.
Registration and Entry Fee:
$19 online mid-day before the event (Noon Friday), or
$29 onsite registration 9-9:30am day of tournament.
Players currently rated 1200+: Free Entry
Free Entry Policy:
Free entry is offered to scholastic (K-12) players who have a current "live Over The Board (OTB)" US Chess rating of 1200+. No exceptions.
To get free entry, players must register online mid-day before the event (Noon Friday).
If you register for free but must cancel, email [email protected]
or text (919) 422-2535 by 9am (one hour before Round 1 of the quad).
Players receiving free entry are not permitted to withdraw mid-quad, without permission from all other players in their quad. Free entry players who withdraw mid-quad (without permission) will not be eligible for free entry in future Dragon Knight Chess quads.
US Chess membership required; Dragon Knight Chess will use vouchers to create new scholastic memberships. US Chess is the governing body of chess in the United States. US Chess conducts all rating calculations for players.
Time Control:
Above USCF 800 sections G/40; delay 5 (3 games):  Each player receives 40 minutes (plus a 5 second delay each move) to complete each game.
USCF U800 sections G/25; delay 5 (3-6 games):  Each player receives 25 minutes (plus a 5 second delay each move) to complete each game.
Onsite registration 9-9:30am day of tournament.
Round Times:
1st Round 10am;
Round 2: ASAP;
Round 3: ASAP
End Time: Between Noon-1pm, depending on quad.
How it Works:
Players must register weekly.
Quads: Players are placed into groups of 4 by their most recent "live" US Chess rating. (Minor section shifts are possible, to avoid family member pairings.)
3-6 rated games each Saturday morning
Each Saturday morning is limited to the first 50 players to register.
Entries are first registered, first served.
Quads are for K-12 students only.
IMPROVE - Game analysis and blitz with Dragon Knight Chess coaches IM Jonathan Schroer and Paul Ascolese (peak FIDE rating 2275)
SIDE EVENTS - Free USCF rated blitz tournaments start as early as 10am.
For questions, concerns, and withdrawals prior to the event email:  [email protected]
For contact during the event email (above) or text (or call) ( 919) 422-2535
Handicap Accessible

NO Residency Restriction: Open to all scholastic players!
Live OTB event

Tournaments: https://www.dragonknightchess.com/tournaments/
Registration: https://form.jotform.com/243304917823154
Payments: https://checkout.square.site/merchant/MLE095F2MVX1C/checkout/RTEAXW7Q72ZRAX6SEW35TUBQ

Address: 2000 Bearcat Way

Suite 104

Morrisville , NC 27560

United States

Sections:
Grand Prix Points:
Prize Fund: Trophies
FIDE Rated: No
Handicap Accessible: Yes
Residency Restriction: No
Online Event: No

Organizer Overview

Dragon Knight Chess

Phone: (919) 422-2535

Dragon Knight Chess Center

weekly on Saturday, starting from Saturday, October 11, 2025, forever

Event Overview

Each Saturday afternoon at 1:30pm
A 3-6 round "quad" US Chess rated tournament open to all scholastic (K-12) players. Quads group players by their skill level. This is a chance to play 3-6 rated (regular and quick) games each Saturday afternoon, with free pizza included!
Dragon Knight Chess Center
2000 Bearcat Way
Suite 104
Morrisville, NC 27560
(919) 422-2535
3-6 round (Single or Double) Quad Round Robin sections
First place trophy in each 4 player section. Team trophy to top school overall. Other prizes will also be awarded.
Registration and Entry Fee:
$19 online mid-day before the event (Noon Friday), or
$29 onsite registration 12:30-1pm day of tournament.
Players currently rated 1200+: Free Entry
Free Entry Policy:
Free entry is offered to scholastic (K-12) players who have a current "live Over The Board (OTB)" US Chess rating of 1200+. No exceptions.
To get free entry, players must register online mid-day before the event (Noon Friday).
If you register for free but must cancel, email [email protected]
or text (919) 422-2535 by 12:30pm (one hour before Round 1 of the quad).
Players receiving free entry are not permitted to withdraw mid-quad, without permission from all other players in their quad. Free entry players who withdraw mid-quad (without permission) will not be eligible for free entry in future Dragon Knight Chess quads.
US Chess membership required; Dragon Knight Chess will use vouchers to create new scholastic memberships. US Chess is the governing body of chess in the United States. US Chess conducts all rating calculations for players.
Time Control:
Above USCF 800 sections G/40; delay 5 (3 games):  Each player receives 40 minutes (plus a 5 second delay each move) to complete each game.
USCF U800 sections G/25; delay 5 (3-6 games):  Each player receives 25 minutes (plus a 5 second delay each move) to complete each game.
Onsite registration 12:30-1pm day of tournament.
Round Times:
1st Round 1:30pm;
Round 2: ASAP;
Round 3: ASAP
End Time: Between 3-4pm, depending on quad.
How it Works:
Players must register weekly.
Quads: Players are placed into groups of 4 by their most recent "live" US Chess rating. (Minor section shifts are possible, to avoid family member pairings.)
3-6 rated games each Saturday afternoon
Each Saturday afternoon is limited to the first 50 players to register.
Entries are first registered, first served.
Quads are for K-12 students only.
IMPROVE - Game analysis and blitz with Dragon Knight Chess coaches IM Jonathan Schroer and Paul Ascolese (peak FIDE rating 2275)
SIDE EVENTS - Free USCF rated blitz tournaments start as early as 1:30pm.
For questions, concerns, and withdrawals prior to the event email:  [email protected]
For contact during the event email (above) or text (or call) ( 919) 422-2535

FOUR SEASON SHOPPING CENTER, CHESTERFIELD

weekly on Monday, starting from Monday, October 13, 2025, forever

Event Overview

SPACE IS LIMITED TO MAX OF 60 PLAYERS.
Eligibility : Open to Everyone (no age restrictions)
Time: 6PM to 9PM
Time control: G/25; d5 (3Rounds; USCF dual-rated)
Sections: The tournament has 3 sections based on monthly published USCF rating:

- Championship Section: USCF rating >=1000 USCF

- Reserve section: USCF 600-999 USCF.

- Beginner section: USCF Under 600 USCF.

TD reserves the right to revise section breaks or provide wild cards. Byes are allowed in any round as long as you let us know by at least 1 round in advance.
Entry fees: $8 per tournament. We accept online payment or credit card on-site. No Cash Transactions.
Registration LINK : Chess Tournament Home (www.tournamentsignup.com)
Prize: Trophies (each section). TIE BREAKERS: Ties will be broken using Modified Median, Solkoff, Cumulative, and Cumulative Opp. for individual trophies
Mandatory requirement: Please bring a valid USCF membership ID number for registration. Additional details at http://chesscardinals.com on how to apply online for USCF membership. Our team can help you get a membership on-site too. New Female Chess Players can get up to 50% discount on their membership.
Directions:

- Parking: Recommended in front of the UPS STORE or SEOUL TACO.

- Entrance: Ground floor through main big glass doors.

- SIGNS: Look for the Chess Cardinals banner.

- Restrooms: Ground floor near emergency EXIT. Separate for MEN/WOMEN. You would need keys. Please RESTROOM KEYS sign on the wall to locate these keys.

Photo/video Consent Agreement .  By registering to the Chess Cardinals tournaments, participants, caregivers & parents grant full permission to Chess Cardinals to use photographs, video- and/or audio-recordings of them, and/or their children, taken during Chess Cardinals events in publications, news releases, online, and in other communications related to the mission of Chess Cardinals. To ensure the privacy of individuals and children, images will not be identified using personal identifying information without written approval from the photographed subject, parent or legal guardian. A person attending Chess Cardinals event who does not wish to have their image recorded for distribution should make their wishes known to the organizer in writing of his/her intentions and include a photograph. Chess Cardinals will use the photo for identification purposes and will hold it in confidence. No registrants and/or participants are entitled to compensation for their appearance in such materials. By registering, you also grant Chess Cardinals and US Chess Federation the right to lawfully use the photos on its website, social media sites, e-newsletters, and other public media which such use shall be considered commercial use for promotion and advertising.  You also release Chess Cardinals and US Chess Federation from any claims related to the use of the photos, recordings, or interviews, including claims of libel or invasion of privacy. You understand that Chess Cardinals retains ownership of the materials and may use them now or in the future for the purposes mentioned above. All registrants and participants release and discharge Chess Cardinals from all liability, losses, and damages for libel, slander, invasion of privacy or any other claim arising out of or relating to the use of videotapes, recordings and/or photograph.

CHESS CARDINALS THURSDAY GRAND PRIX TOURNAMENT

Four Seasons Shopping Center, Chesterfield

weekly on Thursday, starting from Thursday, October 16, 2025, forever

Event Overview

“Chess Cardinals” is a nonprofit 501c3 approved USCF Affiliate and is hosting USCF-rated SWISS format OPEN chess games at Four Seasons Shopping Center, Missouri, every Thursday between 6:00-8:45 pm (on-site registration between 5:30-5: 55 pm). Adults, kids and all levels of players are welcome. SPACE IS LIMITED TO THE FIRST 60 REGISTRANTS. PLEASE REGISTER BEFORE 5:45 PM. NO LATE REGISTRATION IS ALLOWED.
Time control: G/25; d5 (3 Rounds; USCF dual-rated)
Sections:  The tournament has four sections:

- Advanced Section: USCF rating >=1400 USCF

- Championship Section:  USCF rating 1000-1399 USCF

- Reserve section:  USCF 600-999 USCF.

- Beginner section:  USCF Under 600 USCF.

TD reserves the right to revise section breaks or provide wild cards. Byes are allowed in any round as long as you let us know by at least 1 round in advance.
Entry fees:  $5 per tournament. We accept online payment or credit card on-site. No Cash Transactions. Online registration is highly preferred. WWW.TOURNAMENTSIGNUP.COM . Please enter your complete name and USCF ID when you register. PLEASE REGISTER BEFORE 5:45 PM. NO LATE REGISTRATION IS ALLOWED.
Mandatory requirement:  Please bring a valid USCF membership ID number for registration. Additional details at  http://chesscardinals.com  on how to apply online for USCF membership. Our team can help you get a membership on-site too.
Optional requirement:  Notation is optional. Notation books are available for purchase on-site.
Grand Prix Prizes:  Based on all the “Thursday tournaments” in a month, we will tally up points and give trophies to reward improvement in chess skill and encourage participation. For each night’s attendance, you get 3 points for showing up, and for each Win 1 point, each Draw or 1/2-Byes 0.5 point (we will use the USCF cross-table for the event). Regardless of which sections you played, prizes include Top Prize 1st (Champions Trophy). Additional prizes may be awarded depending on the available funds.
Past Tournaments:  US Chess MSA - Affiliate Details   (Tournament History)
Mandatory requirement: Please bring a valid USCF membership ID number for registration. Additional details at http://chesscardinals.com on how to apply online for USCF membership. Our team can help you get a membership on-site too. New Female Chess Players can get up to 50% discount on their membership.
Directions:

- Parking: Recommended in front of the UPS STORE or SEOUL TACO.

- Entrance: Ground floor through main big glass doors.

- SIGNS: Look for the Chess Cardinals banner.

- Restrooms: Ground floor near emergency EXIT. Separate for MEN/WOMEN. You would need keys. Please RESTROOM KEYS sign on the wall to locate these keys.

Photo/video Consent Agreement .  By registering to the Chess Cardinals tournaments, participants, caregivers & parents grant full permission to Chess Cardinals to use photographs, video- and/or audio-recordings of them, and/or their children, taken during Chess Cardinals events in publications, news releases, online, and in other communications related to the mission of Chess Cardinals. To ensure the privacy of individuals and children, images will not be identified using personal identifying information without written approval from the photographed subject, parent or legal guardian. A person attending Chess Cardinals event who does not wish to have their image recorded for distribution should make their wishes known to the organizer in writing of his/her intentions and include a photograph. Chess Cardinals will use the photo for identification purposes and will hold it in confidence. No registrants and/or participants are entitled to compensation for their appearance in such materials. By registering, you also grant Chess Cardinals and US Chess Federation the right to lawfully use the photos on its website, social media sites, e-newsletters, and other public media which such use shall be considered commercial use for promotion and advertising.  You also release Chess Cardinals and US Chess Federation from any claims related to the use of the photos, recordings, or interviews, including claims of libel or invasion of privacy. You understand that Chess Cardinals retains ownership of the materials and may use them now or in the future for the purposes mentioned above. All registrants and participants release and discharge Chess Cardinals from all liability, losses, and damages for libel, slander, invasion of privacy or any other claim arising out of or relating to the use of videotapes, recordings and/or photograph.

The Santa Paula Oddfellows Lodge # 314

weekly on Wednesday, starting from Wednesday, October 29, 2025, forever

Event Overview

THE CHESS RUN WEDNESDAYS is a month-long tournament with one US Chess-rated game every Wednesday.  The tournament is an excellent opportunity for players of all ages and skill levels to participate in weekly rated practice. With classical time controls, players can take their time to think more thoroughly about their moves and strengthen their calculation skills.
Details:

- Schedule :  Doors open at 630pm - Rounds start weekly at 7 pm; casual speed games after tournament games is common.

- Format: 1 round per week. Games are submitted for rating at the end of the month; 4 rounds/month (5 rounds in some months)

- Time Control: G60/d5

- Sections:  one open section

- Players must have an active US Chess membership. Player can also sign up or renew their US Chess membership onsite

- Players must know how to use the clock and record the moves with chess notation

- Chess Boards, Chess Clocks & score sheets provided

Casual play is available, official speed tournaments held bi-monthly.

First Saturday Online Grand Prix

Lichess

monthly on Saturday, but only the first instance of this set, starting from Saturday, November 1, 2025, 7 times

Event Overview

FIRST SATURDAY ONLINE GRAND PRIX
Join our monthly online tournament series - designed for all K-12 chess players who love to compete, learn and grow!
Overview
The First Saturday Online Grand Prix is a seven-tournament scholastic series open to all K-12 students nationwide.
Each monthly event offers its own prize and also counts toward the overall Grand Prix leaderboard. Players may join any number of tournaments.
Schedule

- Platform : lichess.org

- Time control : G/15; +5 seconds increment

- Start Time : 10 AM EST

- Format : 4 rounds Swiss

- Dates : November 1, 2025; December 6, 2025; January 3, 2026; February 7, 2026; March 7, 2026; April 4, 2026; May 2 2026.

- Entry fee : $20

Prizes

- 1st place winner of each tournament: One free private online lesson with WFM Bahar Hallayeva (An exclusive opportunity to learn directly from a titled chess master!)

Grand Prix Points and Series Awards

Players earn Grand Prix points in each tournament. Cumulative points across all seven events determine the Overall Grand Prix Winners:

- 1st place: Trophy + 3 months of Chess for Everyone weekly online classes ($300 value)

- 2nd place: Trophy + 2 months of Chess for Everyone weekly online classes ($200 value)

- 3rd place: Trophy + 1 month of Chess for Everyone weekly online classes ($100 value)

Eligibility

- Open to all K-12 students

- Players may join any number of tournaments to qualify for Grand Prix prizes

- This tournament will be USCF online quick rated. An active USCF membership is required. You can join the USCF or renew an expired USCF membership at this link:   http://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess . You can choose 1 or 2 years plan.

- Before signing up for the tournament, please register for a free  https://lichess.org  account. Please provide your lichess username in the "Lichess username" field when you complete the registration form.

Fair Play Policy

- Games are played on lichess.org

- No outside assistance or chess engines allowed

- Violations may lead to disqualification

After you register, you will receive an email from us with instructions on how to join the tournament online. If you don't receive the email, please check your spam folder or contact us at [email protected] .
If you have questions please contact us at [email protected]

Thinking Thursdays

The Cork and Board

weekly on Thursday, starting from Thursday, November 20, 2025, forever

Event Overview

When:  Meets most Thursdays at 6:30PM
Where:  The Cork and Board, Jefferson City's premiere board game pub!
Cost: Free!  Donations accepted but not expected!
USCF Tournament Director(s): Joshua Wood
USCF Membership Required: Sold Onsite*
Equipment: Several sets, boards, and chess clocks provided; players are encouraged to bring their own!
Registration: Onsite at 6:15PM. Round 1 Begins at 6:30PM (or as close as possible)
Prizes: Bragging rights!

We play for the love of chess!

Join us most Thursday nights for blitz chess!  Graciously hosted by The Cork and Board, stop by for an ice cold beer or a crisp cocktail, some delicious entrees, and some rated chess! The default is rated G/10;d0, though if the participants want to play something else, they make it known!  (Including Hand & Brain, Bughouse, and G/0:01;d5, among other terrible influences!)  Please note, while very family friendly, there is alcohol served at this establishment.  The chess is played in a relaxed atmosphere - arriving late and leaving early are ok.
*If you don't have a USCF membership, it can be purchased on site (or I can walk you through doing it yourself as well).  While required to play rated chess, effort is made if not a member to provide opponents, but preference is given to the tournament players.  When playing anything not rated (e.g. Hand & Brain, Bughouse, etc), a membership is obviously not required!
Check out The Board Fools Chess Club on Facebook for details regarding individual dates!

Tuesday Knighter OPEN

Chess Castle of Minnesota

weekly on Tuesday, starting from Tuesday, December 2, 2025, forever

Event Overview

Tuesday Knighter OPEN (up to $160 in sponsored prizes!)
Rounds every Tuesday.  For best rate, sign up by end-of-day Sunday before round 1.
Format: 4-5 Rd SS, (G/60; +30). New event each month, 1st round 1st Tuesday, last round last Tuesday.
Round Times: 6:30 PM each Tuesday, check-in by 6:20 or you may not get paired.
Entry Fee: If 2-days early, $25 for CCM members , $35 for non-members, (NE discount $5, NM discount $10).  After that, EF is $5 more online until site opens, $10 more at site.  It's good for whole month.  1-day rate is $10 for CCM members , $15 for non-members.
Onsite: Club opens at 6:00 PM. Registration and check-in ends at 6:20PM. Online registration: SIGN UP CLICK HERE!
Prizes: $120-40 (b/12pd) 1st-2nd sponsored prizes! Top Cumulative Upsets get FREE entry next month.
Byes: One bye if 4 rounds, two byes if 5 rounds.  Request by round 3.  One-day entry not applicable.
Other: USCF membership is required . Most games done by 9:00 PM. Games may be broadcast. Spectators welcomed.  Play TUE & THU and save $10, scroll down to Week-Knighter Special for more info.
Questions: Contact TD Nathan Hoover at Click here to show mail address or 763-232-9944.

TUESDAY CHESS NIGHT (3ss, 25+5) by Indy Chess

Latvian Community Center

weekly on Tuesday, starting from Tuesday, January 6, 2026, forever

Event Overview

All are welcome to join us for Indy's largest weekly chess night at the Latvian Community Center!
Register ahead of time at indychess.org/events!
There are three areas in which you can play chess:

1) USCF-RATED TOURNAMENT ROOM
There's a 3-round, Swiss system, G/25+5 USCF-rated tournament (typically two or three sections determined by rating) in a separate room from about 6:30pm to 9:30pm.
Arrive by 6:15pm if you want to be paired in round one (if you are a regular and you pre-register online, just text Mike if you can't arrive by 6:15pm so we know to pair you and start the clock).
Games affect both USCF regular and quick ratings.
Must be a member of USCF to play rated chess (new.uschess.org/join-us-chess).  Make sure to provide your USCF ID# to [email protected] prior to the event, or arrive by 6:15pm to be paired in round one.
First visit = free (but arrive by 6:15p)! Other visits are $5 members/$10 non-members (club membership is $50/yr).

2) KIDS' WORKSHOP AND QUADS
There will be a kids' game review workshop from 6:30-7:00, followed by kids casual play from 7:00-8:00pm.
Kids can earn medals, and eventually cash in medals for trophies.
Kids typically play in "quads" after the lesson, meaning we place them in groups of four according to their level and they play each kid in the quad one time!  First Tuesday of each month we play "Bughouse" (two-on-two chess).
Participation in the kids' area costs $5 (members) / $10 (non-members), but the first visit is free (just show up).
Pay at the door by 6:30p, or save time and register in advance at indychess.org/events.
Parents are requested to stay the first visit, but future visits can leave and return by 7:50pm.

3) ADULT CASUAL
Adult casual play (13+ years old) will also be available 6:30-9:30pm, so come make some friends and meet new opponents.
Adults pair themselves for pick-up games.
Sets and clocks are provided (you can bring your own as well), and any time control is allowed as you desire.
Adult Casual section is always free; just show up and play pick-up games!

The rooms are wheelchair accessible.
All chess equipment is provided (though feel free to bring your own).
There is a cash-only drinks vending machine, but many players bring a water bottle as the water fountain is broken.
Register for chess night at indychess.org/events!

Questions?  Email Mike at [email protected] .  Hope to see you there!

2026 ICEA Chess @ West LA

Nolte Community Center

monthly on Saturday, but only the second instance of this set, starting from Saturday, January 10, 2026, forever

Event Overview

ICEA Chess @ West LA hosts a Monthly OTB Chess Tournament on the second Saturday of each month. It typically features four sections (U1000, 1000+, 1600+ and 2000+) to accommodate different skill levels based on the monthly supplement USCF ratings.
The tournament is a one-day event with four rounds for the 1000+ / 1600+ / 2000+ sections, running from 9 AM to 6 PM, with a time control of G/45;+5 (45 minutes for each player, plus a 5-second increment per move).
The U1000 section is designed for players with ratings below 1000, making it an excellent starting point for new players who haven't established a USCF rating yet. This section has three double rounds from 9 AM to 4 PM, meaning players will play two games against the same opponent each round.
Schedule:
The Second Saturday Of Each Month

Format/Time Control:
Regular Month

- 1800+ Section: 4 Round SS, G/45;+5

- 1000+ Section: 4 Round SS, G/45;+5

- U1000 Section: 3 Double Rounds SS, G/30;+5

Super Month (April, October)

- 2000+ Section: 4 Round SS, G/90;+20 (Cross Two Saturdays)

- 1600+ Section: 4 Round SS, G/45;+5

- 1000+ Section: 4 Round SS, G/45;+5

- U1000 Section: 3 Double Rounds SS, G/30;+5

Unity Weekly Blitz

Unity Chess, Chandler

weekly on Sunday, starting from Sunday, January 11, 2026, forever

Event Overview

Get ready for high-energy chess at our Unity Weekly Blitz Tournament , where quick thinking and sharp instincts matter most. This USCF-rated event features six single round of nonstop action, with a time control of G/3 +2 , ensuring every game is intense from the first move to the last.
Open to players of all skill levels , the tournament offers a competitive yet welcoming environment—perfect for seasoned blitz specialists and players looking to sharpen their speed-chess skills. All USCF rules apply , and a current USCF membership is required . Half-point byes (maximum of two) are available upon request and must be submitted before the end of Round 1.
Whether you’re chasing rating points, testing new ideas, or simply enjoying fast-paced chess with fellow enthusiasts, our weekly blitz promises exciting games, great competition, and a lively chess atmosphere. Join us each week and bring your best blitz game to the board!
🔷 Time: 6-7:30 pm
🔷 USCF Rated
🔷 Time Control: G/3;+2
🔷 6 Single Round
🔷 Entry Fee: $25 (1 unit)
🎁 Prizes:
💠 Open:
🥇1st: Chess Trophy
🥈2nd: Chess Trophy
🥈3rd: Chess Trophy
💠 U1400:
🥇1st: Chess Trophy
🥈2nd: Chess Trophy
🥈3rd: Chess Trophy
Players can register for these tournaments through  King Registration  website.
For more information, please visit:  www.UnityChess.com
We look forward to seeing you at the next tournament and wish you the best of luck.
