94th Massachusetts Open

Heritage Event, Grand Prix, Enhanced Grand Prix, Junior Grand Prix, State Championship Event

Best Western Royal Plaza Hotel

Saturday, May 23, 2026
- Monday, May 25, 2026

Event Overview

A Heritage Event!
US Chess Junior Grand Prix!
A State Championship Event!

MAY 23-25 OR 24-25, MASSACHUSETTS

US CHESS GRAND PRIX POINTS: 50 (ENHANCED)

94th Massachusetts Open

6SS, 40/120, SD/30, d10 (2-day schedule, G/40, d10 in rounds 1-3).  No 2-day schedule in Championship section.  Best Western Royal Plaza Hotel, 181 Boston Post Rd, Marlborough MA 01752. 866-994-1371.  $$7,500  guaranteed .  5 sections.  Championship :  $1,000-500, top U2300 $500.  FIDE.  3-day schedule only. State championship title to high scoring Mass. resident or student.  Under 2100 : $800-400, top U1900 $400.  Under 1800 : $800-400, top U1600 $400.  Under 1500 : $700-350, top U1300 $350.  Under 1200:  $400-250, top U1000 $250.  May play up by a maximum of 200 rating points.     Unrated can play in Under 2100 or below, with these prize limits: $400 in U2100, $300 in U1800, $200 in U1500, $100 in U1200.   EF : $90 for 3-day, $89 for 2-day if mailed by 5/18 or online by 5/20, $110 online by 5/21 or at site.  GMs and IMs free.  $30 discount to players in U1200 sect.  3-day Schedule : Reg. Sat. 8:30 to 9:30 a.m., Rds. Sat. 10:30 & 5, Sun. 10:30 & 5, Mon. 10 & 4.  2-day Schedule  (U2100 to U1200 only): Reg. Sun. 8:30 to 9:30 a.m., Rds. Sun. 10:30, 1, 3 & 5, Mon. 10 & 4.  Schedules merge in round 4.  Byes : 1-5 in Championship sect., 1-6 in others, limit 2, must commit before rd. 3.  Massachusetts Open Scholastic , Saturday 5/23 only. 4SS, G/30; d5. 1st round at 11:00 a.m., others ASAP. 2 sections:  Under 600  and  Under 300.  Trophies to top three in each section. Medals to players scoring three or more points and not winning a trophy. EF: $30 if mailed by 5/18 or online by 5/21, $35 at site. No half point byes.  Massachusetts Blitz Championship : Sun. 5/24, 5SS (dbl), G/5 d0.  Blitz rated but higher of blitz and regular ratings used for pairings and prizes.  EF $10 if playing in main tnmt., else $15.  75% of EFs returned as prizes.  Reg. ends 9:15 p.m., 1st rd. at 9:30 p.m., others ASAP.  Bye allowed 1st rd.  All : MACA membership required for Mass. residents ($12 adult, $6 jr. U18).  Ent : payable to MACA and mail to Robert Messenger, 4 Hamlett Dr. Apt. 12, Nashua NH 03062, or enter online (PayPal) at  www.MassChess.org.  Info : send email to  Click here to show mail address  or call 603-891-2484.  Day of the tournament call 603-557-1732. W.

Marlborough , MA 01752

United States

Baltimore County Chess Tournament 5/23/26

Jewish Community Center of Greater Baltimore

Saturday, May 23, 2026

Event Overview

Register at  chessacademy.com/tournaments !
This tournament is for scholastic players in grades K-12 with and without prior tournament experience.  We recommend that players in their first tournament choose the Unrated option, where they will be grouped by age and play 3 or 4 games.
Players who've previously done well in an Unrated section or have previous rated tournament experience should choose the Rated option, where they'll be placed in a group of 4 players according to their age and rating.  Each participant then plays one game against each of the other three players in their group. At the end of the third game, the winner of each group receives a trophy.
This event should typically finish in 1-2 hours, but can potentially take as long as 3 hours for the most advanced players (although that is rare).
Everyone will use a clock!  We'll go over how to use clocks on-site, and you can watch this short video to see how they work. Unrated section players will play a game in 10 minutes with a 5 second delay, and Rated games are 25 minutes with a 5 second delay for each player.
Players can play in the morning at 10am, the afternoon at 1pm, or both!

- All sections are non-elimination, and all players participate in all rounds

- If you're playing in the Rated sections and have a US Chess ID# and membership, please include it.  If you don't have one, we will purchase it for you ($24 value!).  If you're not sure what your ID# is you can look it up  here

- Please arrive 15 minutes before games start.  Players who arrive after that may not be placed in quads.

- Prices increase by $10 at noon the Tuesday before the tournament.

Questions?  Please let us know at  Click here to show mail address !

Speedy Quads 67

J. Gilligan's Bar and Grill

Monday, May 25, 2026

Event Overview

Speedy - because the time control is G/5;d0 (each player gets 5 minutes to make all their moves.)
Quads - because we divide the players in groups of four based on ratings or skill level.
Players play two games against each of the three other players in their quad.
We hold a Speedy Quads tournament every fourth Monday each month. Speedy Quads has a FREE entry (but we do accept donations to cover the rating fees). There are no prizes. The games are blitz-rated and do not affect regular or quick ratings.
Time Control is G/5;d0; and we play double-round quads.
Register on site only - please arrive before 7:30pm. US Chess members will play rated quads. Non-members will play in an unrated small Swiss blitz tournament.

- Sunday, May 31, 2026

Event Overview

May 29-31 OR 30-31, FLORIDA
US Chess Grand Prix Points: 50 (Enhanced)

13th Annual Summer Solstice Open , 5SS , Top 2 sections FIDE rated , All sections but U1150 G/90+30 sec. incr., U1150 section G/90;d5 (1st two rounds, 2-day schedule, only, all sections, G/60;d5). Fort Lauderdale Marriott North, 6650 N. Andrews Avenue, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33309.

Prizes:  $$10,600 b/170 paid entries, 70% min. Gtd.  Premier:  $1200/Trophy-700-500, U2300 $400-200.  U2050:  $1100/Trophy-600-500, U1900 $300-100.  U1800:  $1000/Trophy-600-500, U1650 $300-100.  U1400:  $900/Trophy-500-400, U1250/Unr. $200-100.  U1150:  Trophies for 1st to 3rd, 1st U900, 1st U700/Unr., Medals to all others.  Top Senior Prize  each cash prize section (must be at least 60 on May 29) $100.

Online entry closes at 5:00 p.m. on May 29. Unr. may enter U1400 or U1150 only. Unr. only eligible for Unr. prizes. Min. USCF or FIDE rating of 1850 required for premier section. Re-entry cash prize sections $65. Reg.: Ends 1/2 hr before 1st rd. $10 service charge for refunds. Up to 2 half-point byes if req’d before rd. 2. 2026 VIRGINIA SENIOR & ADULTS OPEN

State Championship Event

Country Inn & Suites by Radisson

Friday, May 29, 2026
- Sunday, May 31, 2026

Event Overview

2026 Virginia Senior & Adults Open
AND ADULTS-ONLY BLITZ!!
at the Country Inn & Suites by Radisson
10358 Patriot Hwy, Fredericksburg, VA
Friday - Sunday, May 29 – 31, 2026
Organized by the Virginia Chess Federation
WHAT : The 2026 Virginia Senior and Adults Open Chess Championship, with Saturday night Adults-only Blitz.
WHEN : Friday through Sunday, May 29th – 31st, 2026. Round 1 is at 7 PM on Friday , May 29th.
WHERE : Country Inn & Suites by Radisson, 10358 Patriot Hwy, Fredericksburg, VA
- Hotel rate is $99 per night, plus taxes if reserved by Wednesday, May 27th, 2026. Follow the hotel reservation instructions on the Virginia Chess Federation home page,  www.vachess.org .
MAIN TOURNAMENT FORMAT : The main event consists of two sections of play using the Swiss System for pairings:
-  Senior Section : Rated by FIDE and US Chess , observing FIDE Rules. Top Virginia player in this section is eligible to represent Virginia at the 2026 John T. Irwin National Tournament of State Senior Champions to be held in Grand Rapids, MI, during the annual U.S. Open Chess Championships. Players must be at least 50 years old as of August 1, 2026 . We use this date because that is the start date of the Irwin Invitational Tournament.
-  Under 50 Section : US Chess rated , US Chess rules. For players who are 21 to 49 years old as of August 1, 2026.
- 5 rounds , Swiss System. This is not an elimination event!
- The Time Control for all 5 rounds is Game-90 with 30 seconds of increment for each move. This time control requires all players to take chess notation for the entire game.
- There is a 1-hour “no show/forfeit” rul e in effect. A player who is more than 60 minutes late for the announced start time of any round shall be forfeited for that round.
ADULTS-ONLY BLITZ : Four (4) Double-rounds at a time control of Game 5, Delay 2. Play is in two Sections: Open and Under 1500 . All games will be US Chess rated.
PLAYER ELIGIBILITY :
- Residency Requirements : There are no Virginia residency requirements. This tournament is open to all players who are at least 21 years old as of August 1, 2026 ; no exceptions.
- All players must be current members of the US Chess Federation. Virginia-based players must be current members of the Virginia Chess Federation (VCF). You can join US Chess and/or Virginia Chess at  www.vachess.org by selecting the appropriate membership option on our Home Page.
OPTIONAL BYE REQUESTS :
- One half-point Bye is allowed for any round in the Main Tournament (no Bye requests for Blitz). Must be declared by speaking directly with the Chief Arbiter/TD before onsite registration closes at 6:15 pm on Friday May 29th.
- Byes requests and changes for Rounds 2 through 5 must be declared at least ONE HOUR before the start of Round 2. Changes after this deadline will be listed as zero-point byes.
TOURNAMENT SCHEDULE : Both sections follow the same schedule and time controls.
- Friday , May 29th: Round 1 at 7 PM. Pairings will be posted at 6:30 PM.
- Saturday , May 30th: Round 2 at 11 AM, Round 3 at 4 PM. Senior and Adult Blitz will be played on Saturday evening at 9 PM (US Chess rated, Game 5, delay 2, enter online or onsite and see the separate TLA for the Blitz event).
- Sunday , May 31st: Round 4 at 11 AM, Round 5 at 4 PM
- Pairings for Rounds 2-5 will be posted ONE HOUR before the start of the next round. “Tentative Pairings” for the Saturday morning and Sunday morning rounds (Rounds 2 and 4) will be posted the evening prior, but these tentative pairings will be subject to change.
PRIZES : GUARANTEED $4,500 prize fund based on 80 paid players . 1st to 3rd place prize amounts are guaranteed in both sections.
- Senior Section :
+ 1st to 3rd Places: $650, $450, $300. Plaque to the Champion and the Top Virginia player.
+ Top Under 2200: $200 + Plaque
+ Top Under 1800: $165 + Plaque
+ Top Under 1400 / Unrated: $145 + Plaque
+ Top Super Senior (Age 65+): $130 + Plaque
- Under 50 Section :
+ 1st to 3rd Places: $650, $450, $300. Plaque for 1st Place.
+ Top Under 2000: $200 + Trophy
+ Top Under 1700: $165 + Trophy
+ Top Under 1400: $145 + Trophy
+ Top Under 1000: $130 + Trophy
+ Top Unrated: $100 + Trophy
- Both Sections:
+ $75 for the Top Upsets in Rounds 1-2 and Rounds 3-5.
+ An unrated player winning a place prize is limited to $300.
REGISTRATION AND ENTRY FEES :
- Main Tournament ONLINE Entry:   Click here to register now!
+ $75 online or US mail by Sunday May 17th.
+ $95 from Monday May 18th through Sunday May 24th. Note that Saturday, May 23rd is the last day to use the US Mail entry option.
+ $105 starting Monday May 25th and at the tournament site. Cash, checks, credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay accepted onsite.
- Main Tournament ONSITE Entry: Friday, May 29th from 3-6:15 PM. Registration also will be open on Saturday from 8-10 AM for players who want to enter the tournament for Round 2.
- Optional Adults-only Blitz : $25 in advance, $30 onsite at the tournament. We will pay 90% of the Blitz entry fees we receive by section. (For example, if we have 15 entries in the Blitz Open Section, the minimum prize pool will have $338 in cash awards for that section.)
- Entry by US Mail:
+ Send to Mike Hoffpauir, ATTN: VA Sr./U50 Open, 405 Hounds Chase, Yorktown, VA 23693.
+ Print and send us the “mail-in entry form” accessible through the VA Chess Federation ( www.vachess.org ) or include the following information with your mail-in entry: Section, US Chess ID, Bye Requests, mailing address, email address, and phone number. Also be sure to let us know whether you are playing Blitz and provide your Blitz Section! Make your check payable to “VCF” or “VA Chess Federation.”
+ Your Entry is post-marked by Saturday, May 23rd  and includes a check written for the proper amount of your entry fees.
+ Do not send any US Mail entries after May 23rd.
- NOTE: We will retain $10 from entries who withdraw before the start of Round 1.
RE-ENTRY : $35 . A player who had a disappointing Round 1 can “re-enter” the tournament for Round 2 and receive a Half-point Bye to replace their Round 1 score. The Round 1 game counts for rating points, but the Round 1 loss is replaced with a Half-point Bye. Re-entry also means that any other half-point bye the player requested for a later round will become 0-point byes unless that player decides to play in that round at the time of re-entering the tournament.
PAIRINGS :
- The Chief Arbiter/TD will use ratings from the US Chess May 2026 Rating Supplement for pairings and prize awards. The May ’26 Rating Supplement is published by US Chess on or about April 19, 2026. Pairings will be made using the higher of each player’s Over-the-Board (OTB) and Online Regular (slow) ratings from the May Rating Supplement unless the Online rating is “stale” compared to the OTB rating.
- Players without a US Chess rating but who have a rating in another system recognized by US Chess (e.g., FIDE, Canada, many foreign countries) will be paired according to the Chief Arbiter/TD’s conversion of their foreign rating. The Chief Arbiter/TD is the final authority for ratings used for each player.
- “Unrated” players are not unrated if they acquire a US Chess or FIDE rating by Thursday, May 28th.
TOURNAMENT EQUIPMENT :
- Chessboards, pieces, and chess clocks will be provided for all games. You may use your own.
- Use of Electronic Scoresheets is not allowed in the Senior Section unless the player has the approval of the Chief Arbiter.
- Health protocols: Masks are optional, but we will have some on hand for anyone who desires to wear one. We also will have ample hand sanitizer and sanitizing wipes.
QUESTIONS?  Mike Hoffpauir, VCF, [email protected] , 757-846-4805 (text)

- Sunday, May 31, 2026

Event Overview

May 30 & 31. 2026 Pennsylvania State Amateur Championship. Latour Room, Nazareth Student Center, 1300 University Ave., Marywood University, Scranton PA 18509. 2 sections. Championship (Saturday & Sunday): Open to U2200. 5-SS. Saturday Rds 1-3 G/75d5, Sunday Rds 4&5 G/90d5. EF: $17 received by 5/25, $22 after. Trophies to 1st-3rd, U1800, U1600, U1400, U1200/Unrated. 1st & 2nd receive paid advance entry into 2027 PA State Championship, Title to Top PA Resident. Trophy to Top School Team, any number of players may play, top 3 scores count for team. Rds 10am - 1pm - 3:30pm, 9:30am - 1pm. Scholastic (Saturday-only): Open to K-12 who are unrated or rated under 1400. 4-SS. G/40d5. EF: $12 received by 5/25, $17 after. Trophies to 1st-2nd, U1000, U800/Unrated. Trophy to Top School Team, any number of players may play, top 3 scores count for team. Rds 10am - 11:30am - 1pm - 2:30pm. All: Reg 8:30-9:30am. PSCF required $5 OSA. Bye: limit 1, at registration. Cincinnati Tornado MAY. Last Saturday of Month

Wyoming Baptist Church

Saturday, May 30, 2026

Event Overview

Cincinnati Tornado Monthly Tournament
Held on the Last Saturday of the Month
We provide all clocks & chess sets

Advance Entry Fee $45
Online Registration – By Friday 12 midnight deadline
Online Registration:   https://chessearth.com/tornado-registration/
Advance Registration ends on Friday 12 midnight.
NEW OPTION for returning players.   EMAIL or  TEXT MESSAGE  us to pre-register and enter the tournament:

- Email admin@chessearth:   1.) First & Last Name   2.) USCF ID  3.) Section you are playing in  and  4.)  Pay $45 at the Tournament Site

On-Site Entry Fee $50; On-Site Registration – By 9:30am Saturday morning deadline
-  10am First Round.

- On-Site Registration – Ends at 9:30am Saturday morning.     10am First Round.

- Credit Cards, PayPal, Venmo, CashApp, Zelle, Apple Pay accepted on site

- Tournament  Address:    Wyoming Baptist Church, 170 Burns Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45215

4-Round Swiss Tournament
Time Control: G/45 +5; Each player receives 45 minutes with a +5-second increment. A Tornado is a one-day tournament where you play four games. Cash Prizes and Awards are given at the end of the tournament based on your final score.
Round Start Times:
Round #1: 10:00am
Round #2: 12:30pm
Round #3: 2:30pm
Round #4: 4:30pm
Choose a Section To Play In:

- Open Section  -  Includes the Master Bounty Prize - $100

- Under 1600 Section

- Under 1000 Section

- Award Winning Chili.  Good Food; Hot Meals

- Chess Equipment and Merch available to purchase

- USCF Rated Tournament.  Join/Renew USCF on-site.

- Purchase a New Membership at Registration.

- 1/2 Point Bye is available if notified before Round 2.

- Prizes Fund based on 70 players.

- We provide all the Chess Clocks & Chess Sets

Open Section:     **NEW** Rating must be 1600 or above to play in the Open Section.
Or a player can pay $30 to “play up” into the Open Section.
1st – $200      2nd – $150
Top Under 2001   – $100
Top Under 1801   – $100
Includes the Master Bounty Prize - $100

- Master Bounty Prize:  Win your game against the #1 Master in the tournament and win $100. If you draw the Master, win $50.  If the Master wins all the games, then he/she wins the $100.

Chess Castle of Minnesota

Friday, June 5, 2026
- Sunday, June 7, 2026

Event Overview

MINNEAPOLIS OPEN June 5-7, 2026
Over $8,000 in prizes projected including Castle Blitz Championship!
GMs, IMS, & FMs entry refunded with at least 4 games played!!
10 Southdale Center Suite 910, Edina, MN 55435
Cap of 160 players so register now!!!!
Brasket (1800+ ONLY):  Entry fee is $95 by 5/1, $110 by 6/1, $125 by 6/4; $140 onsite.
Prize fund: 1st $1,400, 2nd $700, 3rd $350, U2400 $250, U2200 $250, U2000 $250 (based on 45).
Diesen (U1800): Entry fee is $80 by 5/1, $90 by 6/1, $100 by 6/4; $110 onsite.
Prize fund: 1st $1,000, 2nd $500, 3rd $250, U1600 $200, U1400 $200; U1200 $200;
U1000 $200 + Trophies for 1st - 3rd students U1000 (based on 55).
Future (U800):  Entry fee is $55 by 5/1, $60 by 6/1, $65 by 6/4; $70 onsite.
Prize fund: 1st $250, 2nd $120, 3rd $80, U600 1st $60, 2nd $30; U400 1st $60, 2nd $30; Unrated 1st $60, 2nd $30. Trophies for the top 1st - 3rd Elementary schoolers 1st - 3rd Secondary schoolers (based on 35).
Schedule: Five games, Swiss pairings, USCF required. Future only two-day option.
Three-Day: (Brasket & Diesen) All games 75 minutes + 30 second increment
Onsite Registration: Friday 5:00pm-5:30pm.
Rounds: Friday 6pm; Saturday 10:00am-2:30pm; Sunday 11:00am-3:30pm.
Two-Day: (All sections) Rounds 1 & 2 Game 30 minutes + 30 second increment (First two games) then merge with 3-day Round Three. Onsite Registration: Saturday 9:00am -9:30am.
Rounds: Saturday 10:00am-noon, merge.
Advanced Registration can be made online at  www.onlineregistration.cc or mailed: Dane Zagar 7521 Penn Ave S #1, Minneapolis, MN 55423. Checks payable to: Chess Club of Minnesota; Must be postmarked by June 1st.
One Half-Point Bye can be requested before round 3 is paired, all others are zero-point byes.
Special Rules: Time forfeits after 30 minutes. Unrated players can play in the Diesen or Future but can only win Unrated prizes in Future or Trophies.
Castle Blitz Championship Saturday 7pm: USCF blitz rated eight games, Swiss pairings.
All games are 5 minutes with a 2 second delay.
Registration Fees: $35 by 5/1, $40 by 6/1, $45 by 6/5, or $50 onsite by 6:45pm Saturday.
Prize fund: 1st $500, 2nd $250, 3rd $150, U2300 $150; U2000 $150; U1700 $150; U1400 $150; U1100 $150; U800/Unrated Trophy (based on 55).

Arlington $10 Quads

Holy Cross Lutheran Church

Saturday, June 6, 2026

Event Overview

G/45;d5 - Quad Format - No Prizes - All ratings welcome. $10 entry - cash only - Adults and Kids Welcome No Late Entries - No Byes - No Withdrawals ONSITE REGISTRATION ONLY US Chess Membership Required, will affect quick and regular rating.

- 9:15 AM - Registration Begins

- 9:45 AM - Registration Ends (NO LATE ENTRIES)

- 10:00 AM - Round One

- 12:30 PM - Round Two

- 2:15 PM - Round Three

What is Quad Format? Players are grouped in order of rating. The top four are grouped, then the next four are grouped, and so on. The groups (quads) of four play each other in a three-round round-robin. No late entries, no withdrawals . Quads are round robins. Please do not play if you can't stay for all three games. Leaving in the middle of a quad is rude and provides an extreme inconvenience to the other three players in your quad.

Fairfax Chess Tournament 6/6/26

Pozez Jewish Community Center of Northern Virginia

Saturday, June 6, 2026

Event Overview

Register at  chessacademy.com/tournaments !
This tournament is for scholastic players in grades K-12 with and without prior tournament experience.  We recommend that players in their first tournament choose the Unrated option, where they will be grouped by age and play 3 or 4 games.
Players who've previously done well in an Unrated section or have previous rated tournament experience should choose the Rated option, where they'll be placed in a group of 4 players according to their age and rating.  Each participant then plays one game against each of the other three players in their group. At the end of the third game, the winner of each group receives a trophy.
This event should typically finish in 1-2 hours, but can potentially take as long as 3 hours for the most advanced players (although that is rare).
Everyone will use a clock!  We'll go over how to use clocks on-site, and you can watch this short video to see how they work. Unrated section players will play a game in 10 minutes with a 5 second delay, and Rated games are 25 minutes with a 5 second delay for each player.
Players can play in the morning at 10am, the afternoon at 1pm, or both!

- All sections are non-elimination, and all players participate in all rounds

- If you're playing in the Rated sections and have a US Chess ID# and membership, please include it.  If you don't have one, we will purchase it for you ($24 value!).  If you're not sure what your ID# is you can look it up  here

- Please arrive 15 minutes before games start.  Players who arrive after that may not be placed in quads.

- Prices increase by $10 at noon the Tuesday before the tournament.

Questions?  Please let us know at  Click here to show mail address !

2026 National Open

Heritage Event, American Classic, Grand Prix, Enhanced Grand Prix, Junior Grand Prix, National Championship Event

Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino

Wednesday, June 10, 2026
- Sunday, June 14, 2026

Event Overview

Open Section June 10-14: 9-SS, G/90, +30. GM & IM norms possible.
Under Sections June 11-14, 12-14, or 13-14: 7-SS , G/90 +30  (3-day rounds 1-2 G/60, +10, 2-day rounds 1-4 G/25, +5)
Beginners Sections June 12, 13, and 14: 5-SS G/25, +5
Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino   3000 Paradise Road Las Vegas NV 89109
$125,000 Guaranteed Fund ! In 8 sections, top 3 FIDE rated
Open: $10,000-5,000-2,500-1,000-500-400-350-350-350 top under 2500 $2,500, top under 2400 $2,400
The winner of the Open section is a National Champion and receives a replica of the Edmondson Cup.
Under 2300: $7,000-3,500-1,750-900-450-350-350-350-350
Under 2100: $7,000-3,500-1,750-900-450-350-350-350-350
Under 1900: $6,000-3,000-1500-700-400-350-350-350-350
Under 1700: $5,000-2,500-1,250-600-350-350-350-350-350
Under 1500: $ 3,400-1,700-800-400-350-350-350-350-350
Under 1250: $2,400-1,200-600-350-350-350 top under 900 $850, top under 700 $700 (no provisional)
Provisionally rated players may not win an amount greater than 40% of the top prize in any under section; balance goes to next player(s) in line.
Beginners (unrated, rated under 800, or provisionally rated under 1250) :  3 schedules with 5 rounds per day. $300-200-100 each day plus $400-300-200 overall (best 2 results count) Age 15 and above.
Unrated players may play only in Beginners, Open, or U2300 Section.
Plus-Score Bonus: ($25,000 guaranteed) in addition to any other prizes, every player with a plus score wins a $50 gift certificate. Plus score certificates will be awarded on site only.
Mixed Doubles: best male/female combined 2-player team score: $1,500-750-350. Average rating below 2200; teammates may play in different sections. Only rounds 1-7 count for Open Section or best day for Beginners. Register on site only (no extra fee) before both players have started round 2.
The Freddie: Players age 14 and under are eligible for best game prizes including the Freddie Award and $400 in cash prizes
Ratings
June FIDE ratings used in Open section, June US Chess ratings in all other sections. Online ratings, CCA minimum ratings or other ratings may be used if higher. Players rated more than 100 points higher than the section limit during the last year may be moved to a higher section. The decision of the chief tournament director regarding eligibility or rating adjustments is final.
Entry Fees
Open: $249 by 4/30, $269 by 5/26, $289 later. $400 more for players not rated at least 2200 or FIDE 2100. GM, WGM & foreign IM free by 5/26. $60 discount for other IM or WIM by 5/26.
Under sections: $249 by 4/30, $269 by 5/26, $289 later. $100 play-up fee if rated more than 300 points below section limit or unrated  (except U1250).
Beginners: $129 1 day, $189 2 days, $229 3 days, $31 more after 5/26
All: Early Bird Loyalty discount $50 by 1/31  for players who have played in any previous National Open event.  Senior (over 65) discount $40 by 5/26.  All entry fees $31 more on site.
Schedules
5-day (open section only) : Register Wednesday 4-5 p.m. Rounds 6:30, 1-6:30, 1-6:30, 10-3:30, 10-3:30.
4-day (under sections only) : Register Thursday 2-5 p.m. Rounds 6:30, 1-6:30, 10-3:30, 10-3:30
3-day (under sections only) : Register Friday 9-10:30 a.m. Rounds 12-3; merge with 4-day in round 3 at 6:30
2-day (under sections only) : Register Saturday 8-8:30 a.m. Rounds 9-10:30-12-1:30; merge with 4-day in round 5 at 3:30
Beginners : Rounds Friday 1-2:30-4-6:30-8, Saturday/Sunday 10-11:30-1-3:30-5.
Half point byes available in any round if requested at least 2 hours in advance. Sunday and last round byes must be requested before the start of round 4 and may not be cancelled.
Chess sets and boards provided for tournament play only, not for skittles. Please bring digital chess clocks!
Make your hotel reservations early: $114 Sun-Thu, $154 Fri-Sat. The resort fee is discounted to $30 (normally $45) and self-parking is free for all participants. Cutoff for special hotel rate is May 21; after that, rates will increase significantly and there may not be any rooms available.  VegasChessFestival.com/hotel or (800) 732-7117 .  Be sure to ask for the CHESS (Group SVCF6R) rates
ENTER:  online at VegasChessFestival.com  or mail to Vegas Chess Festivals, PO Box 90925, Henderson, NV 89009-0925. Phone: (702) 930-9550 (info only – no phone entries)
The National Open is part of the LAS VEGAS INTERNATIONAL CHESS FESTIVAL
Grandmaster Simuls and Chess Camp for all ages on Thursday. U.S. Women’s Open Wednesday and Thursday. Walter Browne Memorial Blitz Saturday 9 p.m.  Free Style Chess (chess960) Thursday afternoon. Blitz Sectionals Friday & Sunday nights. Youth Events Friday – Sunday. Poker Tournament Monday Morning.  Free parking. Free raffles with great prizes. Free Lectures. Free GM analysis of your games.

Address: 3000 Paradise Road

Las Vegas , NV 89109

United States

Prize Fund: $125,000

Handicap Accessible: Yes
Residency Restriction: No
Online Event: No

Columbia Chess Club

Event Overview

The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision XLV
June 13, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until the day before the tournament.  $50 late registration the day before/morning of.  Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes.  If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament?  Great!  We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit  https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Live Standings/Pairings/Boards
The top board of each section will be live streamed to the DGT LiveCloud along with real-time updates to Lichess.org and Chess.com.  A live video stream of the top Championship board will also be available on the club's Twitch page.  See this site's "Live" menu for links.
Live standings (including current pre-registration information) and pairings are also available below.
Live Standings
Prizes
$1000 Prize Fund Guaranteed.
Championship (1600+)
$400 Fund. 1st: $200; 2nd: $130; 3rd: $70
Under 1600
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Under 1000
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Schedule

- Round 1: 10:30 a.m.

- Round 2: 12:50 p.m.

- Round 3: 2:40 p.m.

- Round 4: 4:30 p.m.

Byes
A single half-point bye is available any round, including the final round.  The half-point bye may be requested as a part of the advance entry or on site before the tournament starts.  Thereafter the only bye available is a zero-point bye.  The chief tournament director shall have the ability to grant a half-point bye for any round on unusual circumstances.

Columbia Chess Club

Columbia, SC 29212

Email  [email protected] or call/text James Brandmair at 803.569.0938.

The Columbia Chess Club is located in a shopping center with ample parking.
Food
The Columbia Chess Club offers on-site concessions, including drinks and snacks.  By the Fire Pizza and Zorba's Restaurant are located in the same shopping center and will be open during the tournament.  Many other restaurants are available close by!

Grand Prix

Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino

Saturday, June 13, 2026

Event Overview

$5,000 Prize Fund plus the Walter Shawn Browne Cup
We honor the memory of our friend, Grandmaster Walter Browne, by naming the National Open Blitz Championship after him. Walter started the World Blitz Chess Association (WBCA) and always seemed to be in time trouble. His flag has fallen, but he will always be a champion to us.
6 Double Round Swiss Game/3 +2

- Play 12 games – white and black against each opponent

- Open Section is FIDE Blitz Rated

Sections & Prizes
Open (Championship) Section

- FIDE & US Chess Blitz Rated

- 1st $1,000 + cup, 2nd $600, 3rd $300

- U2400 $260, U2300 $240, U2200 $220, U2100 $200, U2000 $180

Reserve (Under 1900) Section

- US Chess Blitz Rated

- 1st $500, 2nd $300, 3rd $200

- U1800 $190, U1700 $170, U1600 $150, U1500 $140, U1400 $130, U1200 $120, U1000 $100

6/13 - Quad chess tournament G40; d5

Saint Petersburg Chess Club

Saturday, June 13, 2026

Event Overview

There will be no “Byes” or withdrawals allowed. Please complete all your Quad games.
WHAT IS THE QUAD CHESS TOURNAMENT? After all the players have entered, they’re ordered from highest rating to lowest. Unrated players are placed at the low end. The top four players are placed into their own section (a “quad”), then the next four highest in another section, and so on down the list.If two family members are in the same quad, I can move one of them quad up or down.The players in each quad play a round robin, one game against each of the players in their section, for a total of three games each. If there is not an even multiple of four players, the lowest section (usually) will have the few extra players and play a three round Swiss tournament rather than a round robin. The quad format is popular in one day events, and results in players of the most similar playing strengths being paired together for all three rounds. Each group of four chess players is called a Quad.If two family members are at the same Quad,I can move one of them to another Quad.
ADVANTAGES OF QUAD TOURNAMENTS: The advantage of Quad Tournaments, and why players enjoy them so much, is that players of the same strength and experience are able to compete against each other. In addition, the less experienced players are able to win the same "First Place" prizes as their more experienced, stronger counterparts in Quad I and II. You have opportunity your rating to go up faster!!!
LOCATION: Saint Petersburg Chess Club 540 4th Avenue North Saint Petersburg, FL 33701 (it is located in between Mirror Lake and the Coliseum, next to the Sunshine Center.)
REGISTRATION: 10:00-10:45 a.m. If you want to make sure you can play, you need to Pay ahead of time here -  https://www.chessregister.com/ .
ENTRY FEE:
$25 if paid by Wednesday (3 days before the tournament)
$30 afterward.
$35 if paid on Saturday.
USCF membership is required. Please check your USCF ID and renew it if it has expired. If you need me to do it on site add $5 to your bill.
ROUNDS: Three Rounds, First starts at approx. 11:00 a.m.
TIME CONTROL: G40; d5
PRIZES: $65 for first place at each Quad or 1st place very big trophy (if two players tied for 1st place $33 each or 1st place big trophy each)
Trophies for 1st to 3rd place for last section!
IMPORTANT NOTICE: Due to space limitation to secure your spot Pay online ahead of time! BRING YOUR CHESS CLOCK!!!
Visit our new website-  https://saintpetersburgchessclub.com for more information about the chess at Saint Petersburg.
For more information you can call also (727) 776-5583, or send me email to  Click here to show mail address

Game 40 Challenge

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, June 13, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 40 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700, Under 1200 & Under 700. No playing up allowed for Open and U1700. Players Under 700 can play in the U1200 Section. Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:30 AM, Round 3- 12:00 PM, Round 4- 1:30 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point Bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Contact: Liulia Cardona at [email protected] or (602) 402-4985
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Entry Fee: $30.00 by Wednesday; $35 by Friday; $40 same day. Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

2025 Haring PA Tournament – Haring Qualifier

State Championship Event

Tri-Bridges Chess Club

Saturday, June 13, 2026
- Sunday, June 14, 2026

Event Overview

This event is the official Pennsylvania Haring Qualifier. You must be a scholastic female player.  You may be from any state. However, to represent Pennsylvania in the Haring Championship at the U. S. Open, you must be a citizen of Pennsylvania.
One section – G/90 d5. Round Times: Saturday – 10 – 1:30 – 5; Sunday 9:30 – 1

Prizes: Haring representative for top Pennsylvanian; 1st Overall – $200, 2nd Overall – $100; Top Under 2000 – $90; Top Under 1800 – $80; Top Under 1600 – $70; Top Under 1400 – $60; Top Under 1200 – $50; Top Under 1000 – $50; Top Upset – $50
Entry Fee: $30
Coffee/tea/water is available. Fast food/sit-down restaurants/convenience stores are within a few minutes’ commute. Two or three hotels are about 5 minutes away, and many are within about 20 minutes. There will also be a small selection of chess literature for sale.
One half-point bye allowed; must declare by the start of round 2.
When signing up, click blue registration button, fill out form, click submit, and then reload page to see if you want to double check that you have signed up.
You may register on site between 8:30 and 9:30.  The entry fee for registering on site is $50.

2026 Summer Tournament by Azeri Chess Academy LLC

Houston Chess Studio

Sunday, June 14, 2026

Event Overview

Organizer
Azeri Chess Academy LLC ( USCF Affiliate ID A9567106 )
Tournament Director
International Grandmaster and Local TD Ulvi Bajarani ( USCF ID 17112757 )
Tournament Purpose
This tournament is part of the Azeri Chess Academy Houston Circuit 2026.
Date & Time
Round 1 starts on June 14, 2026, at 10:00 AM .
Venue
Houston Chess Studio, 250 Patton Street Suite H Houston, Texas 77009.
Time Control
G/30, d10 (Each player gets 30 minutes with a 10-second delay per move).
Format
6-round Swiss system.
Pairings will be generated using ChessRoster SwissSys 11.75 (subject to updates to more recent versions).
Ratings
This tournament is USCF-rated , and the official June 2026 USCF ratings will be used.
Byes

- Up to two (2) half-point byes is allowed and must be declared during registration.

- No additional byes are permitted except for 0-point byes .

- A 1-point bye is awarded to a player who is left without an opponent when the number of players is odd in a given round.

Entry Fee

- $60 – Until May 15, 2026, or for the first 10 players, whichever comes first.

- $80 – Until June 1, 2026, or for the next 20 players, whichever comes first.

- $100 – Until June 14, 2026 at 12:00 AM (midnight), or until all spots are filled.

Cancellation & Refund Policy

- A 50% refund will be granted if a player requests cancellation by June 11, 2026, at 12:00 AM (midnight) .

- No refunds will be issued after this deadline.

Withdrawal Policy

- Players must notify an arbiter before the start of a round if they intend to withdraw.

- Failure to notify an arbiter may affect eligibility for future tournaments organized by Azeri Chess Academy LLC.

Number of Entries
Maximum of 64 participants.
Eligibility

- Open to all players with active USCF membership .

- Players must ensure their USCF membership is active before the start of Round 1.

- Onsite check-ins may be available for players needing USCF membership renewal. They must pay the required renewal fee plus an additional $10 processing fee.

- Failure to renew an expired membership before the tournament will result in exclusion without a refund .

Tournament Schedule (Estimated Round Start Times)
1st Round – 10:00 AM
2nd Round – 11:25 AM
30-minute break
3rd Round – 1:20 PM
4th Round – 2:45 PM
5th Round – 4:05 PM
6th Round – 5:25 PM
Closing Ceremony – 6:45 PM
Prize Fund
Prize distribution is based on the final number of players in the tournament:
< 10 players
1st: $300 + plaque
Total prize fund: $300
10–15 players
1st: $400 + plaque
2nd: $100
Total prize fund: $500

2nd: $250
Total prize fund: $750

3rd: $150
Total prize fund: $900

2nd: $250

- If rating prizes are offered, unrated players are eligible only for prizes in the lowest rating group . This does not affect their eligibility for the overall (main) prizes.

- Prizes are equally shared in case of a tie .

- Payments will be sent via Zelle/PayPal before June 21, 2026. Prize-winners must contact the organizer immediately after the final round to confirm their preferred payment method. Additionally, the prize winners are required to participate in the prize ceremony following the tournament. Failure to complete these actions will result in disqualification from receiving the prize.

Tiebreaks
Tiebreaks will be determined using ChessRoster SwissSys , applying standard USCF tiebreak methods :

- Solkoff

- Modified Median

- Cumulative

If players are tied for 1st place and all tiebreaks are equal , a coin toss will determine the winner.
Anti-Cheating Measures & Electronic Devices Policy

- All players are subject to electronic device scanning (“wanding”) .

- No electronic devices (phones, smartwatches, etc.) are allowed unless explicitly permitted by the arbiter for medical reasons .

- A designated storage box will be provided for electronic devices.

Photography & Video Recording
By registering, players consent to being photographed and recorded by the Tournament Director and their associates for promotional purposes.
Equipment & Notation Rules

- Chess sets, clocks, scoresheets, and pens will be provided by the organizer.

- Notation is mandatory unless a player has less than 5 minutes remaining on their clock.

- Players may keep a yellow scoresheet copy and a pen . However, players are encouraged to bring an extra pen , as available pens may be limited .

Parking & Nearby Restaurants:

- Free parking is available near the venue.

- 3 restaurants in the same strip center as venue: The Red Hot Noodle (Asian), Subway , and Patron Pizza . Several others are within walking distance.

30th annual New York State Open and Senior Amateur

Heritage Event, Grand Prix, Enhanced Grand Prix, Junior Grand Prix

Tiki Resort

Friday, June 19, 2026
- Sunday, June 21, 2026

Event Overview

A Heritage Event!
US Chess Junior Grand Prix!
June 19-21 or 20-21, 2026  NEW YORK
US Chess Grand Prix Points: 20 (Enhanced)
30th annual New York State Open and Senior Amateur .  5-SS, 40/80, SD/30; d30 (2-day option, rds. 1-2 G/60, d10). Tiki Resort, 2 Canada St., Lake George, NY 12845.  $3300 GUARANTEED PRIZES.   In 4 sections.  Open:  $$ 400-200-150, top Under 2010/Unr $240-120, top Under 1810 $200-100.  Senior Amateur: open to under 1910 born before 6/22/76. $$ 300-150-100, top Under 1710/Unr $140-70.  Under 1610:  $$ 240-120-70, Under 1410 $120-60.  Under 1210: $120-60-40, Plaques or medals to Top 3, Top U1000, U800, Unrated.  Unrateds allowed all sections, with prize limits of $150 in Under 1610 Section, $80 in Under 1210. Mixed Doubles:  Best male+female 2-player combined score among all sections: $200-100. Team must average under 2200; may play in different sections or schedules; register (no extra fee) by 2 pm Sat. Top 3 sections EF:   $88 online at chessaction.com by 6/16, $100 later until 1 hour before round 1 or at site. Under 1210 Section EF: all $20 less than top 3 sections.  Online entry $5 less to NYSCA members (dues $12/year with 2 issues Empire Chess , $20/year with 4 issues, may join with online entry). No checks, credit cards OK. Special 1 year USCF dues  with magazine if paid with online entry at chesstour.com: see chessevents.us.   Re-entry $40  (not from Open to Open Section). GMs, IMs, WGMs free, $80 deducted from prize. June official  ratings used; Unofficial uschess.org ratings or Online Regular Ratings usually used if otherwise unrated.  Cannot play below  Online Regular Rating - 100 points. 3-day schedule: Reg. ends Fri 6 pm, rds. Fri 7, Sat 11 & 5, Sun 10 & 3:30.  2-day schedule: Reg. ends Sat 10 am, rds. Sat 11, 2 & 5, Sun 10 & 3:30. Half point byes  OK all, must commit before rd. 2; limit 2 byes (limit 1 bye if under 1810/unr in Open). HR: $119-129, call 518-668-5744 Mon-Fri 9 am-5pm by 5/29 or rate may increase. Car rental: Avis, 800-331-1600, use AWD #D657633, or reserve car online through chesstour.com. Enter Online: chessaction.com (no mailed entries). Questions: www.chesstour.com, DirectorAtChess.us, $15 service charge for refunds. Entries posted at chessaction.com (click "entry list" after entering). Bring set, clock, board  if possible– none supplied. Blitz tournament  Sat 9:30 pm, reg. at site Sat by 9:10 pm.

Lake George , NY 12845

United States

Grupology June Rapid Scholastic Tournament

Grupology HQ

Saturday, June 20, 2026

Event Overview

Tournaments take place every month at Grupology HQ in Downtown Burlingame.
Location

- Grupology HQ: 1419 Chapin Ave. Suite 101, Burlingame CA 94010

Eligibility

- Players must have an active (paid) US Chess Federation membership to compete in the rated sections.

- Expiration date of US Chess membership must be later than the day of the tournament.

- Check membership status

- Become a member or renew your membership

Rapid Tournaments

Sections

- K–12th Rated (4 games)
- 2 or 3 sections depending on number of registrations: 600+, under 600

- TDs reserve the right to adjust the sections based on the players signed up to better serve them.

- K–5th Non-Rated (4 games)

Schedule

- Doors Open: 8:50am

- Start Time: Game 1 starts promptly at 9:00am.

- Rounds: All sections will play 4 games. This is not an elimination competition.
- Round 1: 9:00am

- Round 2: 9:30am

- Round 3: 10:00am

- Round 4: 10:30am

- End Time: ~11:15am

- Byes: Limit one 1/2-point bye if requested prior to the first round. No last round byes.

- Time Control: G/15

- Rating: Games will be USCF quick-rated.

- Notation: Notation not required.

Time Control: G/45;d5 for quads over 1000 rating, G/30;d5 for under 1000.
Rounds: Three rounds starting at 1:30 and ASAP.
Entry fee: $30
Prizes: $60 prize to the winner of each quad. A second place prize is available for sections larger than four players.
Safety: No food is allowed in the playing area.

Phoenix Saturday Action

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, June 20, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:05 AM, Round 3- 11:10 AM, Round 4- 12:15 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by 06/17; $30 by 06/19; $35 same day. Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Speedy Quads 68

J. Gilligan's Bar and Grill

Monday, June 22, 2026

Event Overview

Speedy - because the time control is G/5;d0 (each player gets 5 minutes to make all their moves.)
Quads - because we divide the players in groups of four based on ratings or skill level.
Players play two games against each of the three other players in their quad.
We hold a Speedy Quads tournament every fourth Monday each month. Speedy Quads has a FREE entry (but we do accept donations to cover the rating fees). There are no prizes. The games are blitz-rated and do not affect regular or quick ratings.
Time Control is G/5;d0; and we play double-round quads.
Register on site only - please arrive before 7:30pm. US Chess members will play rated quads. Non-members will play in an unrated small Swiss blitz tournament.

Arlington , TX 76010

- Monday, June 29, 2026

Event Overview

US Chess Junior Grand Prix
JUNE 25-29, 2026   DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA
US CHESS GRAND PRIX POINTS: 200 (ENHANCED)
4th annual DC International (in cooperation with the DC Chess Association),   9-SS, 40/80, SD/30; d30, Omni Shoreham Hotel, 2500 Calvert St., NW, Washington, DC 20008. Hotel valet parking is $45/day Chess rate; see chessevents.us for possible offsite public parking options.  $20,000 guaranteed prizes in 1 section. FIDE rated; FIDE ratings used for pairings & prizes. GM & IM norms possible. Prizes $6000-4000-2000-1500-1200-800-700-600, clear or tiebreak bonus $200, top FIDE under 2300 $2000-1000. Minimum prize guarantees:  If entering online by 6/1 and playing all 9 games (no byes): foreign GM $700, foreign IM/WGM $300. Nonresident aliens:  see US tax laws at chessaction.org. EF: GMs, foreign IMs/WGMs: free ( players forfeiting without proper advance notice subject to fine and losing future entry privileges), US IMs, WGMs and foreign FIDE rated players rated 2000/up FIDE: $150 online at chessaction.com by 5/15, $175 by 6/23, $200 later online or at site. Foreign players rated Under 2000 FIDE:  $300 online by 5/15, $325 by 6/23, $350 later online or at site.  US FIDE Masters :   $200 online by 5/15, $225 by 6/23, $250 later online or at site. US players FIDE rated 2200/up:  $300 online by 5/15, $325 by 6/23, $350 later online or at site. US players FIDE rated 2000/up:   $400 online by 5/15, $425 by 6/23, $450 later online or at site.   US players rated under 2000 FIDE or any FIDE unrated:   $800 online by 5/15, $825 by 6/23, $850 later online or at site. FIDE might not count players with federation “FID” as foreign players.  All:  No checks, credit cards OK.  Special 1-year USCF dues with magazine: see chessevents.us (USCF membership required). Schedule: Late reg. ends Thu 6 pm, rds Thu 7 pm; Fri 1 & 7 pm, Sat 11 am & 5 pm; Sun-Mon 10 am & 4 pm.  Two half point byes available; must commit before rd 3; FIDE norm not possible if taking bye.  HR: $169-169-169-169, hotel reservation link at chessevents.us (or call 202-234-0700, mention Chess); reserve early, Chess block may sell out by early June or before. Parking: See chessevents.us for possible offsite parking options. Special car rental  rates: Avis, 800-331-1600, AWD #D657633, or reserve car online through  chesstour.com .  Special rules:  Players may not possess cellphones during play; see  devicerules.com .  Enter online:  chessaction.com . No mail entries.  Questions:  chesstour.com , [email protected] .  $15 service charge  for refunds.  Entries  posted at  chessaction.com  (click “entry list” after entering).  Prizes not claimed at site  are usually paid through   PayPal (may take around 3 weeks).  Bring set, board, clock  if possible- none supplied.  Invitations:   [email protected] .  Bring set, board, clock if possible- none supplied (top games are assigned to DGT boards by round). Blitz tournament:  Sat. 9:30 pm, register on-site Sat. by 9:10 pm.

54th Annual World Open, Under 1200 And Under 1000 Sections
9-SS, Omni Shoreham Hotel, 2500 Calvert St., NW, Washington, DC 20008. Hotel valet parking is $45/day Chess rate; see chessevents.us for possible offsite public parking options. In 2 sections with $17,000 guaranteed prizes; see separate TLA for World Open, 6 higher sections, July 1-5, 2-5 or 3-5, 2026.   Ratings used for U1200 & U1000 Sections:  June 2026 USCF official; USCF unofficial or USCF Online Regular rating usually used if otherwise unrated. Cannot play below USCF Online Regular Rating-100 points. Time control for U1200 & U1000 Sections:  G/60, d10.  Under 1200 prizes:  $4000-2000-1000-800-600-500-400-300-300-300.  Under 1000 prizes:  $2000-1000-700-500-400-300-300-200-200-200.  Prize limits: 1) If any post-event Regular OTB or Regular Online rating posted 6/24/25-6/24/26, or current Online Regular rating, was more than 40 points over section maximum, prize limit $1,000. 2) Players with under 26 lifetime games rated as of June 2026 official list cannot win over $500 U1000, $1000 U1200. Games rated too late for June official list not counted toward 26 game total. 3) Unrated limit U1000 $200, U1200 $400. 4) Balance of any limited prize goes to next eligible player(s) in line.  Mixed Doubles Bonus Prizes:  Best male+female combined 2-player team score in U1000 plus U1200: $500-300-200. May play in different sections; register (no extra fee) before both players begin round 2; teams must have at least one rated player, teams including an unrated limited to $300, other prize limits do not apply to Mixed Doubles Team prizes.  Entry fee, online at chessaction.com:  Under 1200 Section, $218 by 5/15, $228 by 6/23, $250 at site or online until Noon 6/26. Under 1000 Section, $118 by 5/15, $128 by 6/23, $150 at site or online until Noon 6/26. No checks, credit cards OK.  Re-entry: $100,  no re-entry into U1400 or above. U1200 or U1000 players may also enter U1400 or above separately, but not as a re-entry.  Special 1 year USCF dues  with magazine if paid online with entry: see chessevents.us.  Schedule:  6/26 1 pm, 4 pm, 7 pm; 6/27 11 am, 2 pm, 5 pm, 6/28 10 am, 1 pm, 4 pm.  Half point byes  OK all rounds, limit 3 (limit 2 in last 4 rounds), must commit before round 4. HR: $169-169-169-169, hotel reservation link at chessevents.us (or call 202-234-0700, mention Chess); reserve early, Chess block may sell out by early June or before. Parking: See chessevents.us for possible offsite parking options. Special car rental  rates: Avis, 800-331-1600, AWD #D657633, or reserve car online through  chesstour.com .  Special rules:  Players may not possess cellphones during play; see  devicerules.com .  Enter online:  chessaction.com . No mail entries.  Questions:  chesstour.com ,  chesstour.info , [email protected] .  $15 service charge  for refunds.  Entries  posted at  chessaction.com  (click “entry list” after entering).  Prizes not claimed at site  are usually paid through   PayPal (may take around 3 weeks).  Bring set, board, clock  if possible- none supplied.  Invitations:   [email protected] . - Sunday, June 28, 2026

Event Overview

US Chess Junior Grand Prix
JUNE 26-28 OR 27-28, 2026   DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA
US CHESS GRAND PRIX POINTS: 120 (ENHANCED)

The DC Open (in cooperation with the DC Chess Association), 5-SS, 40/80, SD/30; d30 (2-day option, rounds 1-2 G/60, d10), Omni Shoreham Hotel, 2500 Calvert St., NW, Washington, DC 20008. Hotel valet parking is $45/day Chess rate; see chessevents.us for possible offsite public parking options. $15,000 guaranteed prizes. In 4 sections. Major: Open to 1900/above. $2000-1000-600-400, clear/tiebreak winner $100 bonus, top USCF U2300 $600-300. FIDE. Under 2100: $1200-600-400-300, top Under 1900/Unr $500-300. FIDE. Under 1800: $1200-600-400-300, top Under 1600 (no Unr) $400-200. Under 1500:  $1000-500-300-200, top Under 1300 (no Unr) $400-200. Mixed Doubles Bonus prizes:  best male+female 2-player team combined score among all sections: $500-300-200. Team must average under 2200; may play different sections and schedules; register (no extra fee) by 2 pm Sat. Unrated prize limits: U1500 $200, U1800 $400. Playing up in Major: see peakrating.us. EF: $118 online at chessaction.com by 6/24, all $140 later online or at site (no checks, credit cards OK), until an hour before round 1. GMs $100 from prize. USCF Online Regular or unofficial  uschess.org ratings usually used if otherwise unrated. Cannot play below  Online Regular Rating - 100 points. USCF Membership required. Special 1-year USCF dues with magazine if paid online with entry: see chessevents.us. Re-entry $50; no Major to Major. 3-day schedule: Reg ends Fri 6 pm, rds. Fri 7 pm, Sat 11 & 5, Sun 10 & 4. 2-day schedule: Reg ends Sat 10 am, rds. Sat 11, 2 & 5, Sun 10 & 4. All: Half point byes OK all, limit 2, must commit before rd 2. HR: $169-169-169-169, hotel reservation link at chessevents.us (or call 202-234-0700, mention Chess); reserve early, Chess block may sell out by early June or before. Prizes not claimed at site  are usually paid by PayPal (may take about 3 weeks). Enter online: chessaction.com. No mail entries. $15 service charge for refunds. Questions:  www.chesstour.com, [email protected] .  Entries posted at chessaction.com (click “entry list” after entering) . Bring set, board, clock  if possible- none supplied. Blitz tournament Sat 9:30 pm, enter at site Sat by 9:10 pm.

2026 Castle Chess Grand Prix

Grand Prix

Emory University – Emory Student Center

Friday, June 26, 2026
- Sunday, June 28, 2026

Event Overview

https://castlechess.org/grandprix/

Note “No Spectator” policy!
IMPORTANT – due to the FIFA World Cup Games in Atlanta, out-of-town players should make their travel and hotel arrangements soon!
$12,000 Guaranteed Prize Fund
Dates:

June 26-28, 2026

Location:

Emory University – Emory Student Center
605 Asbury Circle, Atlanta, GA.
Free Parking at Emory is at the Peavine Parking Lot, 29 Eagle Row, Atlanta, GA. Use the covered parking deck – do not park in the outside deck or you will be charged. Allow ~15 minutes to walk from Peavine to the ESC.

Format:

5 rounds. Time Control: G/90, inc/10. 2-day schedule, round 1, G/60, inc/10.

Sections & Prizes:

$12,000 fully guaranteed prize fund in 7 sections.
Master (2200+): $1700 – $1000 – $500; top U2400 : $600 – $300. 80 USCF Grand Prix Points .
Expert (2000-2199): $1000 – $600 – $400.
Class A (1800-1999): $800 – $500 – $300.
Class B (1600-1799): $600 – $400 – $300.
Class C (1400-1599): $500 – $300 – $200.
Class D (1200-1399 or Unrated): $500 – $300 – $200.
U1200 (100-1199 or Unrated): $500 – $300 – $200.
* Strict 100-point rule used for “playing up” a section – see below.

- June 2026 US Chess ratings usually used.

- 100-point Rule: Players rated within 100 points of next section cutoff (June USCF supplement or live rating thereafter) may “play up” a section if they choose to.
- Example: a player rated 1700 on the June rating list (or live rating thereafter) may play up in Class A if they choose to, but not a player rated 1699.

- No exceptions – do not register for a section that you are ineligible for by rating. Erroneous registrations will be moved to the correct section.

- Unrated players may enter the Class D or U1200 sections and are eligible for prizes.

- Prizes are paid on site on Sunday, June 28 until 5:30pm, or mailed out the week of June 30.

- For prizes of $600+, you must fill out a W-9 form with your Tax ID # and address.

Entry Fee :

- $125 online by June 23

- $140 online after June 23 or on-site (cash only, exact change), at least 45 minutes before game.

- Free entries:
- All GMs, IMs, WGMs : Free online entry . No deduction if registered by June 20, otherwise $125 deducted from prize.

- FMs & WIMs currently rated 2200+, All Players currently rated 2400+ . Free online entry . $125 deducted from prize.

- Re-entry : $60 online or on-site (cash, exact change).

- Campers who pay for the tournament at registration should not register separately.

Registration:

Online registration is strongly recommended!
On-site registration (not recommended): 3-day – Friday 5:15-5:30pm. 2-day/Re-Entry: Saturday 8:45-9:00am. Re-enter online or on-site. Cash only (exact change) on-site.
All registration & re-entry closes 1 hour before game.
Bye request/change deadline: 1 hour before first game.
NO CHECK-IN NEEDED if you register online – just show up for your first game.
Campers who pay for tournament at registration should not register separately.

Schedule:

3-day Schedule (5 rounds):

- Friday 6:30pm

- Saturday 1:30pm

- Saturday 6:00pm

- Sunday 9:30am

- Sunday 1:45pm

2-day Schedule (5 rounds):

- Round 1 – Saturday 10:00am (G/60, inc/10)

- Merge with 3-day schedule above starting round 2, Saturday 1:30pm.

Up to two half-point byes available, commit before first round . All byes requested during the tournament are zero points.

Contact:

[email protected] – Chief TD Grant Oen

Notes:

- NO SPECTATORS – during active rounds, parents, spectators, and players that have finished their games are not permitted in the playing room or nearby hallways. Only staff and active players may be in the tournament hall and immediate hallways during play.

- Boards, sets, and clocks are supplied for the tournament only – bring your own for analysis or skittles.

- Withdrawals:
- Cancellations until June 24 may incur a $5 transaction fee.

- 50% refunds after June 24 until 90 minutes before round 1.

- No refunds for cancellations less than 90 minutes before round 1.

- Cancellations, withdrawals, or 0-point byes must be submitted at least 1 hour before the relevant round. Players who “no show” or forfeit a game may incur a $100 fine.

- Fair Play Policy will mirror the Charlotte Chess Center’s FPP – leave cell phones and smart watches in your room or car, or store them in a bag or under your chair during your game. No electronics on your person or in your pocket during play.

- IMPORTANT – due to the FIFA World Cup Games in Atlanta, out-of-town players should make their travel and hotel arrangements soon!

Campers who are playing the tournament should register for the Grand Prix as part of camp registration and continue their room and board plan through the weekend. Or, if you prefer to stay and eat elsewhere, select “camp only” and register for the tournament separately.

https://castlechess.org/grandprix/

Event Overview

5 Round Swiss
Hotel Reservation : $139 per night (Single/Double)
Sets and clocks provided
GM/IM plays for free
Cumulative discounts to the others
Time Controls:
3-Day Option: G/90+30.
2 Day Option: Rounds 1&2: G/75+5, Rounds 3-5: G/90+30
Round Times:
3-Day Schedule: Registration ends at 6 pm Friday
Rounds: Friday 7 pm, Saturday 10-5, Sunday 10:00-4:00
2-Day Schedule: Registration ends at 9 am Saturday.
Rounds: Saturday 10-1:30-5, Sunday 10:00-4:00
FIDE Rated Sections:
Major (1900 and Up USCF or FIDE, 1800 - 1899 may play up with extra $40 EF)
U2200 (1800 - 2199 USCF or FIDE, 1700 - 1799 may play up with extra $40 EF)
USCF Rated Only Sections:
Seniors (Born in or before 1971, under 1800 USCF)
U1900, U1600, U1300, U1000
(unrated players can only join in Seniors, U1300, or U1000)
Prizes
($11,000 b/150 paid entries, 80% prizes guaranteed)
Major: $2000 - $1000 - $500
U2200: $1200 - $600 -$300
U1900: $1000 - $500
U1600: $800 - $400
U1300: $600 - $300
U1000: $400 - $200
Seniors: $600 - $300
Double Bonus Prizes: $200 - $100. Male-Female, Female-Female, or Family 2-player “Teams”, combined scores of all sections, onsite registration OK, no extra fee.
Prizes are not claimed at site, paid through PayPal or Zelle after the tournament within 72 hours.
Blitz Tournament: 5-round Swiss, Saturday June 27 at 9:00 pm, onsite register by 8:30 pm, EF $20 cash only, time control 3+2, up to 80% payout, sets provided, bring your own clocks

Arizona Golden Cup 🏆

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, June 27, 2026

Event Overview

Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish                 Points
1st Place              20
2nd Place            16
3rd Place             13
4th Place             10
5–6                           8
7–10                        5
Participation       3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.

Address: 18440 N. 7th Street Suite 8.

Phoenix , AZ 85022

United States

Entry Fee: $30.00 by 1/28; $35.00 by 1/30; $40.00 same day. Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Over 1200: Cash for top three. 1st - 30%, 2nd - 14%, 3rd - 10%.
Under 1200: Trophy for top three. Trophy for the Best Under 700.

Cincinnati Tornado JUNE. Last Saturday of Month

Wyoming Baptist Church

Saturday, June 27, 2026

Event Overview

Cincinnati Tornado Monthly Tournament
Held on the Last Saturday of the Month
We provide all clocks & chess sets

Advance Entry Fee $45
Online Registration – By Friday 12 midnight deadline
Online Registration:   https://chessearth.com/tornado-registration/
Advance Registration ends on Friday 12 midnight.
NEW OPTION for returning players.   EMAIL or  TEXT MESSAGE  us to pre-register and enter the tournament:

- Email admin@chessearth:   1.) First & Last Name   2.) USCF ID  3.) Section you are playing in  and  4.)  Pay $45 at the Tournament Site

On-Site Entry Fee $50; On-Site Registration – By 9:30am Saturday morning deadline
-  10am First Round.

- On-Site Registration – Ends at 9:30am Saturday morning.     10am First Round.

- Credit Cards, PayPal, Venmo, CashApp, Zelle, Apple Pay accepted on site

- Tournament  Address:    Wyoming Baptist Church, 170 Burns Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45215

4-Round Swiss Tournament
Time Control: G/45 +5; Each player receives 45 minutes with a +5-second increment. A Tornado is a one-day tournament where you play four games. Cash Prizes and Awards are given at the end of the tournament based on your final score.
Round Start Times:
Round #1: 10:00am
Round #2: 12:30pm
Round #3: 2:30pm
Round #4: 4:30pm
Choose a Section To Play In:

- Open Section  -  Includes the Master Bounty Prize - $100

- Under 1600 Section

- Under 1000 Section

- Award Winning Chili.  Good Food; Hot Meals

- Chess Equipment and Merch available to purchase

- USCF Rated Tournament.  Join/Renew USCF on-site.

- Purchase a New Membership at Registration.

- 1/2 Point Bye is available if notified before Round 2.

- Prizes Fund based on 70 players.

- We provide all the Chess Clocks & Chess Sets

Open Section:     **NEW** Rating must be 1600 or above to play in the Open Section.
Or a player can pay $30 to “play up” into the Open Section.
1st – $200      2nd – $150
Top Under 2001   – $100
Top Under 1801   – $100
Includes the Master Bounty Prize - $100

- Master Bounty Prize:  Win your game against the #1 Master in the tournament and win $100. If you draw the Master, win $50.  If the Master wins all the games, then he/she wins the $100.

Under 1600 Section:   The heart of the tournament
1st – $200      2nd – $150
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
Under 1000 Section :  Rating must be lower than 1001. Great for beginners and 1st time tournament players.
1st – $200      2nd – $150
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
Chess Community Gathering

- Hang Out & Analyze;  Play Casual Chess Games in the Skittles room.

- TVs are in the Skittle rooms

- Enjoy Good Food

- Buy Chess Merch

- Watch the Tournament.

- Chess Social Life.

- We are looking for volunteers to help with the clean-up; putting chairs and tables away.  Please email us if you can help.  We appreciate it!!

Event Overview

US Chess Junior Grand Prix
JUNE 29-30, 2026   DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA
18th annual World Open Under 13 Championship . 6-SS, G/60, d10, Omni Shoreham Hotel, 2500 Calvert St., NW, Washington, DC 20008. Hotel valet parking is $45/day Chess rate; see chessevents.us for possible offsite public parking options. Open to all born after 6/30/13. In 3 sections (unrateds allowed any section). Open Section:  Plaques to top 5, top 2 each 1500-1699, Under 1500/Unr; free entry in all CCA over the board tournaments 7/17/26-12/31/26 to 1st, 7/17/26-10/31/26 2nd. Under 1400 Section:  Plaques to top 5, top 2 each 900-1099, Under 900/Unr, free entry in all CCA over the board tournaments 7/17/26-10/31/26 to 1st, 7/17/26-9/30/26 2nd. Under 700 Section: Plaques to top 5, top 2 each 300-499, Under 300, Unrated; free entry in all CCA over the board tournaments 7/17/26-10/31/26 to 1st, 7/17/26-9/30/26 2nd. Free Entry Prize Restrictions:   Some Continental Chess tournaments have minimum rating requirements for their top sections. Other tournaments charge an extra fee, based on a player’s rating, to play in the top sections. Continental Chess free entry prizes do not cover any such additional surcharges for playing in the top section.  Online Entry Fee: $58 at chessaction.com by 6/26, $70 later or at site. Special USCF dues with magazine if paid with online entry: see chessevents.us. USCF membership required.  Reg. ends 10 am 6/29. Rounds: Mon 6/29 11 am, 2 pm, 5 pm; Tue 6/30 10 am, 1 pm, 4 pm. June official ratings used,  unofficial uschess.org or Online Regular USCF ratings usually used if otherwise unrated. Cannot play below USCF  Online Regular Rating - 100 points. Limit of 2 half-point byes, must commit before round 2.  HR: $164-164-164-164, hotel reservation link at chessevents.us (or call 202-234-0700, mention Chess); reserve early, Chess block may sell out by early June or before.  No mail entries. $15 service charge for refunds. Entries posted  at chessaction.com (click “entry list” after entering). Plaques must be claimed at site. Bring set, board, clock if possible- none supplied.

54th Annual World Open (Open through Under 1400 Sections)

Heritage Event, American Classic, Grand Prix, Enhanced Grand Prix, Junior Grand Prix

Omni Shoreham Hotel

Wednesday, July 1, 2026
- Sunday, July 5, 2026

Event Overview

A Heritage Event!
An American Classic!
US Chess Junior Grand Prix

JULY 1-5, 2-5 or 3-5, 2026  DC
US CHESS GRAND PRIX POINTS: 300 (enhanced)
54th Annual World Open, top 6 sections (Open through Under 1400 Sections)
9-SS, Omni Shoreham Hotel, 2500 Calvert St., NW, Washington, DC 20008. Hotel valet parking is $45/day Chess rate; see chessevents.us for possible offsite public parking options. In 6 sections; top 3 are also FIDE rated. $208,000 guaranteed prizes in these sections; see separate TLA for Under 1200 & Under 1000 sections, June 26-28. Ratings used:  July FIDE used in Open. July USCF official used in U2200 to U1400 (unofficial uschess.org or USCF Online Regular Ratings usually used in sections U2200/below if otherwise unrated). Open Section, July 1-5 only:  Open to all rated 2200/over USCF or FIDE (others may also enter, but there is an additional $500 surcharge unless rated 2000/above FIDE or 2200/above USCF), 40/90, SD/30; d30. Under 2200 to Under 1400 Sections, July 1-5, 2-5 or 3-5:  40/90, SD/30; d30 ( 4-day option, rounds 1-2 G/60, d10; 3-day option, rounds 1-5 G/35, d10). Cannot play  below USCF Online Regular Rating minus100 points in Under 2200 to Under 1400 Sections. Open Section Prizes: $20000-10000-5000-2500-1300-1000-800-700-600-500, clear winner bonus $500, top FIDE 2300-2449 $5000-2500-1500, top FIDE 2200-2299 $5000-2500-1500. Top FIDE U2200/Unr $5000-2500-1500. If tie for first in Open Section, top 2 on tiebreak play speed game 10 pm 7/5 for title and bonus prize. GM & IM norms possible. Prizes for U2200 through Under 1400 Sections:  Under 2200:  $12000-6000-3000-1500-1000-800-600-500-400-400, top U2100 (no unr) $2000-1000.   Under 2000: $12000-6000-3000-1500-1000-800-600-500-400-400, top U1900 (no unr) $2000-1000. Under 1800: $12000-6000-3000-1500-1000-800-600-500-400-400, top U1700 (no unr) $2000-1000. Under 1600:  $10000-5000-2500-1300-900-700-600-500-400-400, top U1500 (no unr) $2000-1000. Under 1400: $7000-4000-2000-1200-900-700-600-500-400-400, top U1300 (no unr) $1600-800. Prize limits: 1) If any post-event Regular OTB or Regular Online rating posted 6/29/25-6/29/26, or current Online Regular rating, was more than 40 points over section maximum, prize limit $1000. 2) Players with under 26 lifetime games rated as of July 2026 official list cannot win over $2000 in U1400, $3000 U1600 through U2000. Games rated too late for July official list not counted toward 26 game total. 3) Unrated limit: U1400 $500, U1600 $600, U1800 $800, U2000 $1000, U2200 $1500. 4) Balance of any limited prize goes to next eligible player(s) in line. Mixed Doubles Bonus Prizes:  Best male+female combined 2-player team score in Open through U1400: $2400-1200-700-500-300. Team rating must average under 2200; may play in different sections and schedules; register (no extra fee) before both players begin round 2; at least one player on team must be rated, teams including an unrated limited to $300, other prize limits do not apply to Mixed Doubles Team prizes. Entry fee  for Open through U1400 sections, online at chessaction.com:  $318 by 5/15, $328 by 6/29, $350 at site or online until 90 minutes before round 1. All: $500 extra  to play in Open Section unless rated 2000/above FIDE or  2200/above USCF. No checks, credit cards OK. GMs in Open:  free ( players forfeiting without proper advance notice subject to fine and losing future entry privileges), $200 deducted from prize. IMs, WGMs in Open: EF $100 less; $100 also deducted from prize. Seniors 65/up:  all EF $100 less in U1400 or above sections. No checks , credit cards OK.  Re-entry: $160, no re-entry from Open to Open ($500 extra charge to re-enter Open from lower section unless rated 2000 or above FIDE), no re-entry from U1200 or U1000 to U1400 or above. U1200 or U1000 players may also enter U1400 or above, but not as a re-entry. $20 fee for switching section after 6/29. Special 1 year USCF dues  with magazine if paid online at chessaction.com with entry: see chessevents.us .  5-day schedule: 7/1 7 pm; 7/2-3 11 am & 6 pm; 7/4-5 10 am & 5 pm. 4-day schedule: 7/2 11 am, 2:30 & 6 pm; 7/3 11 & 6; 7/4-5 10 & 5. 3-day schedule: 7/3 11 am, 1:30, 3:30, 6 & 8:30 pm; 7/4-5 10 & 5. All schedules in U1400 to U2200  merge & compete for same prizes within the section. Half point byes  OK all rounds, limit of 3 (limit 2 in last 4 rounds), must commit before round 4. Entries, re-entries close 90 minutes before round. HR: $169-169-169-169, hotel reservation link at chessevents.us (or call 202-234-0700, mention Chess); reserve early, Chess block may sell out by early June or before. Parking: See chessevents.us for possible offsite parking options. Special car rental  rates: Avis, 800-331-1600, AWD #D657633, or reserve car online through chesstour.com. Special rules:  Players may not possess cellphones during play; see devicerules.com. Enter online: chessaction.com.  No mail entry. Questions:  chesstour.com, [email protected] . $15 service charge  for refunds.  Entries  posted at chessaction.com (click “entry list” after entering).  Prizes not claimed at site  are usually paid through PayPal (may take about 3 weeks). Bring set, board, clock  if possible- no equipment supplied (about 10 top boards in Open Section assigned to DGT boards per round).  Invitations: [email protected] .

Washington , DC 20008

United States

Monthly Saturday Swiss

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, July 4, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com.  USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by Wednesday; $30 by Friday; $35 same day.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 2:30 PM, Round 2- 3:35 PM, Round 3- 4:40 PM, Round 4- 5:45 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

2026 Kansas Blitz Championship

State Championship Event

Nguyen Golden Hotel and Conference Center

Friday, July 10, 2026

Event Overview

Kansas Blitz Championship
Friday, July 10
Nguyen Golden Hotel and Conference Center
Registration:
Advance  at https://www.kingregistration.com/event/KSBlitz26 by July 9 by midnight.
Onsite: 6 – 6:30 pm
Entry Fee:
Advance
$25 (or combine with KS Open for $70 by 7/8 midnight),
$10 Scholastic, not eligible for prizes. .
Late/Onsite:
$35,  $15 Scholastic not eligible for prizes.
Memberships:
USCF and KCA memberships are required, OSA
Rounds :
Five-round double swiss (10 games in total).
First round 7 PM, rounds runs immediately upon completion of prior round
Time control
G/5;d0. USCF Blitz rules.  Bring a chess clock, may forfeit without clock
Prize Fund: (based on 40 non-scholastic players)
1st $200, 2nd $120, 3rd $80,
U2000 $60, U1700 $50, U1400/Unr. $40
1st Scholastic Plaque
Bonus $25 and plaque to Kansas Blitz Champion. (Kansas Resident)
Blitz Link:      https://www.kingregistration.com/event/KSBlitz26

Wichita , KS 67209

United States
