CCCA - July '26 Chess Tournament and League

Columbia County Library, Room A

Saturday, July 11, 2026

Event Overview

Join the Columbia County Chess Association for our monthly chess tournament as a part of the year-long running Chess League. Each League Tournament will consist of 4 Rounds G/35;+5 games, Swiss style tournaments at the Columbia County Library with three sections; Open, U1300 and U800. Section Prizes are increased this year with $700 between the three sections (based on 20 Registrants).
Compete in as many or as few Chess League events, earning points throughout the year. The top 12 players from each section will be invited to the Chess League round-robin tournament at the conclusion of the regular season to determine the Chess League Champion!
Season Pass and Multi-month registration discounts available.
Free Casual play will be available in the Library Cafe.
https://columbiacountychessclub.com/2026-registration/

Address: 7022 Evans Town Center Blvd

Room # A

Evans , GA 30809

United States

Sections: 3

Prize Fund: $700
FIDE Rated: No
Handicap Accessible: Yes
Residency Restriction: No
Online Event: No

Game 40 Challenge

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, July 11, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 40 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700, Under 1200 & Under 700. No playing up allowed for Open and U1700. Players Under 700 can play in the U1200 Section. Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:30 AM, Round 3- 12:00 PM, Round 4- 1:30 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point Bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Contact: Liulia Cardona at [email protected] or (602) 402-4985
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Entry Fee: $30.00 by Wednesday; $35 by Friday; $40 same day. Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Evanston 3x3 July

Levy Activity Center

Saturday, July 11, 2026

Event Overview

3SS G/60, delay 5. USCF Dual Rated
Open to players who are EITHER age 14 and older OR whose US Chess Current Published Regular Rating for the month of the tournament is 900 or higher.
US Chess Membership is required.
Three Sections
Section Gold: 1700 and over (1600 - 1699 may play up to Gold)
Section Silver:  1200-1699 (1100 - 1199 may play up to Silver)
Section Bronze: U1200 and unrated
Sections may be combined at TD discretion.  IMPORTANT:  We use the US Chess Current Published Regular rating for the month of the tournament to place players in sections. We don’t make exceptions.
Junior players: Junior players (under fourteen years) rated 900+ are welcome. Must be accompanied by an adult throughout the event. We do not accept junior players rated under 900.
Three rounds. Digital clocks are required and will be set to G/60, delay 5. You may take one half-point bye in round 1 or 2.
Prizes: Your prize is an excellent playing experience at a reasonable cost. We've been running these since 2007 and people like playing here.
Entry fee is $20. Please pre-register and pay here    when registration opens. Online registration closes when the tournament is full; we don’t have a wait list; we reopen registration if spaces become available.
On-Site Entries:  Check evanstonchess.org the morning of the tournament. If space is available on-site entries are $20 cash on an as-available basis starting at 9:00 a.m.
Master and Expert Entries:  First two Masters or Experts who sign up get free entry. If your USCF or FIDE regular rating is 2000 or higher, email your name and USCF ID to [email protected] by 5 p.m. the Tuesday before the tournament to pre-register.

Schedule:
Check-in and On-site Registration  from 9:00 to 9:30 AM.
Players must check in on the posted registration list by 9:30 am; players who don’t check in receive a half-point bye for the first round or will be paired with another late arrival.
First Round 9:50 am, last round over roughly 5:00 pm.
Bring your lunch!  We will have a brief lunch break with no time to go out for food. On-site we have vending machine snacks, coffee and soft drinks.
Other information: Sets supplied. Bring digital delay clocks. Wheelchair accessible. No Smoking. Limit 50 players.

Evanston , IL 60202

United States

Tunnelvision XLVI

Columbia Chess Club

Saturday, July 11, 2026

Event Overview

The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision XLVI
July 11, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until midnight on the Thursday before the tournament.  $50 late registration thereafter.  Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes.  If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament?  Great!  We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff. Players may use either their live standard rating or live quick rating to play in a higher section. Players may not play in a section lower than permitted by their published standard rating.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit  https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Rules Note: Per USCF Rule 28T, the pairing system will avoid pairing players registered under the same team during the first-half of the event.
Live Standings/Pairings/Boards
The top board of each section will be live streamed to the DGT LiveCloud along with real-time updates to Lichess.org and Chess.com.  A live video stream of the top Championship board will also be available on the club's Twitch page.  See this site's "Live" menu for links.
Live standings (including current pre-registration information) and pairings are also available below.
Live Standings
Prizes
$1000 Prize Fund Guaranteed.
Championship (1600+)
$400 Fund. 1st: $200; 2nd: $130; 3rd: $70
Under 1600
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Under 1000
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Schedule

- Round 1: 10:30 a.m.

- Round 2: 12:50 p.m.

- Round 3: 2:40 p.m.

- Round 4: 4:30 p.m.

Byes
A single half-point bye is available any round, including the final round.  The half-point bye may be requested as a part of the advance entry or on site before the tournament starts.  Thereafter the only bye available is a zero-point bye.  The chief tournament director shall have the ability to grant a half-point bye for any round on unusual circumstances.
Location
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd., Ste A
Columbia, SC 29212
Questions?
Email  [email protected] or call/text James Brandmair at 803.569.0938.
Parking
The Columbia Chess Club is located in a shopping center with ample parking.
Food
The Columbia Chess Club offers on-site concessions, including drinks and snacks.  By the Fire Pizza and Zorba's Restaurant are located in the same shopping center and will be open during the tournament.  Many other restaurants are available close by!

Semper Primus Chess Camp (Open to all K-12)

Millersville University

Sunday, July 12, 2026
- Friday, July 17, 2026

Event Overview

HAVE FUN AND PLAY CHESS!!!
PERFECT OPPORTUNITY TO MAKE FRIENDS!!!!!
https://www.semperprimuschesscamp.com/
Semper Primus Chess Camp is tailored to students entering K-12th grade . All camp Tournaments are Rated .
Overview:
We are an overnight chess camp focused on allowing campers to play and learn about the game we love. Our goal is to bring campers of varying ages and levels together to foster both chess skills and community.
When:

- General camp length will be from July 12th – July 17th and July 26th – July 29th (Two great options!)

- Campers will have the option to attend camp for 5 or 3 days for the July 12th-17th camp.

- Extra day (July 18th) checkout option will be available to campers, as a tournament will be held on July 18th.

Where:

- Millersville University, Pennsylvania

- Campers have the option to stay in the suites (5th-12th grade), stay in the suites with a parent/guardian (K-4th grade), or commute (K-12th grade).

- Double Suite and Single Suite accommodations.

Itinerary:

- Campers will have plenty of events to play and compete in.

- Recreational activities will be provided in addition to chess to allow campers to rest their minds and relax.

- Two daily rated tournaments.

- Evening events may include sports, non-chess activities, Blitz, or quick chess.

- Freedom of choice is a standard, with camp counselors staying on site 24 hours a day.

- Formats include Swiss, Quads, and Blitz.

- Master Instruction
​o We will have masters that provide analysis on your games.
​o Daily group lessons on tactics, strategy, openings, and endgames.
o Instruction will be an elective rather than a mandated event.

Note To Parents:
First, I’d like to thank you for considering our Chess Camp. As a father of four I know how important it is to provide them with opportunities to grow. I grew up with 2 brothers and 2 sisters and it was my oldest brother who was born with cerebral palsy that introduced me and taught me the game of chess.
I decided to start up this camp because in my own search for a chess camp had a hard time finding one that allowed for campers to have a full overnight experience, let alone on a college campus. I wanted to have an overnight camp as I find in my dealings with this younger generation that they could use some more time around their peers and making new friends.
I expect to continue to improve the instruction and development of these young minds by bringing in quality Masters who can better their game. I am pleased to already have some talented Masters for or 2024 staff. All chess tournaments are run by a USCF Tournament Director.
Our staff includes a Director, an Assistant Director, a Tournament Director, 3-4 Masters and camp counselors. We typically have a 1/10 ratio of counselors and campers in the suites.
Campers entering 5th through 12th grade may stay in the dorms on their own, while K-4th graders must have a parent/guardian accompanying them. We are equipped to host parents that may want to stay in the area for the week if you don’t mind a suite. Options for 5 night or 3 night stays are available, along with a commuting option. The added day on the registration was designed for parents that don’t want to or can’t pick up their child on Friday but would prefer a Saturday pick up.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me directly.

Brian D. Smith
Director

Free parking. $30,000 guaranteed prizes. In 7 sections:  Master (2100/up): $3000-1500-800-500, clear/tiebreak win $100, top USCF U2400 $1200-600. FIDE. Expert  (1900-2199): $2000-1000-600-400. FIDE. Class A  (1700-1999/Unr): $2000-1000-600-400. FIDE. Class B (1500-1799/Unr): $2000-1000-600-400. Class C (1300-1599/Unr): $1700-900-500-300. Class D  (Under 1400/Unr): $1400-700-500-300. Online entry :  chessaction.com. No mail entries. $15 service charge for refunds. Unclaimed prizes at site usually paid by PayPal (may take about 3 weeks). Phoenix Saturday Action

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, July 18, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:05 AM, Round 3- 11:10 AM, Round 4- 12:15 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by 07/15; $30 by 07/17; $35 same day. Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Westin Chicago North Shore Hotel

Event Overview

JULY 18, 2026  ILLINOIS
US Chess Grand Prix points 10 (enhanced)
11th annual Chicago Class Blitz Championship
4-SS, G/3 d2, double round (8 games), Westin Chicago North Shore Hotel, 601 N Milwaukee Avenue, Wheeling IL 60090 (from Chicago, I-294 north to US-45 north; from Milwaukee, I-94 to Lake Cook Rd to US-45 south). Enter by 9:10 pm. Round 1 begins 9:30 pm, then ASAP, should end by 11:30 pm. One pair of half-point byes  allowed in any round, must commit before round 2. Blitz rated (will not affect regular ratings); higher of Regular or Blitz used for pairings and prizes. $10 service charge for refunds before Rd. 1 pairings. No equipment supplied.

Event Overview

Date: July 24th - 26th, 2026 (Friday through Sunday)
Location: TCC-Bellaire | 4007 Bellaire Blvd, Suite HH, Houston, TX 77025
Sections: Championship & U1800 & (U1400 section, USCF rated only )
Time Control: G/90;+30
3 Day Schedule: July 24th - 26th, 2026
Friday: Round 1 @ 7:00PM
Saturday: Round 2 @ 2:00PM, Round 3 @ 7:00PM
Sunday: Round 4 @ 10:00AM, Round 5 @ 3:00PM
2 Day Schedule: July 25th - 26th, 2026
Saturday: Round 1 @ 9:00 AM, Round 2 @ 2:00PM, Round 3 @ 7:00PM
Sunday: Round 4 @ 10:00AM, Round 5 @ 3:00PM
Championship Section Registration:
Early Bird: $108 before or on 06/12
Regular Fee: $123 before or on 07/14
Late fee: $138
U1800 Section Registration:
Early Bird Price: $88 before or on 06/12
Regular Price: $103 before or on 07/14
Late Price: $118
U1400 Section Registration (US Chess Rated Only):
Early Bird Price: $78 before or on 06/12
Regular Price: $93 before or on 07/14
Late Price: $108
Prizes (All Prizes Guaranteed):
Championship - 1st: $640, 2nd: $320, 3rd: $160
U1800 - 1st: $240, 2nd: $120, 3rd: $60
U1400 - 1st, 2nd, 3rd - Trophies
First three GM/IMs to enter get a minimum prize of $200(GM)/$100(IM), valid until late fee deadline; must play all rounds. FM+ are free before late fee deadline. Please email [email protected] for entry under these conditions.
How do I get a FIDE ID? Play in one of our FIDE tournaments and fill the registration form and we’ll take care of it for you. Alternatively, you can contact USCF and request an ID as well. However, to be officially FIDE rated, one must play five games against previously rated FIDE players, score at least a half point in those games, and have a performance rating of at least 1400. USCF monthly ratings used for pairings. Default late forfeiture time is one hour. Re-entry is available for half the late fee price.

Heritage Event, Grand Prix, Enhanced Grand Prix, Junior Grand Prix

Sheraton Hartford Hotel at Bradley Aiport

Friday, July 24, 2026
- Sunday, July 26, 2026

Event Overview

A Heritage Event
US Chess Junior Grand Prix
JULY 24-26 OR 25-26, 2026   CONNECTICUT
US CHESS GRAND PRIX POINTS: 120 (ENHANCED)
31st Annual Bradley Open
5-SS, 40/80, SD/30; d30 (2-day option, rounds 1-2 G/60, d10). Sheraton Hartford Hotel at Bradley Aiport, 1 Bradley Airport, Windsor Locks CT 06096. I-91 Exit 40 (visible at airport entrance). Chess rate parking: $5/day, $10 overnight.  $15,000 guaranteed prizes!   In 5 sections.   Major  (1900/over; see peakrating.us): $2000-1000-600-400, clear/tiebreak winner $100 bonus, top USCF U2300 $600-300. FIDE.  Under 2100:  $1000-500-300-200, top U1900/Unr $400-200. FIDE.  Under 1800:  $1000-500-300-200, top U1600 (no Unr) $400-200.  Under 1500:  $800-450-300-200, top U1300 (no Unr) $300-150.  Under 1200:  $600-400-200-100, top U1000 (no Unr) $200-100.  Unrated  limit $100 in U1200, $200 U1500, $400 U1800. World Open Rule: Players who scored 8 or more points in 2026 World Open U2200 or below must enter higher section than in World Open. Mixed Doubles Bonus Prizes:  top male+female combined score among all sections $500-300-200 (teams must have at least one rated player, unrated prize limits do not apply to Mixed Doubles prizes), must average under 2200, may play any sections and schedules, reg. (no extra fee) at site by 2 pm Sat.  Top 4 sections Online entry:  $118 at chessaction.com by 7/21, $130 later or at site until 1 hour before round 1.  U1200 Section EF:  $10 less than above.  No checks at site,  credit cards OK. GMs $100 from prize. CSCA or WMCA members, online EF $3 less. Re-entry $60, no Major to Major. July official ratings used, unofficial USCF ratings  or USCF Online Regular ratings   usually used if otherwise unrated.  May not play below USCF Online Regular Rating - 100 points.  Special 1 year USCF dues with magazine if paid online with entry: see chessevents.us.  3-day schedule:  Reg ends Fri 6 pm, rds. Fri 7, Sat 11 & 5, Sun 10 & 3:30.  2-day schedule:  Reg ends Sat 10 am, rds. Sat 11, 2 & 5, Sun 10 & 3:30.  Bye:  all, limit 2; must commit before round 2.  HR:  $169-169, use link at chessevents.us or 860-627-5311; reserve by 7/9 or rate may increase.  Online entry: chessaction.com.  No mail entry. $15 service charge for refunds. Prizes not claimed at site usually paid by PayPal (may take about 3 weeks). Questions: [email protected] ,  chesstour.com. Electronic Devices Rules (all sections)
Do not bring electronic devices (cell phones and smart watches) into the playing venue (playing room, halls outside playing room, smoking area, bathrooms, etc) according to FIDE rule 11.3. Players are subject to scanning to test for possession of cell phones. We plan to monitor using both thermal and magnetic scanners. Traffic in various areas will also be video monitored. You can store your phone in one of our cell phone lockers.
Possession of a device

- Forfeit of the game and potential expulsion for tournament.

Parking Information
Parking is $15/night for overnight guests. It is $6 for day guests. You should validate your ticket at the front desk.

- If both players are not present at the start of the round, the tournament director will start white's clock.

- Any player forfeiting a round must pay a $50 fine before being allowed to play in a future tournament organized by MCA or Baltimore Chess.

- No show forfeit time for all sections is one hour

- The electronic score keeping devices, ChessNoteR and eNotate, cannot be used at this tournament.

- Players with byes who are eligible to play in a lower section that also has a bye player may get paired in that section as a house player. They will still have the bye for standings in their original section. The game in the lower section does count for standings and must be played.

Arizona Golden Cup 🏆

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, August 22, 2026

Event Overview

Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish                 Points
1st Place              20
2nd Place            16
3rd Place             13
4th Place             10
5–6                           8
7–10                        5
Participation       3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.

Address: 18440 N. 7th Street Suite 8.

Phoenix , AZ 85022

United States

Semper Primus Chess Camp (Open to all K-12)

Millersville University

Sunday, July 26, 2026
- Wednesday, July 29, 2026

Event Overview

HAVE FUN AND PLAY CHESS!!!
PERFECT OPPORTUNITY TO MAKE FRIENDS!!!!!
https://www.semperprimuschesscamp.com/
Semper Primus Chess Camp is tailored to students entering K-12th grade . All camp Tournaments are Rated .
Overview:
We are an overnight chess camp focused on allowing campers to play and learn about the game we love. Our goal is to bring campers of varying ages and levels together to foster both chess skills and community.
When:

- General camp length will be from July 12th – July 17th and July 26th – July 29th (Two great options!)

- Campers will have the option to attend camp for 5 or 3 days for the July 12th-17th camp.

- Extra day (July 18th) checkout option will be available to campers, as a tournament will be held on July 18th.

Where:

- Millersville University, Pennsylvania

- Campers have the option to stay in the suites (5th-12th grade), stay in the suites with a parent/guardian (K-4th grade), or commute (K-12th grade).

- Double Suite and Single Suite accommodations.

Itinerary:

- Campers will have plenty of events to play and compete in.

- Recreational activities will be provided in addition to chess to allow campers to rest their minds and relax.

- Two daily rated tournaments.

- Evening events may include sports, non-chess activities, Blitz, or quick chess.

- Freedom of choice is a standard, with camp counselors staying on site 24 hours a day.

- Formats include Swiss, Quads, and Blitz.

- Master Instruction
​o We will have masters that provide analysis on your games.
​o Daily group lessons on tactics, strategy, openings, and endgames.
o Instruction will be an elective rather than a mandated event.

Note To Parents:
First, I’d like to thank you for considering our Chess Camp. As a father of four I know how important it is to provide them with opportunities to grow. I grew up with 2 brothers and 2 sisters and it was my oldest brother who was born with cerebral palsy that introduced me and taught me the game of chess.
I decided to start up this camp because in my own search for a chess camp had a hard time finding one that allowed for campers to have a full overnight experience, let alone on a college campus. I wanted to have an overnight camp as I find in my dealings with this younger generation that they could use some more time around their peers and making new friends.
I expect to continue to improve the instruction and development of these young minds by bringing in quality Masters who can better their game. I am pleased to already have some talented Masters for or 2024 staff. All chess tournaments are run by a USCF Tournament Director.
Our staff includes a Director, an Assistant Director, a Tournament Director, 3-4 Masters and camp counselors. We typically have a 1/10 ratio of counselors and campers in the suites.
Campers entering 5th through 12th grade may stay in the dorms on their own, while K-4th graders must have a parent/guardian accompanying them. We are equipped to host parents that may want to stay in the area for the week if you don’t mind a suite. Options for 5 night or 3 night stays are available, along with a commuting option. The added day on the registration was designed for parents that don’t want to or can’t pick up their child on Friday but would prefer a Saturday pick up.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me directly.

Brian D. Smith
Director

2026 Charlotte Summer Open

Grand Prix

Hilton Garden Inn - Southpark

Friday, July 31, 2026
- Sunday, August 2, 2026

Event Overview

https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/summeropen

OVERVIEW
The Charlotte Summer Open is a 5 round classical event with a $6000 guaranteed prize fund - $5,500 in the main event plus a FREE $500 Saturday evening Blitz tournament! All sections are US Chess and FIDE rated. There is a minimum rating of 1200 and registration cap of 140 players - we expect to sell out so please register well in advance.

WHEN
July 31 - August 2, 2026
​

WHERE
Beautiful Venue in the Heart of Southpark! Walk to Starbucks, Whole Foods and more!
Hilton Garden Inn - Southpark
4808 Sharon Road
Charlotte, NC 28210
(704) 362-5080
​

​ HOTEL BOOKING

Both hotel options attached to the playing venue.
Please email us if the booking links are not showing the correct rate.

Hilton Garden Inn - Southpark
$134 per night single or $149 for double
Free internet and parking
Booking Link Coming Soon - Reserve ASAP

Homewood Suites - Southpark
Overflow hotel, attached to official venue
King Suites only - larger rooms with pullout sofa bed, full kitchen, dining table
$152 for King suite
Free internet and parking
Booking Link Coming Soon - Reserve ASAP

ELIGIBILITY

- Must be members of US Chess.

- There is a USCF rating minimum of 1200  to enter, based on the July supplement or a peak rating since June 1.

- There is a registration cap of 140 players.

SCHEDULE
3-Day Schedule - 5 Rounds
Friday: 6:30pm
Saturday: 10:30am & 4:00pm
Sunday: 10:00am & 3:00pm
​
2-Day Schedule - 5 Rounds
Saturday: 10:30am*, 1:00pm*, 4:00pm
Sunday: 10:00am & 3:00pm
​
*Rounds 1-2 of 2-Day Schedule played at G/30; inc/10 time control, then merge with 3-day schedule, Saturday 4:00pm

TIME CONTROLS
3-Day Schedule:  G/110, inc/10
Rounds 1-2 of 2-day Schedule: G/30, inc/10

PRIZES AND SECTIONS
$5,500 Guaranteed Prize Fund in 3 Sections

Championship Section  -  FIDE Rated - 40 US Chess Grand Prix Points
$1200 - $600 - $300
Top U2200: $400
​
Under 2000 Section  -  FIDE Rated
$700 - $400 - $200
Top U1800: $300
​
Under 1600 Section  - FIDE Rated
$600 - $300 - $200
Top U1400: $300

Minimum rating of 1200.

100-point rule  applies for "playing up" a section - see Special Notes at bottom of page.

ENTRY FEE
$135 by July 15
$150 after July 15

GM/IM/WGMs: Free, no deduction from prize if registered by June 22, otherwise $130 deducted from prize.

SUMMER OPEN BLITZ (FREE)

- Saturday 8/1, 8:30-10:15pm

- Blitz Registration On-site only, Saturday 4:30-8:15pm – No online blitz registration

- Free blitz entry for players in the Charlotte Summer Open.

- Open to all players - $30 on-site blitz entry for those not in the Summer Open.

- 6 (single) Rounds – USCF regular ratings used for pairings/prizes.

- $500 guaranteed prize fund in one section with class prizes.

- US Chess and FIDE blitz rated. US Chess membership required.

Heritage Event, Grand Prix, Enhanced Grand Prix, Junior Grand Prix

Hilton Orange County Airport Hotel

Friday, July 31, 2026
- Sunday, August 2, 2026

Event Overview

A Heritage Event!
US Chess Junior Grand Prix
JULY 31 - AUGUST 2 OR AUGUST 1-2, 2026    CALIFORNIA, SOUTHERN
US CHESS GRAND PRIX POINTS: 150 (ENHANCED)
31ST ANNUAL PACIFIC COAST OPEN
6-SS, 40/80, SD/30; d30 (2-day option, rounds 1-3 G/35, d10), Hilton Orange County Airport, 18800 Macarthur Blvd, Irvine CA 92612. Parking $20/day Chess rate. Free airport shuttle, pool, whirlpool, fitness center. $30,000 guaranteed prizes! In 7 sections; Premier and Under 2100 are also FIDE rated. Premier: Open to 2000/over (see  peakrating.us ). $3000-1500-1000-700, clear/tiebreak 1st $100 bonus, top USCF U2300 $1400-700. Under 2100, Under 1900: Each $2000-1000-600-400. Under 1700, Under 1500, Under 1300: Each $1600-800-500-300. Under 1000: $1000-500-300-200.  Mixed Doubles Bonus prizes:  Best male+female 2-player team combined score among all sections: $1000-500-300-200. Team rating must average under 2200; may play different sections, schedules; register (no extra fee) before both players begin round 2. Cannot play below  USCF Online Regular Rating - 100 points. World Open Rule:  players who scored 8 or more points in 2026 World Open U2200 or below must enter higher section than in World Open. Unrated prize limits: U1000 $150, U1300 $250, U1500 $350, U1700 $500, U1900 $700; balance of any limited prize goes to next eligible player(s) in line. Top 6 sections online Entry Fee: $158 at  chessaction.com by 7/28, $180 later or at site until 1 hour before round 1 (no checks, credit cards OK), GMs $150 from prize.  Under 1000 Section EF: All $20 less than top 6 sections entry fees. Online EF $5 less to SCCF members; join/renew at  scchess.com . Re-entry (no Premier to Premier) $70.  August Official ratings used, unofficial or Online Regular  uschess.org ratings usually used if otherwise unrated. Foreign player ratings: See foreignratings.com. Special 1-year USCF dues  with magazine if paid online with entry: see chessevents.us. 3-day schedule:  Reg. Fri to 11 am, rounds Fri 12 & 6, Sat 11 & 5, Sun 10 & 3:30. 2-day schedule: Reg Sat to 9 am, rounds Sat 10, 12:15, 2:30 & 5, Sun 10 & 3:30. All: Half point byes OK all rounds, limit 2, must commit before round 3. Electronic devices: See: devicerules.com. Prizes not claimed at site usually paid by PayPal; may take about 3 weeks. HR: $184-184-184-184, use link at  chessevents.us   (or call 949-833-9999 and request chess rate), reserve by 7/9 or rate may increase. Car rental: Avis, 800-331-1600, use AWD #D657633. Entry:   chessaction.com . No mail entries. Refunds, $15 service charge.  Questions:  www.chesstour.com , [email protected] .  Entries posted at  chessaction.com (click “entry list” after entry).   Blitz tournament Sat 9:30 pm, enter at site Sat. by 9:10 pm.  Bring set, board, clock  if possible- none supplied.

Irvine , CA 92612

United States

Shenandoah Open 2026

The Comfort Inn Monticello

Friday, July 31, 2026
- Sunday, August 2, 2026

Event Overview

Register here: https://caissachess.net/online-registration/index/8500 . Registration closes exactly 1 hour before the start of round 1:
Where: The Comfort Inn Monticello, 2097 Inn Drive, Charlottesville, VA 22911
Hotel booking link with chess rate($109 + taxes)   https://www.choicehotels.com/reservations/groups/ZL28H0
Schedule:  Round 1 Friday, 7pm. Rd. 2 Saturday, 11am and Rd. 3, 4pm. Rd. 4 Sunday, 10am and Rd. 5, 3pm.
Time Control:  5 rounds of G90+30s increment per move.
Sections:  Championship (minimum rating of 1500 USCF),  (U1600-900),  (U1000/UNRATED).
Prize fund:  $5000, based on 100 entries.
Championship (USCF 1500 minimum): 1st $ 1200, 2nd $600, 3rd $300. Top U-2000 $200. Top U-1800 $200. U1600 (USCF 900 minimum). 1st $700, 2nd $400, 3rd $200. Top U-1300 $200. U1000/UNRATED: 1st $500, 2nd $300, 3rd $200. Trophies for top 3 scholastic players in the U1000 section. Medals for all scholastic players in the U1000 section.
Entry Fee:  $100 by May 1st. $110 May 1st - July 17th. $120 after July 17th.
Amenities: Free Parking, all equipment provided, merchandise available, water, coffee and light snacks during games. Casual social event on Saturday evening at the local Dairy Market.
Withdrawals: If you need to withdraw before the tournament, please contact the Charlottesville Chess Club email (see below). A $10 refund fee applies to all refunds. Refunds are not available after the event starts.
Unrated Players: Must play in the U1000 section unless granted special permission by tournament director. Unrated players are only eligible for 50% of any cash prize earned.
Byes: Players may request a maximum of 2 half point (0.5) byes. Bye requests must be placed before July 31st at 11:59pm.
Forfeits: 30-minute no-show policy. The game will be considered a forfeit exactly 30 minutes after the round start time.
Cell phone/device policy: possession of a device that makes a noise during the game will result in an automatic forfeit.
Media policy: Charlottesville Chess Club uses media platforms to promote the club. By registering for this event, I consent to appear in the Club's social media and website posts.
Contact:  For questions, or withdrawals prior to the event, email:  Click here to show mail address

Join the Columbia County Chess Association for our monthly chess tournament as a part of the year-long running Chess League. Each League Tournament will consist of 4 Rounds G/35;+5 games, Swiss style tournaments at the Columbia County Library with three sections; Open, U1300 and U800. Section Prizes are increased this year with $700 between the three sections (based on 20 Registrants).
Compete in as many or as few Chess League events, earning points throughout the year. The top 12 players from each section will be invited to the Chess League round-robin tournament at the conclusion of the regular season to determine the Chess League Champion!
Season Pass and Multi-month registration discounts available.
Free Casual play will be available in the Library Cafe.

Monthly Saturday Swiss

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, August 1, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com.  USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by Wednesday; $30 by Friday; $35 same day.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 2:30 PM, Round 2- 3:35 PM, Round 3- 4:40 PM, Round 4- 5:45 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

12th Annual Pacific Coast Open Blitz Championship

Grand Prix, Enhanced Grand Prix

Hilton Orange County Airport Hotel

Saturday, August 1, 2026

Event Overview

AUGUST 1, 2026  CALIFORNIA SOUTHERN
US Chess Grand Prix points 10 (enhanced)
12th annual Pacific Coast Open Blitz Championship
4-SS, G/3 d2, double round (8 games), Hilton Orange County Airport, 18800 Macarthur Blvd, Irvine CA 92612. Parking $20/day chess rate.  $500 guaranteed prizes:  $150-100, top Under 2300 $72, Under 2000 $70, Under 1700/Unr. $60, Under 1400 $48. Entry fee (Sat. night at site only): $20, no checks. GMs $20 from prize. Enter by 9:10 pm. Round 1 begins 9:30 pm, then ASAP, should end by 11:30 pm. One pair of half-point byes  allowed in any round, must commit before round 2. Blitz rated (will not affect regular ratings); higher of August Regular or Blitz used for pairings and prizes. $10 service charge for refunds before Round 1 pairings (no refunds after Round 1 is paired). No equipment supplied.

Game 40 Challenge

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, August 8, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 40 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700, Under 1200 & Under 700. No playing up allowed for Open and U1700. Players Under 700 can play in the U1200 Section. Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:30 AM, Round 3- 12:00 PM, Round 4- 1:30 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point Bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Contact: Liulia Cardona at [email protected] or (602) 402-4985
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Entry Fee: $30.00 by Wednesday; $35 by Friday; $40 same day. Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Address: 18440 N. 7th Street Suite 8.

Phoenix , AZ 85022

United States

Tunnelvision XLVII

Columbia Chess Club

Saturday, August 8, 2026

Event Overview

The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision XLVII
August 8, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until midnight on the Thursday before the tournament.  $50 late registration thereafter.  Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes.  If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament?  Great!  We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff. Players may use either their live standard rating or live quick rating to play in a higher section. Players may not play in a section lower than permitted by their published standard rating.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit  https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Rules Note: Per USCF Rule 28T, the pairing system will avoid pairing players registered under the same team during the first-half of the event.
Live Standings/Pairings/Boards
The top board of each section will be live streamed to the DGT LiveCloud along with real-time updates to Lichess.org and Chess.com.  A live video stream of the top Championship board will also be available on the club's Twitch page.  See this site's "Live" menu for links.
Live standings (including current pre-registration information) and pairings are also available below.
Live Standings
Prizes
$1000 Prize Fund Guaranteed.
Championship (1600+)
$400 Fund. 1st: $200; 2nd: $130; 3rd: $70
Under 1600
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Under 1000
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Schedule

- Round 1: 10:30 a.m.

- Round 2: 12:50 p.m.

- Round 3: 2:40 p.m.

- Round 4: 4:30 p.m.

Byes
A single half-point bye is available any round, including the final round.  The half-point bye may be requested as a part of the advance entry or on site before the tournament starts.  Thereafter the only bye available is a zero-point bye.  The chief tournament director shall have the ability to grant a half-point bye for any round on unusual circumstances.
Location
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd., Ste A
Columbia, SC 29212
Questions?
Email  [email protected] or call/text James Brandmair at 803.569.0938.
Parking
The Columbia Chess Club is located in a shopping center with ample parking.
Food
The Columbia Chess Club offers on-site concessions, including drinks and snacks.  By the Fire Pizza and Zorba's Restaurant are located in the same shopping center and will be open during the tournament.  Many other restaurants are available close by!

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.

Arizona Golden Cup 🏆

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, August 22, 2026

Event Overview

Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish                 Points
1st Place              20
2nd Place            16
3rd Place             13
4th Place             10
5–6                           8
7–10                        5
Participation       3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.

Phoenix , AZ 85022

United States

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, August 22, 2026

Event Overview

FREE Pizza and drinks for those playing in the Golden Cup tournament in the morning!
6 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 5 minutes. Boards, sets and clocks will be provided.
Sections: Under 1200 and Over 1200. No playing up allowed! Highest USCF rating between Regular, Quick, and Blitz will be used for sections.
Schedule: Round 1- 2:30 PM, Round 2- 2:45 PM, Round 3- 3:00 PM, Round 4- 3:15 PM. Round 5- 3:30 PM, Round 6- 3:45 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 6 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point Bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Entry Fee: $30.00 by 1/28; $35.00 by 1/30; $40.00 same day. Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Over 1200: Cash for top three. 1st - 30%, 2nd - 14%, 3rd - 10%.
Under 1200: Trophy for top three. Trophy for the Best Under 700.

Game 60 Challenge

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, August 29, 2026

Event Overview

CASH PRIZES!!!
Four round Swiss. Time control: Game in 60 minutes with 5 sec increment. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Renewals are available at the site. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200. No Playing up allowed! Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.
Schedule: Check in and register until 8:45 AM. Rounds start at 9:00 AM- 11:20 AM- 1:40 PM- 4:00 PM. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds (Max 2). All byes must be requested before the start of round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Entry Fee: Open & U1700: $40 by 08/26; $45 by 08/28; $50 Same Day. U1200: $30 by 08/26; $35 by 08/28; $40 Same Day. Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Open & U1700: 1st - 30%, 2nd - 14%, 3rd - 10%. Under 1200: Trophies for Top 3.

Address: 18440 N. 7th Street Suite 8.

Phoenix , AZ 85022

United States

Grand Prix, Enhanced Grand Prix, Junior Grand Prix, State Championship Event

DoubleTree by Hilton Lisle-Naperville

Thursday, September 3, 2026
- Monday, September 7, 2026

Event Overview

2026 Illinois Open State Championship
September 3rd - Sep. 7th, 2026
DoubleTree by Hilton Lisle Naperville
3003 Corporate W Dr, Lisle, IL 60532
Event run by the organizers of the Chicago Summer Open, King Registration and Wilson Chess
Out of State Players are Welcome to Play
Watch games live for the IL Open on Link to come
View pairings and standings at https://www.kingregistration.com/results/ILopen26

$126 room rate until 8/13 reservation link to come
6 Sections — Open section, U2100 and U1900 sections are FIDE rated
Open 5-day only playing schedule
All other sections 3 playing schedules (4-day, 3-day or 2-day)
Also Sunday Night Blitz (see below)
$15,000 in prizes
$500 in door prizes for ICA Members
80 US Chess Enhanced Grand Prix points
Register online at https://www.kingregistration.com/event/ilopen26
SECTIONS
PRIZES

Open ( FIDE Rated )
$1600 — $800 — $600 — $400

Under 2100 ( FIDE Rated )
$1200 — $700 — $400 — $300

Under 1900 ( FIDE Rated )
$1200 — $700 — $400 — $300

Under 1700
$1000 — $600 — $400 — $200

Under 1500
$1000 — $600 — $400 — $200

Under 1300
$600 — $400 — $300 — $200

Unrateds may not win over $200 in U1300, $250 in U1500, $300 in U1700, $350 in U1900

Minimum Prize Guarantee for foreign GM's and IM's
Must register by 8/14 and play all 9 rounds to qualify.
Limited to first 6 that qualify
GM's = $600
Foreign IM's = $300

ENTRY FEES:
TIME CONTROLS AND PLAYING SCHEDULE:

- $120 online by 8/01

- $130 online by 8/15

- $140 online by 8/27 - Open section only

- $140 online by 8/28 - All other sections

- $160 after that or onsite
- $5 discount for ICA members

- Become an ICA member - Here

- GMs/WGMs & all IL FIDE titled players (FM/WFM and above) free entry .

- Out of state IMs $50 off. Online registration should recognize title.

- Play-up one section up to U2100 for $25 extra. Must be within 200 points of next section. Must be at least 1100 to play up into U1500.

- Play-up into Open $220 anyone below 2100 US Chess and below 2000 FIDE.
- IL Jr. players over 1900 may play up into Open for $110

- Contact organizer for discount

- Entries later than 30 minutes before round 1 of any schedule receive 1/2-point bye for round 1.

- You may play up one section for $25 extra.

- 1/2 point byes OK all rounds, must commit by end of round 2 (maximum 2)

- Reentry available for $60 (no Open to open)

- Default time is 1 hour

5-day (Open only)
G/90;+30 second increment

- Thursday 7:00pm

- Friday 2:00pm, 7:00pm

- Saturday 10:00am, 4:00pm

- Sunday 10:00am, 3:00pm

- Monday 10:00am, 3:00pm

4-day
G/90;+30 second increment

- Friday 7:00pm

- Saturday 10:00am, 4:00pm

- Sunday 10:00am, 3:00pm

- Monday 10:00am, 3:00pm

3-day
1st two games G/60;d10 then merges with 4-day schedule

- Saturday (G/60;d10): 10:00am, 1:00pm

- Saturday (G/90;+30): 4:00pm

- Sunday (G/90;+30): 10:00am, 3:00pm

- Monday (G/90;+30): 10:00am, 3:00pm

2-day
1st four games G/30;d5, then merges with 4-day schedule

- Sunday (G/30;d5): 9:00am, 10:30am, 12:00pm, 1:30pm

- Sunday (G/90;+30): 3:00pm

- Monday (G/90;+30): 10:00am, 3:00pm

Boards, sets, and clocks provided
Refunds are subject to $15 processing fee

Sunday Night Blitz!
7:30pm 9/6
4 double rounds (one as white/one as black) at G/3;+2

1st - $150
2nd - $90
1st Under 2100 - $70

1st Under 1700 - $60
1st Under 1500 - $50

One bye available (any round)

Register online at https://www.kingregistration.com/event/ILopenblitz26 or onsite by 7:15pm

For the Individual Scholastic on Saturday Sep. 5 see https://www.kingregistration.com/event/ILschol26

Heritage Event, Grand Prix, Junior Grand Prix, State Championship Event

Hilton Melbourne at Rialto Place

Saturday, September 5, 2026
- Monday, September 7, 2026

Event Overview

Event Overview
September 5-7, 2026, FLORIDA
US Chess Grand Prix Points: 60

2026 Harvey Lerman Florida State Championship, 6SS ,  Top 2 sections FIDE rated , (USCF ratings used for pairings & prizes). G/90+30 sec. incr.
Hilton Melbourne at Rialto Place, 200 Rialto Place, Melbourne, FL 32901 .
Free parking. No resort fee. 5 minutes from Melbourne International Airport. Free breakfast for two if staying at Hilton.

Prizes:   $$16,000 Guaranteed . 5 Sections:
Open: $2000+trophy-1000-500-300, U2250 $900-500.
Under 2050:   $900+trophy-600-400, U1950 $500-300-200.
Under 1800:  $750+trophy-500-250, U1650 $400-250.
Under 1500:  $750+trophy-500-250, U1350 $400-250.
Under 1200:  $700+trophy-500-250, U1050 $400-250, U800 $300-200.
Top Senior Prize each section (must be at least 60 on September 7) $200  (prize is in addition to any other prize).
All:  Unrated may not win over $100 or trophy except for Open section top 4 prizes. Cash prizes for 1st-3rd brilliancy & book prizes for biggest upset rds. 1-5. Up to 2 half-point byes if requested before rd. 3. USCF & FCA memberships required for all events. Out of state players are welcome. Only Florida players eligible for trophies and titles.
EF:  $99 super-saver by 7/15, $109 early-bird by 7/31, $115 by 8/20, $135 by 8/31, $158 by 9PM on 9/4, $160 on-site. Re-entry $60. GM free entry available by request to TD until 7/31, else $135 from prize. $10 service charge for refunds. Online entry at https://www.spacecoastchessfoundation.org/event/floridastatechampionship
Reg.:  On-site registration ends 1 hour before 1st rd. Later entries receive ½ point BYE for round 1. Online registration ends 9pm Friday. No phone, US Mail, or email entries. Late registration permitted on-site with up to two ½ point BYEs for missed games.
Round Times: All Sections.
Sat. 10:00am, 3:30pm;
Sun. 10:00am, 3:30pm;
Mon. 10:00am, 3:30pm.
Other info:   Players in Open and Under 2050 sections required to turn in completed scoresheets. Bring clocks, sets, and boards – none supplied, but vendor will be on-site. No cell phones or other electronic devices. See website for additional information and policies.
State Blitz Championship: 6SS.  Saturday 9/5 at 8:30pm, G/3 d2, 70% of entries paid out as cash prizes. Online EF $25. Online entry is available until 2pm Saturday, otherwise $5 more. Onsite entry for first round closes at 8:00pm Saturday. Later entries receive ½ point BYE for missed rounds (limit of two ½ point BYEs, with additional missed rounds counting as zero points). Online entry at https://www.spacecoastchessfoundation.org/event/floridastatechampionship .
State Quick Championship: 5SS.  Sunday 9/6 at 8:30pm, G/10 d3, 70% of entries paid out as cash prizes. Online EF $25. Online entry is available until 2pm Sunday, otherwise $5 more. Onsite entry for first round closes at 8:00pm Sunday. Later entries receive ½ point BYE for missed rounds (limit of two ½ point BYEs, with additional missed rounds counting as zero points). Online entry at https://www.spacecoastchessfoundation.org/event/floridastatechampionship .
Florida Chess Association Meetings: Sunday: Board meeting at 8:30 am, Annual membership meeting at 9:15 am.
HR:  See website for hotel rooms and rates information:  https://www.spacecoastchessfoundation.org/event/floridastatechampionship .
Online entry and latest info:  Online entry at https://www.spacecoastchessfoundation.org/event/floridastatechampionship .

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, October 3, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com.  USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by Wednesday; $30 by Friday; $35 same day.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 2:30 PM, Round 2- 3:35 PM, Round 3- 4:40 PM, Round 4- 5:45 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/fallfide

OVERVIEW
The 2026 Fall Southeastern FIDE Championship takes place over Labor Day Weekend, September 5-7, 2026 in SouthPark Charlotte. There are three FIDE and US Chess rated sections with a minimum rating of 1400 to participate. There is a $5,500 guaranteed prize fund - $5,000 in the main event plus a free $500 Saturday evening blitz tournament.

There is a registration cap of 125 players. The Fall SE FIDE runs alongside the Labor Day GM/IM Norm Invitational .

Game 40 Challenge

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, September 12, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 40 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700, Under 1200 & Under 700. No playing up allowed for Open and U1700. Players Under 700 can play in the U1200 Section. Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:30 AM, Round 3- 12:00 PM, Round 4- 1:30 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point Bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Contact: Liulia Cardona at [email protected] or (602) 402-4985
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Entry Fee: $30.00 by Wednesday; $35 by Friday; $40 same day. Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Evanston Tri-Level September

Levy Activity Center

Saturday, September 12, 2026

Event Overview

4SS G/40, delay 5. USCF Dual Rated
Open to players who are EITHER age 14 and older OR whose US Chess Current Published Regular Rating for the month of the tournament is 900 or higher.
US Chess Membership is required.
Three Sections
Section Gold: 1700 and over (1600 - 1699 may play up to Gold)
Section Silver:  1200-1699 (1100 - 1199 may play up to Silver)
Section Bronze: U1200 and unrated
Sections may be combined at TD discretion.  IMPORTANT:  We use the US Chess Current Published Regular rating for the month of the tournament to place players in sections. We don’t make exceptions.
Junior players: Junior players (under fourteen years) rated 900+ are welcome. Must be accompanied by an adult throughout the event. We do not accept junior players rated under 900.
Four rounds. Digital clocks are required and will be set to G/40, delay 5. You may take one half-point bye in round 1, 2 or 3.
Prizes: Your prize is an excellent playing experience at a reasonable cost. We've been running these since 2007 and people like playing here.
Entry fee is $20. Please pre-register and pay here    when registration opens. Online registration closes when the tournament is full; we don’t have a wait list; we reopen registration if spaces become available.
On-Site Entries:  Check evanstonchess.org the morning of the tournament. If space is available on-site entries are $20 cash on an as-available basis starting at 9:00 a.m.
Master and Expert Entries:  First two Masters or Experts who sign up get free entry. If your USCF or FIDE regular rating is 2000 or higher, email your name and USCF ID to [email protected] by 5 p.m. the Tuesday before the tournament to pre-register.

Schedule:
Check-in and On-site Registration  from 9:00 to 9:30 AM.
Players must check in on the posted registration list by 9:30 am; players who don’t check in receive a half-point bye for the first round or will be paired with another late arrival.
First Round 9:50 am, last round over roughly 5:00 pm.
Bring your lunch!  We will have a brief lunch break with no time to go out for food. On-site we have vending machine snacks, coffee and soft drinks.
Other information: Sets supplied. Bring digital delay clocks. Wheelchair accessible. No Smoking. Limit 50 players.

Evanston , IL 60202

United States

Tunnelvision XLVIII

Columbia Chess Club

Saturday, September 12, 2026

Event Overview

The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision XLVIII
September 12, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until midnight on the Thursday before the tournament.  $50 late registration thereafter.  Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes.  If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament?  Great!  We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff. Players may use either their live standard rating or live quick rating to play in a higher section. Players may not play in a section lower than permitted by their published standard rating.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit  https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Rules Note: Per USCF Rule 28T, the pairing system will avoid pairing players registered under the same team during the first-half of the event.
Live Standings/Pairings/Boards
The top board of each section will be live streamed to the DGT LiveCloud along with real-time updates to Lichess.org and Chess.com.  A live video stream of the top Championship board will also be available on the club's Twitch page.  See this site's "Live" menu for links.
Live standings (including current pre-registration information) and pairings are also available below.
Live Standings
Prizes
$1000 Prize Fund Guaranteed.
Championship (1600+)
$400 Fund. 1st: $200; 2nd: $130; 3rd: $70
Under 1600
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Under 1000
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Schedule

- Round 1: 10:30 a.m.

- Round 2: 12:50 p.m.

- Round 3: 2:40 p.m.

- Round 4: 4:30 p.m.

Byes
A single half-point bye is available any round, including the final round.  The half-point bye may be requested as a part of the advance entry or on site before the tournament starts.  Thereafter the only bye available is a zero-point bye.  The chief tournament director shall have the ability to grant a half-point bye for any round on unusual circumstances.
Location
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd., Ste A
Columbia, SC 29212
Questions?
Email  [email protected] or call/text James Brandmair at 803.569.0938.
Parking
The Columbia Chess Club is located in a shopping center with ample parking.
Food
The Columbia Chess Club offers on-site concessions, including drinks and snacks.  By the Fire Pizza and Zorba's Restaurant are located in the same shopping center and will be open during the tournament.  Many other restaurants are available close by!

Texas Chess Center - Bellaire

Friday, September 18, 2026
- Sunday, September 20, 2026

Event Overview

Date: September 18th - 20th, 2026 (Friday through Sunday)
Location: TCC-Bellaire | 4007 Bellaire Blvd, Suite HH, Houston, TX 77025
Sections: Championship & U1800 & (U1400 section, USCF rated only )
Time Control: G/90;+30
3 Day Schedule: September 18th - 20th, 2026
Friday: Round 1 @ 7:00PM
Saturday: Round 2 @ 2:00PM, Round 3 @ 7:00PM
Sunday: Round 4 @ 10:00AM, Round 5 @ 3:00PM
2 Day Schedule: September 19th - 20th, 2026
Saturday: Round 1 @ 9:00 AM, Round 2 @ 2:00PM, Round 3 @ 7:00PM
Sunday: Round 4 @ 10:00AM, Round 5 @ 3:00PM
Championship Section Registration:
Early Bird: $108 before or on 08/09
Regular Fee: $123 before or on 09/08
Late fee: $138
U1800 Section Registration:
Early Bird Price: $88 before or on 08/09
Regular Price: $103 before or on 09/08
Late Price: $118
U1400 Section Registration (US Chess Rated Only):
Early Bird Price: $78 before or on 08/09
Regular Price: $93 before or on 09/08
Late Price: $108
Prizes (All Prizes Guaranteed):
Championship - 1st: $640, 2nd: $320, 3rd: $160
U1800 - 1st: $240, 2nd: $120, 3rd: $60
U1400 - 1st, 2nd, 3rd - Trophies
First three GM/IMs to enter get a minimum prize of $200(GM)/$100(IM), valid until late fee deadline; must play all rounds. FM+ are free before late fee deadline. Please email [email protected] for entry under these conditions.
How do I get a FIDE ID? Play in one of our FIDE tournaments and fill the registration form and we’ll take care of it for you. Alternatively, you can contact USCF and request an ID as well. However, to be officially FIDE rated, one must play five games against previously rated FIDE players, score at least a half point in those games, and have a performance rating of at least 1400. USCF monthly ratings used for pairings. Default late forfeiture time is one hour. Re-entry is available for half the late fee price.

Premiere Section - Open (US Chess Rated) - 1st - $1000; 2nd - $700; 3rd - $550; U2200 - 1st - $425; 2nd - $300

Phoenix Saturday Action

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, September 19, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:05 AM, Round 3- 11:10 AM, Round 4- 12:15 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by 09/16; $30 by 09/18; $35 same day. Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Arizona Golden Cup 🏆

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, September 26, 2026

Event Overview

Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish                 Points
1st Place              20
2nd Place            16
3rd Place             13
4th Place             10
5–6                           8
7–10                        5
Participation       3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.

Event Overview

Cincinnati Tornado Monthly Tournament
Held on the Last Saturday of the Month
We provide all clocks & chess sets

Advance Entry Fee $45
Online Registration – By Friday 12 midnight deadline
Online Registration:   https://chessearth.com/tornado-registration/
Advance Registration ends on Friday 12 midnight.
NEW OPTION for returning players.   EMAIL or  TEXT MESSAGE  us to pre-register and enter the tournament:

- Email admin@chessearth:   1.) First & Last Name   2.) USCF ID  3.) Section you are playing in  and  4.)  Pay $45 at the Tournament Site

On-Site Entry Fee $50; On-Site Registration – By 9:30am Saturday morning deadline
-  10am First Round.

- On-Site Registration – Ends at 9:30am Saturday morning.     10am First Round.

- Credit Cards, PayPal, Venmo, CashApp, Zelle, Apple Pay accepted on site

- Tournament  Address:    Wyoming Baptist Church, 170 Burns Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45215

4-Round Swiss Tournament
Time Control: G/45 +5; Each player receives 45 minutes with a +5-second increment. A Tornado is a one-day tournament where you play four games. Cash Prizes and Awards are given at the end of the tournament based on your final score.
Round Start Times:

- Prizes Fund based on 70 players.

- We provide all the Chess Clocks & Chess Sets

Or a player can pay $30 to “play up” into the Open Section.
1st – $200      2nd – $150

Under 1600 Section:   The heart of the tournament
1st – $200      2nd – $150
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.

- Buy Chess Merch

- Watch the Tournament.

- Chess Social Life.

Columbia County Library, Room A

Saturday, October 3, 2026

Event Overview

Join the Columbia County Chess Association for our monthly chess tournament as a part of the year-long running Chess League. Each League Tournament will consist of 4 Rounds G/35;+5 games, Swiss style tournaments at the Columbia County Library with three sections; Open, U1300 and U800. Section Prizes are increased this year with $700 between the three sections (based on 20 Registrants).
Compete in as many or as few Chess League events, earning points throughout the year. The top 12 players from each section will be invited to the Chess League round-robin tournament at the conclusion of the regular season to determine the Chess League Champion!
Season Pass and Multi-month registration discounts available.
Free Casual play will be available in the Library Cafe.

Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 2:30 PM, Round 2- 3:35 PM, Round 3- 4:40 PM, Round 4- 5:45 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.

Tunnelvision XLIX

Columbia Chess Club

Saturday, October 10, 2026

Event Overview

The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision XLIX
October 10, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until midnight on the Thursday before the tournament.  $50 late registration thereafter.  Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes.  If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament?  Great!  We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff. Players may use either their live standard rating or live quick rating to play in a higher section. Players may not play in a section lower than permitted by their published standard rating.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit  https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Rules Note: Per USCF Rule 28T, the pairing system will avoid pairing players registered under the same team during the first-half of the event.
Live Standings/Pairings/Boards
The top board of each section will be live streamed to the DGT LiveCloud along with real-time updates to Lichess.org and Chess.com.  A live video stream of the top Championship board will also be available on the club's Twitch page.  See this site's "Live" menu for links.
Live standings (including current pre-registration information) and pairings are also available below.
Live Standings
Prizes
$1000 Prize Fund Guaranteed.
Championship (1600+)
$400 Fund. 1st: $200; 2nd: $130; 3rd: $70
Under 1600
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Under 1000
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Schedule

- Round 1: 10:30 a.m.

- Round 2: 12:50 p.m.

- Round 3: 2:40 p.m.

- Round 4: 4:30 p.m.

Byes
A single half-point bye is available any round, including the final round.  The half-point bye may be requested as a part of the advance entry or on site before the tournament starts.  Thereafter the only bye available is a zero-point bye.  The chief tournament director shall have the ability to grant a half-point bye for any round on unusual circumstances.
Location
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd., Ste A
Columbia, SC 29212
Questions?
Email  [email protected] or call/text James Brandmair at 803.569.0938.
Parking
The Columbia Chess Club is located in a shopping center with ample parking.
Food
The Columbia Chess Club offers on-site concessions, including drinks and snacks.  By the Fire Pizza and Zorba's Restaurant are located in the same shopping center and will be open during the tournament.  Many other restaurants are available close by!

Phoenix Saturday Action

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, November 14, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:05 AM, Round 3- 11:10 AM, Round 4- 12:15 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by 11/11; $30 by 11/13; $35 same day. Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

The Indianapolis Public Library - Central Library

Saturday, October 17, 2026

Event Overview

One Day: Two Tournaments
A FREE casual, arena style chess tournament. Play as many or as few games as you would like; it's up to you. Players will be paired with assistance from the tournament director. A casual, free, and open to everyone chess experience. Registration not required.
A FREE USCF rated tournament - Players must have a USCF membership to play in the rated section) with sections based on rating and age. Registration required.
SECTIONS:
Scholastic Sections (K-12):
10:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. (EST) - Please arrive by 10 AM
G/25 minute + 5 sec increment
4 USCF Rated Games
3U, 6U, 8U & 12U sections
USCF ID required
Trophies/Medals - TBD
TD may combine sections based on the number of participants
Players may play up if desired
OPEN Sections (Adults & Kids):
10:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. (EST) - Please arrive by 10 AM
G/25 minute + 5 sec increment
4 USCF Rated Games
PRO (1800+), RESERVE (U1800) & NOVICE (U1200) sections
USCF ID required
Trophies/Medals - TBD
TD may combine sections based on the number of participants
Players may play up one section; Must be within 200 points of section
UNRATED/CASUAL Arena:
Open to all ages and skills
USCF ID not required

This event is open to both Adults and Kids

1st Round starts at 10:30 am EST; Next rounds ASAP;
One 1/2 point bye allowed and request prior Round 2
No cell phones / devices during play; All devices off, face down on table is okay

No eating during game

Chess sets/Clock/Notation sheets provided
