Arizona Golden Cup 🏆

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, November 21, 2026

Event Overview

Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish                 Points
1st Place              20
2nd Place            16
3rd Place             13
4th Place             10
5–6                           8
7–10                        5
Participation       3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.

Phoenix , AZ 85022

United States

Prizes: Over 1200: Cash for top three. 1st - 30%, 2nd - 14%, 3rd - 10%.
Under 1200: Trophy for top three. Trophy for the Best Under 700.

Cincinnati Tornado OCT. Last Saturday of Month

Wyoming Baptist Church

Saturday, October 31, 2026

Event Overview

Cincinnati Tornado Monthly Tournament
Held on the Last Saturday of the Month
We provide all clocks & chess sets

Advance Entry Fee $45
Online Registration – By Friday 12 midnight deadline
Online Registration:   https://chessearth.com/tornado-registration/
Advance Registration ends on Friday 12 midnight.
NEW OPTION for returning players.   EMAIL or  TEXT MESSAGE  us to pre-register and enter the tournament:

- Email admin@chessearth:   1.) First & Last Name   2.) USCF ID  3.) Section you are playing in  and  4.)  Pay $45 at the Tournament Site

On-Site Entry Fee $50; On-Site Registration – By 9:30am Saturday morning deadline
-  10am First Round.

- On-Site Registration – Ends at 9:30am Saturday morning.     10am First Round.

- Credit Cards, PayPal, Venmo, CashApp, Zelle, Apple Pay accepted on site

- Tournament  Address:    Wyoming Baptist Church, 170 Burns Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45215

4-Round Swiss Tournament
Time Control: G/45 +5; Each player receives 45 minutes with a +5-second increment. A Tornado is a one-day tournament where you play four games. Cash Prizes and Awards are given at the end of the tournament based on your final score.
Round Start Times:
Round #1: 10:00am
Round #2: 12:30pm
Round #3: 2:30pm
Round #4: 4:30pm
Choose a Section To Play In:

- Open Section  -  Includes the Master Bounty Prize - $100

- Under 1600 Section

- Under 1000 Section

- Award Winning Chili.  Good Food; Hot Meals

- Chess Equipment and Merch available to purchase

- USCF Rated Tournament.  Join/Renew USCF on-site.

- Purchase a New Membership at Registration.

- 1/2 Point Bye is available if notified before Round 2.

- Prizes Fund based on 70 players.

- We provide all the Chess Clocks & Chess Sets

Open Section:     **NEW** Rating must be 1600 or above to play in the Open Section.
Or a player can pay $30 to “play up” into the Open Section.
1st – $200      2nd – $150
Top Under 2001   – $100
Top Under 1801   – $100
Includes the Master Bounty Prize - $100

- Master Bounty Prize:  Win your game against the #1 Master in the tournament and win $100. If you draw the Master, win $50.  If the Master wins all the games, then he/she wins the $100.

Under 1600 Section:   The heart of the tournament
1st – $200      2nd – $150
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
Under 1000 Section :  Rating must be lower than 1001. Great for beginners and 1st time tournament players.
1st – $200      2nd – $150
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
Chess Community Gathering

- Hang Out & Analyze;  Play Casual Chess Games in the Skittles room.

- TVs are in the Skittle rooms

- Enjoy Good Food

- Buy Chess Merch

- Watch the Tournament.

- Chess Social Life.

- We are looking for volunteers to help with the clean-up; putting chairs and tables away.  Please email us if you can help.  We appreciate it!!

Monthly Saturday Swiss

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, November 7, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com.  USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by Wednesday; $30 by Friday; $35 same day.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 2:30 PM, Round 2- 3:35 PM, Round 3- 4:40 PM, Round 4- 5:45 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Evanston 3x3 November

Levy Activity Center

Saturday, November 7, 2026

Event Overview

3SS G/60, delay 5. USCF Dual Rated
Open to players who are EITHER age 14 and older OR whose US Chess Current Published Regular Rating for the month of the tournament is 900 or higher.
US Chess Membership is required.
Three Sections
Section Gold: 1700 and over (1600 - 1699 may play up to Gold)
Section Silver:  1200-1699 (1100 - 1199 may play up to Silver)
Section Bronze: U1200 and unrated
Sections may be combined at TD discretion.  IMPORTANT:  We use the US Chess Current Published Regular rating for the month of the tournament to place players in sections. We don’t make exceptions.
Junior players: Junior players (under fourteen years) rated 900+ are welcome. Must be accompanied by an adult throughout the event. We do not accept junior players rated under 900.
Three rounds. Digital clocks are required and will be set to G/60, delay 5. You may take one half-point bye in round 1 or 2.
Prizes: Your prize is an excellent playing experience at a reasonable cost. We've been running these since 2007 and people like playing here.
Entry fee is $20. Please pre-register and pay here    when registration opens. Online registration closes when the tournament is full; we don’t have a wait list; we reopen registration if spaces become available.
On-Site Entries:  Check evanstonchess.org the morning of the tournament. If space is available on-site entries are $20 cash on an as-available basis starting at 9:00 a.m.
Master and Expert Entries:  First two Masters or Experts who sign up get free entry. If your USCF or FIDE regular rating is 2000 or higher, email your name and USCF ID to [email protected] by 5 p.m. the Tuesday before the tournament to pre-register.

Schedule:
Check-in and On-site Registration  from 9:00 to 9:30 AM.
Players must check in on the posted registration list by 9:30 am; players who don’t check in receive a half-point bye for the first round or will be paired with another late arrival.
First Round 9:50 am, last round over roughly 5:00 pm.
Bring your lunch!  We will have a brief lunch break with no time to go out for food. On-site we have vending machine snacks, coffee and soft drinks.
Other information: Sets supplied. Bring digital delay clocks. Wheelchair accessible. No Smoking. Limit 50 players.

Address: 300 Dodge Ave

Evanston , IL 60202

United States

- Top U1700 Team: $220 + Plaques (Team average below 1700 US Chess)

- Top U1400 Team: $200 + Plaques (Team average below 1400 US Chess)

- Top Boards 1-4: $50

- Top Individual Upset: $50

- Top College Team: Trophy

- Top Scholastic Team: Trophy

BOARDS PROVIDED. BRING CLOCKS IF ABLE. COFFEE AND WATER PROVIDED. G/90;d5, 5SS
3rd Year in a Row!

- 2024 Results

- 2025 Results

October 2026 published ratings will be used for prize eligibility and board order.
Check out the new rules document and  FAQs
Team Construction

- Teams of 4, up to 1 alternate (ALTERNATE IS OPTIONAL. Up to 5 players on a team)

- Team Average Rating MUST be 2200 or below

- October 2026 ratings used for pairings and prize eligibility purposes

- Unrated players will not contribute to team average ratings. Some exceptions apply (See  Rules Document for more information regarding unrated players).
- If a player has a rating in USCF Quick/Blitz but no USCF Regular rating, then the highest USCF rating can be applied to the team average (Leave comment in

- Board order is determined by rating. Switches for board order for players within 50-points are allowed before round 1. (See  FAQ for questions)

- Each team must have a team captain. The team captain is responsible for ensuring all results are submitted and that players are in the correct board order. Captains are also the first person the tournament director talks to in case of questions or disputes

- Looking for teammates or have a team and looking for 1 or 2 additional players? Contact the TD, at  Click here to show mail address for help finding teammates

Entry Fee

- Early Bird Entry: $120 per team if registered by Sunday, Oct. 11th, 2026

- Regular Entry: $160 per team by Nov. 6th

- Same-Day Entry: $200 per team. Please register by 9:30am on-site to be paired for round 1

Registration

- Teams may register through either option:
- ONLINE REGISTRATION:  COMING IN AUGUST 2026

- PDF Registration: (email completed form to [email protected] ):  https://drive.google.com/file/d/108hTZzsASgZ0xCL476eks4r7tS9XvjZF/view?usp=sharing

SCHEDULE

- Friday, Nov. 6th: FREE BLITZ SIDE EVENT @ 8pm at the playing hall (link coming in August)
- On-Site Registration ONLY, 7:30pm-7:55pm

- Only free for players playing in the main event.  $5 entry fee for players not playing in the main event

- 4 double-round Swiss and $20 to first place (8 games total)

- Time Control: G/3;+2

- Saturday, Nov. 7th:
- Format is 5-round Team Swiss, G/90;d5

- On-Site Registration: 9am-9:30am

- Rounds: 10am-2pm-5:30pm

- Sunday, Nov. 8th:
- Rounds: 10am-2pm

- Prizes given out ASAP, no formal prize ceremony

HOTEL

- Courtyard by Marriott, 503 Newburd Rd, Shippensburg, PA 17257
- 12-minute walk through campus to playing hall, 2-minute drive

- Other hotel options available, but the Courtyard by Marriott is the only one walking distance

- HOTEL LINK WITH GROUP RATE COMING SOON
- Room must be reserved by Oct. 7th, 2026 to get the group discount.

- Check here for other options:  https://www.google.com/maps/search/hotels+near+shippensburg+university/@40.0587828,-77.5292696,14.71z/data=!4m8!2m7!5m5!5m4!1s2024-11-15!2i2!4m1!1i2!6e3?entry=ttu

Location Info:
Address: 110 Cumberland Dr, Shippensburg, PA 17257
Playing hall: The playing hall is the Tuscarora Room. After you park behind the building, as you walk around the building counterclockwise, enter the first entrance you see on your left. It should be labeled as the Tuscarora Room. It is on the other side of the building from the main dining hall entrance. Since the room is part of Reisner Dining Hall, you can use Reisner Dining Hall in Google Maps as a reference if you're driving to the playing hall.
Free parking in lot FS-15 (The parking lot behind the playing hall and the dining hall): Link to parking map:  https://www.ship.edu/globalassets/visit/parkingmap.pdf

- Backup parking lot is lot C-7 in case FS-15 gets too full

We are one of the most central locations in PA.
Distance from Harrisburg: 43 mi (45 mins)
For Philadelphia: Take I-76 and then I-81 S
For Pittsburgh: Take I-76, we’re 16 minutes off the highway. Shorter drive than to Harrisburg.
Distance from Hagerstown, MD : 34 mi (37 mins)

Food Options:

- Chick-fil-A across the street (Saturday only)

- Snack Shack / Convenience Store across the street (opens at 11)

- Many food options 5 minute drive from playing hall

- Dining hall adjacent to the playing hall (all you can eat)
- Prices (Based off Fall 2024 prices):
$9.60 Breakfast (7AM-10:30AM), $11.85 Lunch/Brunch (10AM-2:30PM), $13.55 Dinner ( 3:30pm-8:00pm )

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, November 14, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:05 AM, Round 3- 11:10 AM, Round 4- 12:15 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by 11/11; $30 by 11/13; $35 same day. Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Tunnelvision L

Columbia Chess Club

Saturday, November 14, 2026

Event Overview

The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision L
November 14, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until midnight on the Thursday before the tournament.  $50 late registration thereafter.  Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes.  If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament?  Great!  We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff. Players may use either their live standard rating or live quick rating to play in a higher section. Players may not play in a section lower than permitted by their published standard rating.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit  https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Rules Note: Per USCF Rule 28T, the pairing system will avoid pairing players registered under the same team during the first-half of the event.
Live Standings/Pairings/Boards
The top board of each section will be live streamed to the DGT LiveCloud along with real-time updates to Lichess.org and Chess.com.  A live video stream of the top Championship board will also be available on the club's Twitch page.  See this site's "Live" menu for links.
Live standings (including current pre-registration information) and pairings are also available below.
Live Standings
Prizes
$1000 Prize Fund Guaranteed.
Championship (1600+)
$400 Fund. 1st: $200; 2nd: $130; 3rd: $70
Under 1600
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Under 1000
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Schedule

- Round 1: 10:30 a.m.

- Round 2: 12:50 p.m.

- Round 3: 2:40 p.m.

- Round 4: 4:30 p.m.

Byes
A single half-point bye is available any round, including the final round.  The half-point bye may be requested as a part of the advance entry or on site before the tournament starts.  Thereafter the only bye available is a zero-point bye.  The chief tournament director shall have the ability to grant a half-point bye for any round on unusual circumstances.
Location
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd., Ste A
Columbia, SC 29212
Questions?
Email  [email protected] or call/text James Brandmair at 803.569.0938.
Parking
The Columbia Chess Club is located in a shopping center with ample parking.
Food
The Columbia Chess Club offers on-site concessions, including drinks and snacks.  By the Fire Pizza and Zorba's Restaurant are located in the same shopping center and will be open during the tournament.  Many other restaurants are available close by!

3 Day Schedule: November 20th - 22th, 2026
Friday: Round 1 @ 7:00PM
Saturday: Round 2 @ 2:00PM, Round 3 @ 7:00PM
Sunday: Round 4 @ 10:00AM, Round 5 @ 3:00PM
2 Day Schedule: November 21th - 22th, 2026

Sunday: Round 4 @ 10:00AM, Round 5 @ 3:00PM

Early Bird: $108 before or on 10/11

Early Bird Price: $88 before or on 10/11

Championship - 1st: $640, 2nd: $320, 3rd: $160

First three GM/IMs to enter get a minimum prize of $200(GM)/$100(IM), valid until late fee deadline; must play all rounds. FM+ are free before late fee deadline. Please email [email protected] for entry under these conditions.
How do I get a FIDE ID? Play in one of our FIDE tournaments and fill the registration form and we’ll take care of it for you. Alternatively, you can contact USCF and request an ID as well. However, to be officially FIDE rated, one must play five games against previously rated FIDE players, score at least a half point in those games, and have a performance rating of at least 1400. USCF monthly ratings used for pairings. Default late forfeiture time is one hour. Re-entry is available for half the late fee price.

Arizona Golden Cup 🏆

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, November 21, 2026

Event Overview

Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish                 Points
1st Place              20
2nd Place            16
3rd Place             13
4th Place             10
5–6                           8
7–10                        5
Participation       3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.

Address: 18440 N. 7th Street Suite 8.

Phoenix , AZ 85022

United States

2026 US Masters

Heritage Event, Grand Prix, National Championship Event

Hilton Charlotte University Place

Wednesday, November 25, 2026
- Sunday, November 29, 2026

Event Overview

https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/usmasters

OVERVIEW
The 2026 US Masters is a US Chess National Championship held over Thanksgiving Weekend. The USM is part of the FIDE Circuit and offers GM/IM norms and a $25,000 guaranteed prize fund.

The USM is held just after the Fall GM/IM Norm Invitational and runs alongside the NC Open , an open event for all players.

New this Year:

- Higher rating minimums for untitled juniors

- Larger female and senior prizes

- Adjusted time control from G/90 to G/80, inc/30, allowing for a more relaxed schedule while still being valid for norms, rating, and the FIDE Circuit.

WHEN
November 25-29, 2026 ​

WHERE
Hilton Charlotte University Place
8629 JM Keynes Drive
Charlotte, NC 28262
Free Internet, Free Parking
​
$139/Night
Booking Link - Book ASAP
Click "edit stay" at the top of the booking page to select your exact dates
Please email us if the booking link is not showing the correct rate.

REGISTRATION

- Online registration required .

- Online registration closes November 25, 4:00pm

- On-site check-in is not necessary for pre-registered players.

ELIGIBILITY

- Players rated or once rated 2200+ USCF or FIDE based on an established rating of 26+ games.

- Players with the NM, FM, WFM, or higher titles.

- CFC and other foreign National Masters accepted.

- CM and WCM titles are not considered.

- Untitled juniors (born 2007 or after) must be rated 1950+ FIDE and 2100+ USCF at any time between September 1 and November 25; the ratings need not be achieved concurrently. Additional fee applies.

- No exceptions to eligibility rules.  Players who do not qualify for the USM may enter the NC Open .

- Entry fees are based on status at the time of registration.

SPECTATORS

- Parents, spectators, and other non-players may attend, but during play, are not permitted in any playing halls or nearby hallways and restrooms.

- May enjoy side events and use the hotel common areas.

- Anyone may register for the $2,000 Blitz  on Saturday.

TIME CONTROL
G/80; inc/30
The USM has been specifically approved by FIDE to be played at a slightly faster classical time control and still be valid for norms, rating, and the FIDE Circuit.

PRIZES
$25,000 Guaranteed Prize Fund in 1 Section.
150 US Chess Grand Prix Points

$7000 - $3500 - $2000 - $1500 - $1400 - $1200 - $1000
Top U2500 FIDE: $1400 - $700
Top U2350 FIDE: $1200 - $600
Top U2200 FIDE: $1000

Bonus Prizes (can be won in addition to other prizes)

- $500 + USM trophy and title for clear or playoff winner

- Top Female: $1000

- Top Senior (born 1976 or earlier) : $1000

The USM is counted towards the FIDE Circuit , part of the FIDE Candidates cycle. See regulations .

NORMS

- GM, IM, WGM, WIM norms available

- Norm “Super Swiss” – normal federation requirement waived

- FIDE requires at least one Swiss norm (40+ players) to obtain GM/IM/WGM/WIM titles

SCHEDULE

​SIDE EVENTS
FREE $2000 Blitz

- Saturday, November 29

ENTRY FEES

- Entry fees are based on status at the time of registration.

- All GMs, IMs, WGMs:  Free Online Entry. No deduction from prize by October 10, otherwise $200 deducted.

- Titled Player Entry (FMs, WIMs, WFMs, NMs):  $339 by November 1, $369 by November 15, $399 after November 15.

- Untitled Juniors (born 2007 or after) with Peak Ratings Under 2200:  Must be rated 1950+ FIDE and 2100+ USCF between September 1 and November 25: $400 more than Titled Player Entry.

- USM players who have an unsuccessful start may withdraw and join the NC Open for a discounted fee of $100 (only available to U2400 FIDE players who are not receiving conditions).

2026 North Carolina Open

Heritage Event, Grand Prix

Hilton Charlotte University Place

Friday, November 27, 2026
- Sunday, November 29, 2026

Event Overview

https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/ncopen

OVERVIEW
The 2026 North Carolina Open is a 6 round tournament held over Thanksgiving Weekend featuring a $12,000 guaranteed prize fund in 6 sections. The NC Open runs alongside the  2026 US Masters , a premier US Chess national event.
​
Side events include the Free $2,000 Blitz and a Scholastic (K-8) tournament. Throughout the weekend, participants may enjoy game analysis, lectures, and blitz challenges with a VIP titled player!

WHEN
Main Event
November 27-29, 2026
3-day and 2-day playing schedules

Side Events

- K-8 Scholastic (U700) - Friday

- $2,000 Blitz - Saturday

- VIP events - all weekend

WHERE
Hilton Charlotte University Place
8629 JM Keynes Drive
Charlotte, NC 28262
Free Internet, Free Parking
​
$139/Night
Booking Link - Book ASAP
Click "edit stay" at the top of the booking page to select your exact dates
Email us if the booking link is not showing the correct rate.

​
REGISTRATION

- Online registration is strongly recommended .

- All registration closes 90 minutes before round 1.

- On-site check-in is not necessary .

- On-site Registration:
- 3-Day Schedule: Friday 8:30-9:30am

- Scholastic: Friday 8:30-8:45am

- 2-Day and Re-Entry: Saturday 8:45-9:00am

- Blitz Registration: Saturday 4:00-8:45pm

* Rounds 1-3 of 2-Day played at G/20; inc/10, then merge with 3-day, Saturday 4:00pm

3-Day Schedule:  G/100, inc/10
2-Day Schedule:  Rounds 1-3: G/20, inc/10, Rounds 4-6 (merge with 3-day): G/100, inc/10

Hilton Charlotte University Place

Friday, November 27, 2026

Event Overview

https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/ncopenschol

OVERVIEW
The 2026 North Carolina Open Scholastic is a 5-round K-8 tournament held alongside the NC Open and US Masters .  It is open to K-8 players (age 13 or younger) with a rating under 800 or unrated.

WHEN
Friday, November 27, 2026

WHERE
Hilton Charlotte University Place
8629 JM Keynes Drive
Charlotte, NC 28262
Free Internet, Free Parking
​
$139/Night
Booking Link - Book ASAP
Click "edit stay" at the top of the booking page to select your exact dates
Please email us if the booking link is not showing the correct rate.

REGISTRATION

- Online registration strongly recommended.

- Scholastic registration closes 1 hour before round 1 start time.

- On-site registration: Friday 8:30-8:45am.

- On-site check-in is not necessary for players who registered online

ELIGIBILITY

- K-8 players only (age 13 and under)

- Players must be unrated or rated under 800 based on the November 2026 US Chess rating supplement, not live ratings.

- Players who do not meet the requirements should enter the NC Open .

FORMAT

- 5 rounds – no eliminations

- Time Control: G/20, inc/10

- November US Chess Supplement Ratings used.

- US Chess Rated - US Chess Membership required .

- Boards, sets, clocks provided (must use our equipment)

- Byes (request to skip certain rounds):
- Up to 2 optional half-point byes which must be requested at least 90 minutes before round one begins.​​

- All byes requested after the start of round one are zero-point byes.

Round 2: 11:15am

Round 3: 1:00pm

Trophies to top 10, based on US Chess standard tiebreaks

Game 40 Challenge

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, December 26, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 40 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700, Under 1200 & Under 700. No playing up allowed for Open and U1700. Players Under 700 can play in the U1200 Section. Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:30 AM, Round 3- 12:00 PM, Round 4- 1:30 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point Bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Contact: Liulia Cardona at [email protected] or (602) 402-4985
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Entry Fee: $30.00 by Wednesday; $35 by Friday; $40 same day. Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Address: 18440 N. 7th Street Suite 8.

Phoenix , AZ 85022

United States

Cincinnati Tornado NOV. Last Saturday of Month

Wyoming Baptist Church

Saturday, November 28, 2026

Event Overview

Cincinnati Tornado Monthly Tournament
Held on the Last Saturday of the Month
We provide all clocks & chess sets

Advance Entry Fee $45
Online Registration – By Friday 12 midnight deadline
Online Registration:   https://chessearth.com/tornado-registration/
Advance Registration ends on Friday 12 midnight.
NEW OPTION for returning players.   EMAIL or  TEXT MESSAGE  us to pre-register and enter the tournament:

- Email admin@chessearth:   1.) First & Last Name   2.) USCF ID  3.) Section you are playing in  and  4.)  Pay $45 at the Tournament Site

On-Site Entry Fee $50; On-Site Registration – By 9:30am Saturday morning deadline
-  10am First Round.

- On-Site Registration – Ends at 9:30am Saturday morning.     10am First Round.

- Credit Cards, PayPal, Venmo, CashApp, Zelle, Apple Pay accepted on site

- Tournament  Address:    Wyoming Baptist Church, 170 Burns Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45215

4-Round Swiss Tournament
Time Control: G/45 +5; Each player receives 45 minutes with a +5-second increment. A Tornado is a one-day tournament where you play four games. Cash Prizes and Awards are given at the end of the tournament based on your final score.
Round Start Times:
Round #1: 10:00am
Round #2: 12:30pm
Round #3: 2:30pm
Round #4: 4:30pm
Choose a Section To Play In:

- Open Section  -  Includes the Master Bounty Prize - $100

- Under 1600 Section

- Under 1000 Section

- Award Winning Chili.  Good Food; Hot Meals

- Chess Equipment and Merch available to purchase

- USCF Rated Tournament.  Join/Renew USCF on-site.

- Purchase a New Membership at Registration.

- 1/2 Point Bye is available if notified before Round 2.

- Prizes Fund based on 70 players.

- We provide all the Chess Clocks & Chess Sets

Open Section:     **NEW** Rating must be 1600 or above to play in the Open Section.
Or a player can pay $30 to “play up” into the Open Section.
1st – $200      2nd – $150
Top Under 2001   – $100
Top Under 1801   – $100
Includes the Master Bounty Prize - $100

- Master Bounty Prize:  Win your game against the #1 Master in the tournament and win $100. If you draw the Master, win $50.  If the Master wins all the games, then he/she wins the $100.

Under 1600 Section:   The heart of the tournament
1st – $200      2nd – $150
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
Under 1000 Section :  Rating must be lower than 1001. Great for beginners and 1st time tournament players.
1st – $200      2nd – $150
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
Chess Community Gathering

- Hang Out & Analyze;  Play Casual Chess Games in the Skittles room.

- TVs are in the Skittle rooms

- Enjoy Good Food

- Buy Chess Merch

- Watch the Tournament.

- Chess Social Life.

- We are looking for volunteers to help with the clean-up; putting chairs and tables away.  Please email us if you can help.  We appreciate it!!

US Masters / NC Open Blitz

Hilton Charlotte University Place

Saturday, November 28, 2026

Event Overview

https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/ncoblitz

OVERVIEW
The 2026 $2,000 Blitz is a 6 round US Chess and FIDE Blitz-rated event held alongside the US Masters  and NC Open .  This event is open to everyone but is free for those playing in the US Masters or NC Open.

WHEN
Saturday, November 28
9:00pm

WHERE
Hilton Charlotte University Place
8629 JM Keynes Drive
Charlotte, NC 28262
Free Internet, Free Parking
​
$139/Night
Booking Link - Book ASAP
Click "edit stay" at the top of the booking page to select your exact dates
Please email us if the booking link is not showing the correct rate.

BLITZ REGISTRATION

- Open to all players.

- On-Site Registration Only , Saturday 4:00-8:45pm.

- Entries after 8:45pm receive a round 1 bye.

- No online or emailed registration.

- Round 1 starts 9:00pm, rounds 2-6 are ASAP.

​

FORMAT

- 6 single rounds

- 2 sections (Championship and Under 2000)
- No playing up unless approved by the Chief Arbiter.

- Time Control: G/3, inc/2

- November US Chess Regular Ratings  are used for pairings and prizes.
- At the Chief Arbiter’s discretion, live ratings, US Chess Blitz, FIDE Classical or Blitz ratings, or other ratings may be used if higher than US Chess regular ratings.

- Sections:
- Players in the NC Open - Championship section will play in Blitz Championship.

- Players in U2000 or lower sections in the main event will play in Blitz U2000.

- On-site registered players will play in the section as determined by their rating.

- US Chess Blitz and FIDE Blitz rated - US Chess Membership required .

TIME CONTROL
G/3, inc/2

PRIZES & SECTIONS
$2,000 Guaranteed Prize Fund in 2 Sections.

Blitz Championship (2000+) - FIDE Blitz Rated
$600 – $300 – $200 – $100
Top U2400 USCF: $100
Top U2200 USCF: $100

Under 2000 Section  – FIDE Blitz Rated
$250 – $150 – $100
Top U1700: $60
Top U1400: $40

ENTRY FEE
Free Entry for players in the US Masters, NC Open, or NCO Scholastic.
Other Players: $40

Phoenix Saturday Action

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, December 5, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:05 AM, Round 3- 11:10 AM, Round 4- 12:15 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by 12/02; $30 by 12/04; $35 same day. Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Address: 18440 N. 7th Street Suite 8.

Phoenix , AZ 85022

United States

Dallas Winter FIDE

Texas Chess Center - Irving

Friday, December 11, 2026
- Sunday, December 13, 2026

Event Overview

Date: December 11th - 13th, 2026 (Friday through Sunday)
Location: TCC Irving Location - 4343 W Royal Lane #114, Irving, TX 75063
Sections: Championship & U1800 & (U1400 section, USCF rated only )
Time Control: G/90;+30
3 Day Schedule: December 11th - 13th, 2026
Friday: Round 1 @ 7:00PM
Saturday: Round 2 @ 2:00PM, Round 3 @ 7:00PM
Sunday: Round 4 @ 10:00AM, Round 5 @ 3:00PM
2 Day Schedule: December 12th - 13th, 2026
Saturday: Round 1 @ 9:00 AM, Round 2 @ 2:00PM, Round 3 @ 7:00PM
Sunday: Round 4 @ 10:00AM, Round 5 @ 3:00PM
Championship Section Registration:
Early Bird: $108 before or on 11/01
Regular Fee: $123 before or on 12/01
Late fee: $138
U1800 Section Registration:
Early Bird Price: $88 before or on 11/01
Regular Price: $103 before or on 12/01
Late Price: $118
U1400 Section Registration (US Chess Rated Only):
Early Bird Price: $78 before or on 11/01
Regular Price: $93 before or on 12/01
Late Price: $108
Prizes (All Prizes Guaranteed):
Championship - 1st: $640, 2nd: $320, 3rd: $160
U1800 - 1st: $240, 2nd: $120, 3rd: $60
U1400 - 1st, 2nd, 3rd - Trophies
First three GM/IMs to enter get a minimum prize of $200(GM)/$100(IM), valid until late fee deadline; must play all rounds. FM+ are free before late fee deadline. Please email [email protected] for entry under these conditions.
How do I get a FIDE ID? Play in one of our FIDE tournaments and fill the registration form and we’ll take care of it for you. Alternatively, you can contact USCF and request an ID as well. However, to be officially FIDE rated, one must play five games against previously rated FIDE players, score at least a half point in those games, and have a performance rating of at least 1400. USCF monthly ratings used for pairings. Default late forfeiture time is one hour. Re-entry is available for half the late fee price.

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, December 12, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Game in 25 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com.  USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Entry Fee: $25.00 by Wednesday; $30 by Friday; $35 same day.
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Sections: Open, Under 1700 & Under 1200 (No playing up allowed). Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 2:30 PM, Round 2- 3:35 PM, Round 3- 4:40 PM, Round 4- 5:45 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Hilton Charlotte University Place

Friday, December 18, 2026
- Wednesday, December 23, 2026

Event Overview

https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/najr

OVERVIEW
The 2026 North American Junior (U20) Championships will be held December 18-23. The NA Junior is the official Continental Junior Championship of North America and endorsed by the Confederation for Chess in the Americas. This event offers IM/FM titles and GM/IM norms for medalists, as well as a Blitz Championship side event.

The NA Junior is held just before the Winter Classic (same venue) and the Winter Elite Camp (different venue).

WHEN
December 18-23, 2026 ​

WHERE
Hilton Charlotte University Place
8629 JM Keynes Drive
Charlotte, NC 28262
Free Internet, Free Parking
​
$139/Night
Booking Link - Book ASAP
Click "edit stay" at the top of the booking page to select your exact dates
Please email us if the booking link is not showing the correct rate.

REGISTRATION

- Online registration required .

- Online registration closes December 17. Same-day registrations may incur a 0-point bye in round 1 at the Chief Arbiter's discretion.

- This event is US Chess and FIDE-rated. US Chess membership required for all players.

- On-site check-in is not necessary for pre-registered players.

- Official Players - each federation (CAN, MEX, USA) may designate one player as their official representative per section. The gold medalists from the 2025 North American Junior Championships may also register as official players in the same sections. ORs receive free entry (full refund is already paid) if fully registered by November 15. Upon completion of the event, they will also be reimbursed a fee of $200 USD to help with travel expenses. ORs registering after November 15 will be considered regular players and are not eligible for OR conditions.

ELIGIBILITY

- Open to players from Canada, Mexico, and USA who are under 20 years old (19 and younger) as of 1/1/2026. All players must be born on or after 1/1/2006.
- Players' FIDE federation must show CAN, MEX, or USA.

- This event is US Chess and FIDE-rated. US Chess membership  required for all players.

- There is no rating or title minimum or maximum.

- Girls may enter either section - Open U20 or Girls U20.

- Erroneous registrations will be subject to the refund policy.

Arizona Golden Cup 🏆 (End of 2026 Series)

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, December 19, 2026

Event Overview

Arizona's Premier Year - Long USCF Chess Series.
Earn Points. Win Gold. Become a Champion. 🏆
A year-long USCF-rated chess series. Players earn Golden Points at each monthly event. Final standings after December determine the Arizona Golden Cup Champion, 2nd and 3rd Place in each section. Players may enter the series at any time during the year. Tournament is open to everyone. USCF membership is required.
4 Round Swiss G/30; d5 USCF-rated tournament series with cumulative points.
Sections: Open (1800 +). Under 1800. Under 1200. No playing up allowed. Official rating will be used for sections and prizes. Half point Byes available in all 4 rounds (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. If a player moves to a higher section during the year, points earned in the previous section do not transfer. The player begins earning Golden Cup points in the new section.
Schedule: Round 1: 9:00 AM. Round 2: 10:15 AM. Round 3: 11:30 AM. Round 4: 12:45 PM. Ceremony will follow right after last game is over.
Entry Fee: $35.00 by Wednesday, $40.00 by Friday, $45.00 Same Day. Refund Policy: Full refund if canceling up to 1 hour before the event. No refund after that.
Awards: Top 3 Trophy in each section, Best U1400 and Best U800 in each monthly event.
At the end of the series-After December event: Champion Trophy (in each section) + 7 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 2nd Place Trophy (in each section) + 5 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. 3rd Place Trophy (in each section) + 3 Months of Free entry for 2027 series. Players are eligible to win only one Arizona Golden Cup prize, awarded in the highest scoring section in which they competed.
Golden Points System:
Finish                 Points
1st Place              20
2nd Place            16
3rd Place             13
4th Place             10
5–6                           8
7–10                        5
Participation       3
Bonus Points:
+3 points — Perfect score (4/4).
+2 points (only in December) — Played Most consecutive months.
Monthly Event Tie-Handling (Point Splitting): When two or more players are tied for placement in a monthly Arizona Golden Cup event, Golden points are split evenly among the tied positions.
Tie-Breaks (Year-End):
1. Most 1st-place finishes.
2. Head-to-head results.
3. Most tournaments played.
4. Best December result.
TD decisions are final.

Schedule: Round 1- 2:30 PM, Round 2- 2:45 PM, Round 3- 3:00 PM, Round 4- 3:15 PM. Round 5- 3:30 PM, Round 6- 3:45 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 6 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point Bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Entry Fee: $30.00 by 1/28; $35.00 by 1/30; $40.00 same day. Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
Prizes: Over 1200: Cash for top three. 1st - 30%, 2nd - 14%, 3rd - 10%.
Under 1200: Trophy for top three. Trophy for the Best Under 700.

Tunnelvision LI

Columbia Chess Club

Saturday, December 19, 2026

Event Overview

The Columbia Chess Club Presents Columbia Tunnelvision LI
December 19, 2026
$1000 Guaranteed
10:30 a.m. 4-Round G/45;inc.5
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd.
Columbia, SC 29212
Register
Registration
Standard registration is $40 until midnight on the Thursday before the tournament.  $50 late registration thereafter.  Registration online only, registration limited to first 74 players.
Entry for titled players (National Master and above) is free, standard entry fee deducted from prizes.  If you are a titled player, simply use the "Titled Player" option at checkout.
Considering Tunnelvision as your first chess tournament?  Great!  We've put together a guide to help first-time players .
Register Now
Pre-Registered Players
Format
4 Round Swiss. Time control is G45/inc.5 (45 minutes starting time with a 5-second increment ), which will be USCF dual-rated under both Quick and Classical. All equipment provided. USCF Rules Apply, active USCF Membership required. Tournament has three sections: Championship (1600+), Under 1600, and Under 1000. Players may register for a higher section if they are within 100 USCF rating points of the cutoff. Players may use either their live standard rating or live quick rating to play in a higher section. Players may not play in a section lower than permitted by their published standard rating.
If you need to renew or obtain a USCF membership, please visit  https://new.uschess.org/join-us-chess.
Rules Note: Per USCF Rule 28T, the pairing system will avoid pairing players registered under the same team during the first-half of the event.
Live Standings/Pairings/Boards
The top board of each section will be live streamed to the DGT LiveCloud along with real-time updates to Lichess.org and Chess.com.  A live video stream of the top Championship board will also be available on the club's Twitch page.  See this site's "Live" menu for links.
Live standings (including current pre-registration information) and pairings are also available below.
Live Standings
Prizes
$1000 Prize Fund Guaranteed.
Championship (1600+)
$400 Fund. 1st: $200; 2nd: $130; 3rd: $70
Under 1600
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Under 1000
$300 Fund: 1st: $150; 2nd: $100; 3rd: $50
Schedule

- Round 1: 10:30 a.m.

- Round 2: 12:50 p.m.

- Round 3: 2:40 p.m.

- Round 4: 4:30 p.m.

Byes
A single half-point bye is available any round, including the final round.  The half-point bye may be requested as a part of the advance entry or on site before the tournament starts.  Thereafter the only bye available is a zero-point bye.  The chief tournament director shall have the ability to grant a half-point bye for any round on unusual circumstances.
Location
Columbia Chess Club
6169 St. Andrews Rd., Ste A
Columbia, SC 29212
Questions?
Email  [email protected] or call/text James Brandmair at 803.569.0938.
Parking
The Columbia Chess Club is located in a shopping center with ample parking.
Food
The Columbia Chess Club offers on-site concessions, including drinks and snacks.  By the Fire Pizza and Zorba's Restaurant are located in the same shopping center and will be open during the tournament.  Many other restaurants are available close by!

2026 North American Junior Blitz Championships

Hilton Charlotte University Place

Monday, December 21, 2026

Event Overview

https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/najrblitz

OVERVIEW
The 2026 North American Junior (U20) Blitz Championship is a 6 round US Chess and FIDE Blitz-rated event held as a side event to the 2026 NA Junior .

The NA Junior is held just before the Winter Classic (same venue) and the Winter Elite Camp (different venue).

WHEN
Monday, December 21, 2026
11:00am​

WHERE
Hilton Charlotte University Place
8629 JM Keynes Drive
Charlotte, NC 28262
Free Internet, Free Parking
​
$139/Night
Booking Link - Book ASAP
Click "edit stay" at the top of the booking page to select your exact dates
Please email us if the booking link is not showing the correct rate.

BLITZ REGISTRATION

- Registration closes December 20, 10:30am.

- This event is US Chess and FIDE-rated. US Chess membership required for all players.

- On-site check-in is not necessary for pre-registered players.

ELIGIBILITY

- It is not required to be playing the NA Junior main event to be eligible to play the blitz.

- Open to players from Canada, Mexico, and USA who are under 20 years old (19 and younger) as of 1/1/2026. All players must be born on or after 1/1/2006.
- Players' FIDE federation must show CAN, MEX, or USA.

- This event is US Chess and FIDE-rated. US Chess membership  required for all players.

- There is no rating or title minimum or maximum.

- Girls may enter either section - Open U20 or Girls U20.

- Erroneous registrations will be subject to the refund policy.

SECTIONS
Open U20 (open to boys and girls)
Girls U20

FORMAT
7 round Swiss
Time Control: G/3; inc/2

PRIZES
Gold, Silver, Bronze medals to top 3 per section (on tiebreaks).

TIEBREAKS

- Direct Encounter (applies if all tied players have played each other)

- Greater # wins

- Greater # games with Black

- Buchholz cut 1

- Buchholz

- Sonneborn-Berger

SCHEDULE
Blitz Round 1 starts 11:00am, remaining rounds ASAP.

BLITZ ENTRY FEE

- $30 online by December 10

- $40 after December 10 (online or on-site)

CONTACT

Game 40 Challenge

Phoenix Chess Academy

Saturday, December 26, 2026

Event Overview

4 round Swiss. Time control: Game in 40 minutes with 5 sec delay. Boards, sets, clocks and scoresheets will be provided.
Registration: Go to www.phoenixchessacademy.com. USCF membership is required. New or renewing USCF members are welcome. Highest rating will be used for Swiss pairings and prize purposes.
Sections: Open, Under 1700, Under 1200 & Under 700. No playing up allowed for Open and U1700. Players Under 700 can play in the U1200 Section. Sections will be combined in case a section has less than 4 players registered.
Schedule: Round 1- 9:00 AM, Round 2- 10:30 AM, Round 3- 12:00 PM, Round 4- 1:30 PM. Awards Ceremony will start right after last game is over. Half point Byes are available in all 4 rounds and (Max 2) and must be requested before round 2. Requesting a zero-point Bye late in the tournament is considered the same as withdrawing.
Contact: Liulia Cardona at [email protected] or (602) 402-4985
Prizes: Trophies for top three in each section.
Entry Fee: $30.00 by Wednesday; $35 by Friday; $40 same day. Refund Policy: Full refund will be issued to players who withdraw at least an hour before the first round. In cases where a registered player does not show up for the tournament without prior notice, they will not be eligible for a refund.
A player will automatically forfeit the game if going in the bathroom with a cellphone.

Phoenix , AZ 85022

Cincinnati Tornado DEC. Last Saturday of Month

Wyoming Baptist Church

Saturday, December 26, 2026

Event Overview

Cincinnati Tornado Monthly Tournament
Held on the Last Saturday of the Month
We provide all clocks & chess sets

Advance Entry Fee $45
Online Registration – By Friday 12 midnight deadline
Online Registration:   https://chessearth.com/tornado-registration/
Advance Registration ends on Friday 12 midnight.
NEW OPTION for returning players.   EMAIL or  TEXT MESSAGE  us to pre-register and enter the tournament:

- Email admin@chessearth:   1.) First & Last Name   2.) USCF ID  3.) Section you are playing in  and  4.)  Pay $45 at the Tournament Site

On-Site Entry Fee $50; On-Site Registration – By 9:30am Saturday morning deadline
-  10am First Round.

- On-Site Registration – Ends at 9:30am Saturday morning.     10am First Round.

- Credit Cards, PayPal, Venmo, CashApp, Zelle, Apple Pay accepted on site

- Tournament  Address:    Wyoming Baptist Church, 170 Burns Ave, Cincinnati, OH 45215

4-Round Swiss Tournament
Time Control: G/45 +5; Each player receives 45 minutes with a +5-second increment. A Tornado is a one-day tournament where you play four games. Cash Prizes and Awards are given at the end of the tournament based on your final score.
Round Start Times:
Round #1: 10:00am
Round #2: 12:30pm
Round #3: 2:30pm
Round #4: 4:30pm
Choose a Section To Play In:

- Open Section  -  Includes the Master Bounty Prize - $100

- Under 1600 Section

- Under 1000 Section

- Award Winning Chili.  Good Food; Hot Meals

- Chess Equipment and Merch available to purchase

- USCF Rated Tournament.  Join/Renew USCF on-site.

- Purchase a New Membership at Registration.

- 1/2 Point Bye is available if notified before Round 2.

- Prizes Fund based on 70 players.

- We provide all the Chess Clocks & Chess Sets

Open Section:     **NEW** Rating must be 1600 or above to play in the Open Section.
Or a player can pay $30 to “play up” into the Open Section.
1st – $200      2nd – $150
Top Under 2001   – $100
Top Under 1801   – $100
Includes the Master Bounty Prize - $100

- Master Bounty Prize:  Win your game against the #1 Master in the tournament and win $100. If you draw the Master, win $50.  If the Master wins all the games, then he/she wins the $100.

Under 1600 Section:   The heart of the tournament
1st – $200      2nd – $150
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
Under 1000 Section :  Rating must be lower than 1001. Great for beginners and 1st time tournament players.
1st – $200      2nd – $150
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
$100 – Class Prize. We figure out the class prize after seeing the number of players who enter.
Chess Community Gathering

- Hang Out & Analyze;  Play Casual Chess Games in the Skittles room.

- TVs are in the Skittle rooms

- Enjoy Good Food

- Buy Chess Merch

- Watch the Tournament.

- Chess Social Life.

- We are looking for volunteers to help with the clean-up; putting chairs and tables away.  Please email us if you can help.  We appreciate it!!

- Monday, December 28, 2026

https://www.charlottechesscenter.org/events/winterclassic

OVERVIEW
The Charlotte Winter Classic is a classical event with a $7,500 guaranteed prize fund - $7,000 in the main event plus a FREE $500 Sunday evening blitz. The event is open to all - there is no minimum rating or registration cap.

The Winter Classic is held just after the NA Junior Championship (same venue) and just before the Winter Elite Camp  (different venue).

WHEN
December 26-28 or 27-28, 2025
​

WHERE
Great venue in the heart of Southpark! Walk to Starbucks, Whole Foods and more!

Hilton Charlotte University Place
8629 JM Keynes Drive
Charlotte, NC 28262
Free Internet, Free Parking
​
$139/Night
Booking Link - Book ASAP
Click "edit stay" at the top of the booking page to select your exact dates

​

​ ELIGIBILITY

- This event is fully open! There is no minimum rating or registration cap.

REGISTRATION

- Online registration only - no on-site registration.

- All registration closes 75 minutes before round 1 start time.

- On-site check-in is not necessary for players .

Under Sections, 3-Day Schedule : G/100, inc/10
2-day Schedule: Rounds 1-2: G/30, inc/10, Rounds 3-5: same as 3-day above

$7,000 Guaranteed Prize Fund in 4 Sections .

Championship -  FIDE Rated

- Sunday, 12/27, 8:30pm

- Free blitz entry for players in the Winter Classic.

2026 Michigan High School & Junior High Team Championships

48309,

Directions:

https://www.oakland.edu/oc/

Directions to the Oakland Center

The Oakland Center is located in the heart of Oakland University’s main campus.

Oakland University is located in southeastern Michigan between Flint and Detroit. The 1,441-acre campus actually extends into two cities — Auburn Hills and Rochester Hills, between Adams Road and Squirrel Road, just south of Walton Boulevard. Take I-75 to exit 79 and go east on University Drive to the main entrance of campus. Or, take M-59 to the Squirrel Road exit and go north to the main entrance of campus at the corner of University Drive.

From OU’s Main Entrance

To get to the Oakland Center from the main entrance of campus, drive around the circle drive past the first entrance to Meadow Brook Road until you get to the second entrance to Meadow Brook Road and turn right. The Oakland Center is located on the right side of the road between North and South Foundation Halls. The best place to park is in Parking Lot 1 or 2.

Format:

Printable Flyer: Printable Flyer: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RMMuXsTyjjbycyCSt_cZ0n-fR5R9hysW/view?usp=sharing

High School: 4-SS, 2 Sections - High School Championship: HS Teams (Gr 9-12), High School Reserve: HS Teams (Gr 9-12) U1000 Avg Team Rating

Junior High (No HS 9th Grade Teams per MCA Rules): 5-SS, 2 Sections - Junior High Championship: K-9, Junior High Reserve: K-9 U600 Avg Team Rating

Average Team Rating Calculator: https://www.michess.org/team-rating-calculator

Michigan Chess Association and USCF Memberships Required for ALL Players

Event Policies:

MCA Scholastic Code of Conduct & Building Policies will be provided via a separate flyer online and via hard copy during the event. By registering for this event, players, parents, and coaches agree to abide by these policies. Any violations of these policies can lead to withdrawal of all teams from the school and ejection from the facility.

Teams:

- Each team is composed of 3-5 players. A standard team consists of 4 players. A team may compete with 3 players, possibly forfeiting on board 4. Teams of 5 players are also permitted where any 4 of the 5 players can play each round while keeping consistent board order.

- The players on a team must be part of the same educational system (“school’) as defined by USCF Scholastic Regulations Sections 5.2, 5.3, or 5.4. https://new.uschess.org/sites/default/files/media/documents/uschess-scholasticregulations_2024-2025.2024.08.05a.pdf

- Multiple teams from the same school may be submitted to any section or event.

- There is no requirement that the teams be sponsored by the school. A group of friends that meet the team eligibility requirements can register and compete.

- Individual players should not register for the event. Contact MCA for assistance forming a team.

- For teams that cannot participate due to last minute withdrawals, the remaining players may still participate in the extra rated games.

Section Eligibility:

MCA Standing Rule 82-01: Ninth grade students playing in an MCA scholastic team tournament must play in the event for the type of school they attend. Examples: (Adopted 01/13/82)

1. If a high school includes grades 9 12, then those ninth graders would play in the High School Tournament.

2. If a junior high school has grades 7 9, then those ninth graders would play in the Junior High School Tournament.

Board Order:

MCA Standing Rule 84-03: Regarding board order in team tournaments: Rated players should generally be placed in rating order; unrated players may be placed anywhere. This should be done with fairness in mind: The strongest player on each team should play on first board, no matter whether he has a relatively high or low rating or is unrated. The tournament director may, at his discretion, change submitted player placements, after considering evidence from various sources (non-USCF ratings, other coaches, etc.). (Adopted 06/21/84).

Average Team Rating:

Use our online tool to determine eligibility for Reserve sections: https://www.michess.org/team-rating-calculator

Match Games:

Individual games are between the players only without the assistance of parents, coaches, and teammates. All questions or concerns, including current match score, should be directed to the TD.

Extra Rated Games:

Each round, Fourth boards without an opponent and alternates are paired randomly so they can play rated games. These games are optional, and players are not guaranteed a game. Points scored in these matches DO NOT count for individual medals.

Equipment:

Boards and Pieces are provided for tournament games. Bring your own set for skittles between rounds.

Bring Clocks:

Games may start without clocks, but games running long will have a clock placed on them with very little time.

Notation:

Please bring writing utensils. All players must record the moves of their game until one player has less than 5 minutes remaining on the clock.

Cell Phones:

No Players may have a cell phone in their possession during their game.

Spectators:

Parents and Coaches may be separated from the playing area once games begin.

Time Control:

JH: G/40;d5

HS: G/55;d5

Rounds:

JH: 9am – 11am – 1pm – 3pm – 5pm

HS: 9:30am – 12:30pm – 3pm – 5:30pm

$25 per Player in Advance by 2/21/2026 (Sat week before) at Midnight

$33 per Player in Advance by 2/23/2026 (Mon prior) at Midnight

$55 per Player in Advance by 2/26/2026 (Thur prior) at 8pm

All mailed entries must be postmarked by 2/20/2026

ABSOLUTELY NO ENTRIES AFTER THURSDAY AT 8PM FOR ALL SECTIONS.

Online registration: http://www.onlineregistration.cc (Preferred Method)

If an invoice is needed for school payment, please contact the TD by 2/16/2026 to allow time for processing.

Registration:

The Online Registration ( https://onlineregistration.cc/index.php) system will be the main mechanism to register for the tournament, but not the only method. Those registering through other ways will not be listed at the Online Registration Entry List. MCA will provide a separate website link closer to the tournament date to view full entries along pairings and results during the tournament.

Online registration Links:

- JH: https://onlineregistration.cc/MCA/2026_MCA_JHTeam

- HS: https://onlineregistration.cc/MCA/2026_MCA_HSTeam

Mailed registration: Michigan Chess Association, P.O. Box 40, Flint, MI 48501

DO NOT register unless you are part of a known school team. Individual players without a team are not allowed to participate.

Check-In

Teams must be paid in advance and will be paired for round 1. Parents should check-in with their Coaches. Coaches with any changes must inform MCA staff in writing before 8:15am. No refunds will be given to any players or teams who are paired for the first round and do not arrive. Policy materials will be available onsite.

High School Sections: Individual Medals: Gold 4.0 pts, Silver 3.5 pts, Bronze 3.0 pts

High School Championship Team Awards: Top 10

High School Reserve Team Awards: Top 6

Junior High Sections: Individual Medals: Gold 5.0 pts, Silver 4.0-4.5 pts, Bronze 3.5 pts

Junior High Championship Team Awards: Top 10 teams + all at 3.5

Junior High Reserve Team Awards: Top 7 teams + all at 3.5

810-955-7271

jeffchess64@gmail.com

No outside food/drink or delivery services.

- Oakland Center Food Vendors will be open to purchase food

Building Policies: TBD

🚗 Drive Directions Using the Windsor–Detroit Tunnel

Enter Canada through the Windsor–Detroit Tunnel

As you exit the tunnel on the Canadian side, you’ll be in downtown Windsor (near Park Street / Ouellette Ave). Crossing via the tunnel often takes about 20–30 minutes total including the tunnel drive + U.S./Canada customs if traffic isn’t heavy.

Head toward your destination

From the tunnel exit, get onto Ouellette Avenue (northbound).

Turn onto Riverside Drive heading east.

Continue to Walker Road / Huron Church Road south and then follow signs toward E.C. Row Expressway / Banwell Road if needed.

Eventually head east on North Service Road.

Arrive at 1800 N Service Rd, Windsor, ON

Total driving from the tunnel exit to this address inside Windsor city limits is usually around 15–25 minutes, depending on traffic and signals.
